anh_en: Seems like a few Exoswarm got lost inside the forest. I'm going after them. Hope they are okay. —Decima

anh_en: There's a layer of snow over it. Looks like it's been left here for a while...

anh_en: Normally, it won't take that much time to navigate through the forest. This is pretty concerning.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: We should find Decima!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: The trees... They are coming back to life...

speaker: NPC #750463
anh_en: Hello, wandering travelers. Are you here to enjoy the beauties of Upphaf Forest as well?

speaker: NPC #750463
anh_en: We've met once.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: I don't remember anything. I'm sorry.

speaker: NPC #750463
anh_en: Hehe, that's quite all right. I notice your camera. You are here for the sights and photos, right?

speaker: NPC #750463
anh_en: Don't mind me. Go, enjoy the scenery.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Miss Decima... Thank goodness you're okay.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: We saw your message at the abandoned research outpost and were worried you might've gotten into trouble...

speaker: NPC #750463
anh_en: I thought perhaps my people might come looking for me, so I left a message for them.

speaker: NPC #750463
anh_en: It's easy to lose track of time walking these woods. My apologies if I've caused you concern.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Good to know you're okay. What about the Exoswarm?

speaker: NPC #750463
anh_en: Don't worry, they're back to where they belong. I was just wandering around, enjoying the scenery.

speaker: NPC #750463
anh_en: It's been a long time. Inara, how have you been?

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: It's been a long time...?

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: This used to be a place of lush forest before the Lament.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: The space station behind the glacier. The forest within the ice. Anything related to ice always feels so eternal and unchanging...

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: {PlayerName}, is there anything you hope will never change?
There is.
All things inevitably change.
What do you think?

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: I do too, but I can't quite remember right now.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: True, even a glacier that's stood for a thousand years could thaw in its thousandth and one.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: For my short life span, a lot of things stay the same. I hope all the beautiful views I get to see could be frozen in time.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: I want to take a few more photos. Do you mind waiting here for me?
Okay.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: It was vast, as far as the eye could see. Even on a world map, it was a patch of green no one could miss.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: I won't take long! Be right back.
With that, Inara ran off.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Then, the Lament changed everything. Animals, plants, insects, and even the birds on the ground.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: When the warm fjord became the new pole, everything was sealed under a thick, never-melting layer of ice.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Their stories ended there.
You sound like you're reading from a picture book.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: I feel like someone said the same thing before... Can't remember, though. It might just be from a picture book!

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Or some opening lines of a play.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: But look, how gorgeous this place is.

speaker: NPC #750463
anh_en: The disaster ten years ago... there was only one survivor. I never thought I'd see her again.

speaker: NPC #750463
anh_en: This is a blessing. For her, and for you.

speaker: NPC #750463
anh_en: It seems she has finished with her photos. Go meet her, wandering traveler. I wish you luck on your journey...
You met Inara before?

speaker: NPC #750463
anh_en: Back then, the rescue team asked me to guide them to their camp... They were never supposed to encounter that storm.

speaker: NPC #750463
anh_en: The team ran into the Void Storm only because of the monsters that were chasing them.

speaker: NPC #750463
anh_en: The place where they perished wasn't far from their temporary camp. This lady likely witnessed her companions' deaths.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: That's why she was so severely devastated that she lost her memory.

speaker: NPC #750463
anh_en: In the cold, a forest frozen in ice is a blessing.

speaker: NPC #750463
anh_en: One day, all those frozen will thaw and come back to life, and so will her memories.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Is this from experience?

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: I took so many good photos!

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: How was your chat with Miss Decima?
It was all right.
Wanna know what we talked about?

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: How are you able to start a chat with anyone wherever you go? That's impressive.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: I won't ask about your conversation... That would be awkward.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: I am a bit curious about her, though. She looks familiar somehow, but I can't remember where I've met her before.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Anyway, never mind! All the signs along the way point to hot springs being nearby.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: The view around the hot springs must be a real break from all this ice! That'll be our next stop!

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Look, a cabin here. I can't believe it. Is someone actually living here?

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Do you think it'll be rude to be taking pictures around his or her house?
Just a few photos for the trip, she won't mind.
Good point, let's not take any pictures.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Totally. Just some photos I'll keep to myself. I also want a few of the other places...

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Yes. Let's go somewhere else instead!

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Hmm... Where would be a good spot for the pictures? Let's see.. Here and here...
Inara steps away, looking for a suitable photo spot somewhere else.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Such a beautiful and breathtaking place, just like a painting.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: I feel like I lost something here somewhere.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: But I... I've never been to the frostlands before, have I?
Let's assume you did lose something.
Let's go look for it together.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: If it does exist, I... We... Does that mean those dreams...

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Okay, let's go find it. This time, I'll lead the way.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: When I played building sims, I'd always put houses in places like this, like the hermits from Huanglong legends, or the hidden races you read about in New Federation novels.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: But later, I started building houses elsewhere.
How come?

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: I had to travel so far from familiar ground to reach hidden gems like this. And the silence… it just made you feel alone almost immediately.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: When a beautiful view just becomes part of your daily routine, staying here means you're just… living in your own memories.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Sometimes, dreamy can be another name for empty.
Why the sentiment all of a sudden?

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Actually, I've been getting this strange feeling ever since coming to the frostlands.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Right here...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Ugh, got so caught up booking my time off... Totally forgot to hire a guide...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Watch out!

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: These... These monsters... It's them...

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: It's them... These monsters. I've dreamt about them several times.
But you tried to remember as much as you could.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: ...It was right here... Now, there is nothing left.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: I didn't forget anything... except for a part of myself.
That's not true.
Look, something's beneath the ice.
You break open the ice and reveal a frozen safety box.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: It's the expedition team's Cassette...
This might be what you're looking for.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: ...Sorry, {PlayerName}. I need some time alone.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: I've been dreaming about being on an expedition team, out there investigating the frostlands.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Some teach me how to play video games, some... are very interested in Upphaf Forest, and talk about the many pre-Lament stories...

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: But later, we are chased by the monsters, and then, a Void Storm hits us out of nowhere... Everyone, one after another... are all... all...

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: In my dreams, I never make it back to the outpost. I'm just… stuck out there in the frostlands. Always. Over and over again... I just can't make it.
(Comfort her)

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: I can't remember their faces. Each time I woke up, I always felt... those were just dreams.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: {PlayerName}, those weren't just dreams... right? I've forgotten something important, haven't I?
Some memories might never come back.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Thanks for waiting, {PlayerName}. I feel much better now.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Human memory can be so unreliable at times.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Even if you try to hold onto a memory, repeating it over and over... you can still lose it one day, without even knowing.
At least you remember it now.
The dreams held that memory for you.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Let's... take a picture here. I want to remember this place. I won't forget. Not again.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Thank you. Now that our trip is wrapping up, allow me be your guide instead.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: This right here is the best photo spot. A lot of my colleagues came straight here when they first got to the outpost.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: You should take a photo for yourself as well.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Look at this place. The research center, our supply hub, and the gateway to the underground oasis.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: This is where our frostlands journey started, and where it will end.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Let's mark the end of our trip with this photo.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: That was a rough journey, we...
We're back.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Yes, that's right! W-We made it.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: I need to submit this Cassette and print out the pictures... Oh, there's so much to do.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Thank you for traveling with me. Here's your pay, as we agreed.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: See you next time, {PlayerName}!

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: It's so beautiful... Why didn't I come here sooner?

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Let's take a picture here, {PlayerName}!
You take a few steps away. The wind drowns her soft whimpering, leaving fine marks on the frostlands.
Not long after, she walks to your side.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Hello, you must be {PlayerName}?

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: From the looks of it, if I want to see everything the frostlands have to offer during my vacation, my best bet is to find a good guide...
So you want me to be your guide?

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Exactly! I'd be so grateful if you could show me around all the best spots in the frostlands. Oh, and it comes with good pay, of course!
I can do that.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Great! Let's head out right away!

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: O magnificent frostlands. Challenger Inara, coming your way!
Any specific places in mind?

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Well, if I had to choose, definitely the SkyArk Space Station! It's a newly discovered space station, and I've been dreaming of seeing it with my own eyes.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Okay, let's go.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Hehe... This is my first trip in over ten years! Away we go!
You are?

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: I'm Inara, a maintenance worker at the Frostlands Polar Research Outpost. Running into you at a time like this, I'm starting to believe in fate!
No need to get all emotional...
Well, what can I do for you?

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Oops, sorry. I got a bit carried away.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Here's the thing. I've been hard at work at the outpost for more than a decade now, and I've never taken the time to appreciate the frostlands' view.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Can you believe that? Totally unacceptable to me anyway. So, I finally put in for some time off. I'm going to give this place a proper exploration it deserves.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: But a new problem has surfaced. Between the endless maintenance work and scrambling to get my leave approved, I did zero trip planning.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You choose to stay.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Will this place still look the same when the owner returns?
(Ready the camera.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (I'll send her all these photos after she's back.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Should go check on Inara now...)

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Wow—Oh—This is the view I saw in the reports just two days ago!

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Seeing it with my own eyes gives me a sense of nostalgia...

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Quick, take some pictures!

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Ever since this station was discovered, nearly a third of the outpost have tried to get on the excavation crew.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: We've come all this way... It'd be a shame if we don't take a peek at what's inside.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: There's a researcher from the expedition team by the entrance. Let's go have a chat.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: The folks who work here are always hungry for the unknown. An opportunity like this? They're on it in a heartbeat.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: But the actual excavation work hasn't even started yet, and people are already in a spin.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: The excavation work still hasn't started?

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Your last report showed that the threat level here is still unconfirmed. Researchers are only allowed in once that's settled.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Strangely enough, the closer I get to it, the more I feel like I've seen this place before.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: But this fallen debris was only discovered a few days ago, and I've never left the outpost. So why does it feel... familiar?
Maybe you've seen similar ruins before?

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Possibly.

speaker: NPC #750350
anh_en: Oh, Miss Inara? And you must be... {PlayerName} from the Academy? Your reputation precedes you.

speaker: NPC #750350
anh_en: What brings you here?

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: I'm on vacation. I'd like to visit the inside of the space station. Have they given out visiting permits yet?

speaker: NPC #750350
anh_en: Sorry, there're still parts of the space station that haven't been checked for safety yet. All visits are prohibited.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Well, that's disappointing... Sigh, I guess I'll have to come back on my next vacation.

speaker: NPC #750350
anh_en: P-Please don't give me that look. I'm starting to feel I'm the villain now...

speaker: NPC #750350
anh_en: How about this, I'll send both of you some pictures we took from inside the space station as a souvenir.

speaker: NPC #750350
anh_en: Do come back for a visit after we confirm it's safe inside the space station, Miss Inara.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: I guess it will have to be. I'll go have a look around to see if there're any good views for pictures.

speaker: NPC #750350
anh_en: I have the pictures for Miss Inara uploaded, and some for you as well, {PlayerName}.
I'll keep an eye out.

speaker: NPC #750350
anh_en: And also... these are pictures of the space station's interior we took, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #750350
anh_en: Safe travels.

speaker: NPC #750350
anh_en: By the way, {PlayerName}. It's probably not my business, but please take care of her while in the frostlands.

speaker: NPC #750350
anh_en: Back when Miss Inara first came, she was very reserved. She just put her head down and did her job, hardly talking to anyone.

speaker: NPC #750350
anh_en: Then a veteran expedition team noticed how dependable she was and invited her to support their frostlands operations.

speaker: NPC #750350
anh_en: Two months later, that very team encountered a Void Storm. She happened to be away at a temporary camp, so she was spared from the disaster.

speaker: NPC #750350
anh_en: The rescue team brought her back safely, but everyone soon learned that she had lost all memories of the expedition.

speaker: NPC #750350
anh_en: Void Storms typically don't cause amnesia. We suspect that she might have wanted to remember this journey so badly that she inadvertently...

speaker: NPC #750350
anh_en: I'm a bit worried that she might get shaken up again on her second trip here.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: I just remembered—there's an abandoned research outpost nearby! I heard the Roya use it as a rest stop. We can take a break there too.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: But I don't know how to get there. All I have is a map.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: But just a plan and a map won't do us much good if we run into something dangerous out there...
I'll keep you safe.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Words of the mighty. If only I had learned a few moves back when I was still in school!

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Well, if you could handle a Voidworm, guess I'll be safe sticking with you.

speaker: NPC #750349
anh_en: Let's head to the outpost.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: There's a note here.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: Every single one of these wind chimes carried someone's wish. Their ringing was like a prayer.
That title...
Please drop it.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: Afraid not! Naming the hero is a privilege of the people.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: Come on, let's go. We've got more locations to shoot!

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: But now, everyone who made those wishes and anyone who might've made them come true... they're all gone.
The one who can make their wishes come true...
Isn't that you?

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: I… I can't make anyone's wish come true. What can I do?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Maybe people didn't make wishes here just so someone could fulfill them.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: ...Maybe they did it just to be heard. To share their joy and their sorrow. The wish itself is proof that they were here. A message for anyone who comes after.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: And now... we can hear them too. Isn't that enough?

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: ...You're a special soul. You really live up to that "Dark Justice" title, too. Thank you. I... I needed to hear that.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: I remember a huge bed of hydrangeas right by this tennis court...

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: TDs! Be careful!

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: I was scared me to death. TDs, in the residential area! {PlayerName}, thank goodness you were here!

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: You've already figured it out, haven't you? Or... did you know from the start?
No.
I realized it from the way you spoke and acted.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: The Left Behind in Honami don't see Neon Tower's distortion. They don't remember the Lament that struck either.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: They just... go on, repeating their old lives and memories in this Sonoro city.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: But you remember everything. Why?

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: I can't say why exactly... but when the Lament came... I was aware of it. I felt my own end.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: And in that instant, a single, powerful wish was born. I think... that wish is what's keeping me here.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: I won't fade away. Not until I've seen it through. That's my choice.
So you came to me...

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: Must be that dense Remnant Energy that pulled them in and changed the landscape… But it's not all bad. We got some amazing shots out of it.
...to fulfill that wish?

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: ...Yes. And with your help, it's almost within reach.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: Alright, my sweet hero! Just one last place I want to photograph. Let's go.
You seem to know a lot...
...about Honami's past.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: Of course I do. I'm part of that past.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: This city, me, and everyone else still wandering here... we were all lost in the disaster. What's left are only remnants of the past.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: I'm sorry. I didn't mean to hide it. I just... couldn't find the words.
You meant no harm.
...Don't be sorry.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: This is the last one. Take the picture however feels right to you.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: An ordinary neighborhood. An empty playground…

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: It's like everyone just... stepped out for a minute.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: The last photo for the Honami City project is finally complete.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: Compared to them, my resolve was a joke. So I came back to Honami, buried the project, and tried to forget.
But you couldn't forget.
You picked it back up.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: ...I couldn't bear the thought of Honami being forgotten. I refused to let that happen.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: In that final moment, as I lay dying, I saw Honami's blue sky one last time. Saw the cherry blossoms falling as always...

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: Regret washed over me. And from it, a wish was born. Stronger than anything I'd ever felt.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: ...This city that I loved so much, its people, all of it... it didn't deserve to just vanish.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: In that moment, I finally understood. The duty I walked away from... my friends at the Association...

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: They must have known this feeling. That's why they walked into danger. To record it all. To save something.
To save a civilization's memories.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: Could you deliver these to the Pioneer Association for me?
To leave proof of existence.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: ...Yes. And completing this "Honami Photo Feature" with you is the last thing I can do for this city.
Your wish...
Is it fulfilled?

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: Yes. It is. Thank you, Dark Legend of Justice.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: No... thank you, my friend. For helping me see it through.
You leave Honami City and deliver the photos to the Pioneer Association, along with Eri's membership application…

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: My application must be years overdue by now. Ah, just saying it out loud is so embarrassing!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I will. But... are you sure you don't want to be the one to do it?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I thought you'd want to see it to the end yourself.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: ...It's alright. I don't need to.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: The truth is... I almost quit my appraisal. Halfway through.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: When I joined the Association as an intern and saw what my peers were willing to do, I realized my dream was just a kid's fantasy. A naive admiration.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: I couldn't do what they did. Staking their lives to photograph a dying city. I admired their passion... but I just didn't have it in me.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Hello again, Passenger! Hm? Where's the other Passenger?

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Wonderful! After all, making sure Honami's people are happy is one of my duties, you know!
She fulfilled her wish.
And left.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: I see, I see. What a shame. I even had dessert ready for her. More for me, I suppose.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: This is the reward she promised. She left it in my care for you.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Y'know, when she first wandered in here, she put on a cheerful face. But I could feel the weight on her.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: On your little adventure together, did she get any happier?
...Yes.
She became happy.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Membership... Appraisal... Hmm, more fancy words....

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Guess she's not the type to sit back and relax...

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Welcome back, Passenger! Perfect timing! Someone came here looking for you. Said it's something important.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: We chatted. She asked about nice spots for pictures. I suggested the fountain.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: The cherry blossoms there are in full bloom. They won the vote for... "Honami Crossing's Most Scenic Spot"!
Pioneer Association...
Membership...

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Uh-huh. Whenever that came up, things got a bit heavy…

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Too complicated. Not for a capybara like me. It's best you ask her yourself.

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: The cafe needs me, so I'll leave you to it, Passenger.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Right. To the fountain it is.)
A customer in the coffeehouse?
Someone we know?

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Yes! What a happy occasion!

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Nope, a new face! Oh, this calls for a celebration!

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: Thanks to you and Chisa breaking Honami's loop, Shashou Cafe finally has a new visitor. Who knows, this cafe might just hum with life again.
About that customer…
Do you know anything else?

speaker: NPC #50180
anh_en: She said she's from the Pioneer Association. She seemed... troubled by a "membership appraisal."

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Maybe if I try a different angle, the photo would look better?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Hey, over here!

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: Hi, I'm Eri from the Pioneer Association. Finally, we meet!

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: You're the "Mysterious Scissorswoman's" partner. The black-haired hero, Honami's newest urban legend!

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: It's not just that you're strong enough to fight the TDs. It's why you do it. People can see you're genuinely trying to protect this city.
Heh, "Mysterious Scissorswoman"...
Another bizarre nickname.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: C'mon, legends need cool titles. It's part of the appeal!

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: Anyway, the real reason I sought you out is because I need your help with a project. I want to photograph Honami City.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: This isn't just for fun. It's for my membership appraisal. I call myself a member of the Pioneer Association, but I'm technically still pending membership review.
Membership review?
Now things are getting heavy.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: I've been a huge fan of Wutherium Geographic magazine since I was a kid. Joining the Pioneer Association as an editor? That's the dream.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (A Left Behind, but doesn't seem local. Where did she come from?)

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: But the Editorial Board has a crazy appraisal process. You have to pitch a project that aligns with the Association's mission, pull off a photoshoot, secure approval, and get it published.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: I finally chose my theme, but now the streets are blocked, TDs are popping up everywhere, and my Terminal decided to die on me!

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: I was totally out of options until I started hearing about your heroics... Please, you have to help me! This is my one shot!
All right. I'll help you.
And the reward for all this?

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: Thank you, Dark Legend of Justice! Don't worry, I won't let you work for free!

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: Oh, don't worry. I'm not about to let a legendary hero work for free!

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: Let's get started then. Please, take a photo of this fountain at its absolute best.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: This place... it used to be so full of life. You could see tired shoppers stopping by, listening to the water, stealing a moment of peace.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: Just like Shashou Cafe, this fountain became a landmark in Honami Crossing. It's a memory... the feeling of being perfectly content.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (...Unusual. Better figure out her intentions first.)
I'm {PlayerName}.
Namipon said you were looking for me?

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: Ah, yes! The "Dark Legend of Justice"! Please, I have a request for you!
…"Dark Legend of Justice"?
Are you talking about me?

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: Of course! I recognized you immediately.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: The lighting, the framing, the timing… perfect. Just perfect!

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: Seeking out your help couldn't have been more right. Thank you! And of course, I have Namipon to thank for introducing us.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: Honami's mascot always brings luck. Wherever Namipon goes, good things follow.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: So, it's only fitting that our next stop has a whole lot more Namipons!
Alright. Let's go.
Maybe later.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: Look! The cherry blossoms, and this grand army of Namipon statues. This spot was voted to the top of Honami's "Ten Best Views" list more than once, you know.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: People here place their hopes for tomorrow on that little guy. I guess when life feels unpredictable, you hold on to simple, certain things.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: Ah, listen to me ramble on! Sorry, sorry! To make it up to you, you pick the next spot. Your turn to choose a photo op.
Me?
Sure, why not.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: Then I'm counting on you. Honestly, I'm really curious to see what you think is beautiful in this city.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Chisa mentioned the cherry blossoms in the Underground Street… That could work.)

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: This tree may have grown a bit… wild, but somehow all these Namipons balance it out.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: What do you think? Can you feel the bond between Honami and its favorite capybara?
I can feel it.
And its fascination with voting for random stuff.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: Ha! You got me there. People in Honami get kinda obsessed with the things important to them.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: It's that dopey face, the slow waddle, the fluffy everything... Namipon just has a way of melting stress away.
If Namipon hears that…
It'll start strutting.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: Didn't expect you to pick this place.
You sound sad.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: It's more regret than sadness, really. But don't you worry about me, I'm fine.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: ...Right now, I have more important things to do.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: Anyway, we're done here. On to the next spot! Hmm... where to?
I have one in mind.
How about the Summer Arbor?

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: The Summer Arbor walkway in Central Park? The wind chimes are beautiful, but... it's too close to Neon Tower. Could be risky. You sure about that?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Most Left Behind instinctively ignore the anomalies around them. It's a coping mechanism.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (But Eri notices the Tower's anomalies... She really is different.)
It's okay.
A friend recommended it.
I'll take care of it.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: Just... please be careful. I don't want you going out of your way.
She said it was lovely here.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: Let me guess, was it that mysterious scissor-wielding girl? She's got quite the eye! Hey, maybe she should pick up a camera herself and contribute to the Pioneer Association.
Thanks for the praise.
I'll pass the compliment along.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: This is Seisen Garden… I haven't been here in ages.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: This underground street used to be the heart of Honami's art scene. They were always hosting film festivals and photo exhibitions... I even had a few of my own pieces displayed here once.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: Now, it's just the cherry blossoms putting on a show for nobody. No more exhibitions. No more crowds.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: I never thought I would be able to come back here.

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: Listen. Hear the wind chimes in the Summer Arbor?

speaker: NPC #850354
anh_en: That sound... It's just like old times...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (A new mark just showed up on the map... Guess I'd better check it out.)

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: You've kept me waiting so long, Acis.

speaker: NPC #750178
anh_en: Mi… Misha?

speaker: NPC #750177
anh_en: Hehe, don't cry, my love. Aren't you happy to see me now?

speaker: NPC #750178
anh_en: I am…

speaker: NPC #750178
anh_en: I'm back, Misha.

speaker: NPC #750177
anh_en: Welcome home, Acis.

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: Welcome back, young one. I've been waiting for you.

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: Yes. I'm their daughter.

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: Fifty-two years ago, the observation data my father protected was eventually found by Ephor Valeria and her team. Thanks to that, both the town and the city of Septimont were spared from disaster.

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: But Father wasn't so lucky. He and his entire squad were lost to the hunting grounds that night.

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: It wasn't until eight years ago that his frequency started appearing around the Sanguis Plateaus again. That's when people began to remember the name “Timid Acis.”

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: But by then, my mother was already old and losing her memory. Before she forgot everything, the one thing she asked of me… was to uncover the truth about my father.
They reunited with each other.
Your mother... I think I saw her just now.

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: Then what you saw must have been her lingering frequency after passing.

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: She forgot so much… but never the one she loved.

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: I should be going. My grandson's still waiting for me at home.

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: How did the investigation I requested go?

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: He's always wanted to be a Gladiator like his father. No matter who tries to talk him out of it… he won't budge. Ha, I wonder where he got that stubbornness from.

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: I only wish Mother and Father could have seen all this.
I think… they already have.

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: …Yeah. You're right.

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: Well then, I should take my leave too. Thank you, young one. Thank you… for giving this story its ending.
Well…
(You hand over the necklaces and photos to Ina.)
You show her the photos you took and tell her how Acis's story came to an end.

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: So Father's frequency lingered all these years… just to fulfill his promise to Mother.

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: I'm so sorry, Father, for making you wander alone for so long.
Father?
Wait… Acis was your—

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Misha's necklace is glowing… and the light's pointing at that Drake nearby.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (…Is that Acis's necklace in its claw?)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (The marked route just ends here.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Maybe the Sensor can find more clues.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (The map has just been updated with more details. Looks like I'm getting closer to the truth.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Time to follow it and investigate further.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Didn't spot the necklace mentioned in the letter... Could it be lost nearby?)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (I should search around for hidden clues.)
You find a necklace just like the one from the memory left by the frequency. It resonates with your map and reveals a new marker.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Is this... Misha's necklace? Did she leave it here as a prayer for Acis's safe return?)

speaker: NPC #750177
anh_en: …I'll always wait for you, Acis.

speaker: NPC #750177
anh_en: Tomorrow, I'll visit the Priestesses at the Temple. I hope they can see a future where you come back to me, safe and sound.

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: You're here again, Acis...

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: It's been so long… and still, you can't let go?

speaker: NPC #750179
anh_en: …Sorry, Acis, for leaving you to face this mission alone.

speaker: NPC #750178
anh_en: Don't give up, Captain! The other teams—they're coming, they'll be here soon…

speaker: NPC #750178
anh_en: Just hold on… Captain?

speaker: NPC #750178
anh_en: Please… don't leave me alone…

speaker: NPC #750178
anh_en: Even if I'm the last one standing, I'll track those monsters… and record every trace… for the Ephor…

speaker: NPC #750178
anh_en: Damn it… why won't this bleeding stop…
You defeat the Drake and recover Acis's lost necklace, clutched tightly in its claws.
Following Acis's wish, you join his necklace with Misha's and place them together in the last place marked on the map.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: A new frequency appeared. That figure... Is that Misha?

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: It's been so long, Acis. And your "spirit" still lingers here on these Plateaus.

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: An amateur who became a Gladiator. No talent. No strength.

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: Someone like him didn't fit in with the elites during the hunt on the Plateaus. And so, he started keeping his distance from the others.
That's... a sad story.
Why did he choose to be a Gladiator at all?

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: It is. Misery followed Acis all the way to the end.

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: No one really knew. Or maybe no one cared enough to ask.

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: All we know is that he died fighting the Dark Tide creatures, 52 years ago.

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: If his spirit hadn't lingered, no one would've remembered his story. He'd be just another nameless Gladiator buried in the Vale of Glory.
Then why does his spirit still appear on the Plateaus?
...What exactly happened to him?
Acis?

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: It likely has something to do with the Sanguis Plateaus itself.

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: I heard its unique terrain attracts and holds Remnant Energy.

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: As a result, many Gladiators who died here with unfulfilled wishes have left behind wandering frequencies.
So Acis had an unfulfilled wish too?

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: That's what I've always wondered. I've asked people to look into it, but no one has ever found a clear answer.

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: I'm not young anymore… but Acis is still out there, forever trapped in a tragedy from half a century ago.

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: {Male=Young man;Female=Young lady}, could you track his traces and take photos of the places he's been to?

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: I want to know where he wandered… and what's still holding him here.
No problem.
If I get paid...
Is that his name?

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: Thank you, kind stranger. I'll make sure there's a reward for you.

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: Of course. I'll have it ready next time we meet.

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: Also, please take this map. Acis marked it himself during the hunt. It shows the places he once visited. Follow it, and you'll know where to go.

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: I'm counting on you, {Male=young man;Female=young lady}.

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: Yes. His "spirit" has been wandering here for ages. People have spotted it many times.

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: They called him "Timid Acis."
Timid Acis?

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: The name came from his past.

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: Acis was once a well-known Gladiator... not for his courage, but for the opposite.

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: Rumors painted him as a coward.

speaker: NPC #750176
anh_en: Did you find the way home, Father?

speaker: NPC #750177
anh_en: I'm so sorry. Acis and I only found your weapons...

speaker: NPC #750177
anh_en: I'll bring them back to the Vale of Glory, Ma, Pa. It's the only thing I can do for you now...

speaker: NPC #750178
anh_en: ...Sorry, Misha. If only I were as strong as the Gladiators… If only I could've joined the hunt myself… Maybe then, your parents wouldn't have been taken by the Dark Tide...

speaker: NPC #750178
anh_en: I'm still too weak. All I can do is watch over you from afar. But I promise that one day, I'll be strong enough.

speaker: NPC #750177
anh_en: You've really been pushing yourself too hard lately, Acis.

speaker: NPC #750178
anh_en: D-don't tease me...

speaker: NPC #750177
anh_en: Alright, alright. Off you go, Acis. I'll take care of myself and the little one.

speaker: NPC #750177
anh_en: Ever since you became a Gladiator, you've come home covered in bruises every single day. Look at the spot I patched up last time… You've hurt it again!

speaker: NPC #750178
anh_en: …Sorry for making you worry.

speaker: NPC #750177
anh_en: It's High Tide now, and I heard the Dark Tide creatures are no easy prey. Even regular Tacet Discords have gone feral under the Blightcloud… Is everyone on the hunting ground alright?

speaker: NPC #750178
anh_en: I don't know all the details. But try to stay in camp if you can, Misha.

speaker: NPC #750178
anh_en: Don't worry about me. I'll protect you and our home.

speaker: NPC #750177
anh_en: Hehe. Since when did my man learn to sound so cool, eh?

speaker: NPC #750178
anh_en: That's really all I want. Ever since I met you, I've known what I need to fight for.

speaker: NPC #750177
anh_en: Mmhmm. And now you're learning how to make your lady blush too?

speaker: NPC #750179
anh_en: I was surprised to hear Misha let you join the hunt this time.

speaker: NPC #750178
anh_en: …She didn't. I didn't tell her. If she finds out, a scolding won't be the end of it.

speaker: NPC #750179
anh_en: You... Well, if that's your choice, I won't say more about it.

speaker: NPC #750179
anh_en: But aren't you afraid, Acis? Our mission this time is to hunt the Dark Tide creatures in the lower levels, the most dangerous place of the Plateaus. We also need to record the Dark Tide's data. One mistake, and we're gone.

speaker: NPC #750178
anh_en: Of course I'm scared. To be honest, my legs are still shaking.

speaker: NPC #750178
anh_en: But even so, I have to face it. I made a vow to protect Misha here in this canyon. It's time I live up to that promise.

speaker: NPC #750179
anh_en: Haha, then I guess we can't call you "Timid Acis" anymore.

speaker: NPC #750179
anh_en: Sorry for what I said before. There's still a bit of time before we head out. Go say a proper goodbye to Misha, Acis.

speaker: NPC #750177
anh_en: Acis, you've earned everyone's recognition at last.

speaker: NPC #750177
anh_en: But, why am I crying... No, I should be happy for him now...

speaker: NPC #750178
anh_en: The hunt this time didn't go as planned. Those monsters destroyed the traps we set. They could break through the siege any moment now.

speaker: NPC #750177
anh_en: Exactly. That's why it matters. So promise me… you'll come back safe.

speaker: NPC #750178
anh_en: The captain assigned me to the frontline team to go after the ones that escaped. Tomorrow morning, we're heading deep into Maroonwood to track them down.

speaker: NPC #750177
anh_en: Just promise you'll make it back safe and sound, okay?

speaker: NPC #750177
anh_en: I see... Well then, take this.

speaker: NPC #750177
anh_en: I made these necklaces. One for each of us. Keep it with you, as a talisman. Promise?

speaker: NPC #750178
anh_en: ...Okay.

speaker: NPC #750177
anh_en: Cheer up now. I'll be waiting for you at the foot of the Three Heroes' Crest.

speaker: NPC #750178
anh_en: The Three Heroes' Crest… where we made our vow?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The clamor of the crowd, their panicked shrieks, and an eerie hymn echo all around...

speaker: NPC #750095
anh_en: The dark, suffocating fog that's swallowing the sky... Could this be the Dark Tide?

speaker: NPC #750095
anh_en: Don't be tempted by the songs! Run! Beware the Tacet Discords!

speaker: NPC #750095
anh_en: Now is not the time to surrender. I still see the Blessed Maiden's light shining through. She hasn't given up yet!

speaker: NPC #750095
anh_en: My lantern still burns bright, and my sword remains keen enough to fell any evil that dares approach!

speaker: NPC #750095
anh_en: I, Rosalie Seneca, will never succumb to the Dark Tide.

speaker: NPC #750095
anh_en: Heh, but if luck should spare me one last time, I want to live... I have so many dreams yet to fulfill...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: And then, silence falls once more.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The final words of the girl echo in the lingering frequency.

speaker: NPC #750094
anh_en: {Male=Sir;Female=Madam}, you just returned from Avinoleum?
(Keep the truth a secret and remain silent)

speaker: NPC #750094
anh_en: ...! Did she say anything? Please, tell me everything you saw and heard.
You recount in detail what you saw and heard to the old man before you, her ending included.
The old man's lips quiver ever so slightly. For a long, silent moment, he doesn't speak a word.

speaker: NPC #750094
anh_en: I was meant to attend the coronation ceremony with her that day, but circumstances delayed me...

speaker: NPC #750094
anh_en: By the time I arrived, it was too late. I couldn't protect my own child as a father, nor could I safeguard the sacred land as an Acolyte.
It wasn't your fault.

speaker: NPC #750094
anh_en: Thank you... for telling me.

speaker: NPC #750094
anh_en: At least now I know that my daughter died a true Acolyte, her faith unwavering, her soul virtuous.

speaker: NPC #750094
anh_en: I recall the dusk when I took Rosalie to Avinoleum. The golden light of the setting sun bathed the main tower's dome.
(Hand him the pictures of the seminary)

speaker: NPC #750094
anh_en: And she asked me who built such a glorious place or if it was a blessing from the Sentinel.

speaker: NPC #750094
anh_en: I forgot what I answered, but I believe she found her own answer.
It was the work of those before us.
Along with our efforts that built this civilization.

speaker: NPC #750094
anh_en: One day, on the land of Ragunna, such splendor will rise again.

speaker: NPC #750094
anh_en: I promise, I'll finish this memoir and never let these precious things be lost to time.

speaker: NPC #750094
anh_en: ...Until we meet again, {Male=sir;Female=madam}.

speaker: NPC #750094
anh_en: …Thank you. I believe I already know your answer. That's enough.

speaker: NPC #750094
anh_en: I promise, I'll finish this memoir and never let these precious things be lost to time.

speaker: NPC #750094
anh_en: This long-overdue birthday gift…I know Rosalie would have cherished it.

speaker: NPC #750094
anh_en: ...Until we meet again, {Male=sir;Female=madam}.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (You remain silent, fixing your calm gaze on the old man.)

speaker: NPC #750094
anh_en: You have left a spark of hope lingering in this old, withered heart.

speaker: NPC #750094
anh_en: This is indeed Avinoleum. These towers, these columns... They still shine with the brilliance of days gone by.

speaker: NPC #750094
anh_en: …{Male=Sir;Female=Madam}, there's something I must ask, something I wasn't ready to inquire before.

speaker: NPC #750094
anh_en: When the Dark Tide surged, my daughter, <color=Highlight>Rosalie</color>, was studying in the seminary. Like so many others there, she vanished from this world.

speaker: NPC #750094
anh_en: Do you think it's possible that, after all these years, Rosalie still survives in those ruins, isolated from our world?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You are instinctively aware of the weight of this question. About that girl's ending...
Actually, I encountered her lingering frequencies.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Hmm? Seems like a special frequency appeared nearby?)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Something feels familiar...)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (It must be that special frequency. What message will it carry this time?)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (The Blessed Maiden's coronation? Wait, I sense a Tacet Discord's frequency.)

speaker: NPC #750148
anh_en: *Fretful and depressed cry*

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: The tower... It seems to have risen to where Avinoleum is.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: What happened? Was that my hallucination?

speaker: NPC #750094
anh_en: Excuse me, {Male=sir;Female=madam}, have you noticed something unusual in that sky?

speaker: NPC #750094
anh_en: Yes. Twenty years ago, the Dark Tide swept through and changed everything. It took too many things and people we held dear.

speaker: NPC #750094
anh_en: Someone must write it down, lest the glory and triumphs of our past fade into nothing.

speaker: NPC #750094
anh_en: But when I reached the part about Avinoleum, I realized I could barely remember what it looked like.

speaker: NPC #750094
anh_en: I… My memories of the seminary are slipping away. The place where I spent my youth, where I strengthened my faith and devoted myself to self-discipline… it's all fading.
Are you an Acolyte?

speaker: NPC #750094
anh_en: I was. But as you can see, I no longer wear the vestment.

speaker: NPC #750094
anh_en: The current Order deems the study of the past forbidden, erasing all past records.

speaker: NPC #750094
anh_en: But now I have an idea... If you can reach the seminary, could you capture some photos for me?

speaker: NPC #750094
anh_en: Even if it has changed greatly, seeing it again might help me recall something... Anything.
Sure thing.
You've been observing the sky?
Sure, with the right compensation.

speaker: NPC #750094
anh_en: Thank you. I've managed to save a little over the years. You won't be doing this for nothing.

speaker: NPC #750094
anh_en: Absolutely. I've managed to save a little over the years. You won't be doing this for nothing.

speaker: NPC #750094
anh_en: Please take this map with you. I... no longer need it.
The old man gives you a slightly yellowed map. You find some familiar places depicted on it.

speaker: NPC #750094
anh_en: This was drawn back when Avinoleum was still on the ground. It marks the renowned places of that time.

speaker: NPC #750094
anh_en: Even now, high in the heavens, I believe some traces of its former beauty remain.

speaker: NPC #750094
anh_en: If you can... take some time to appreciate the sights and enjoy the Ragunna of old.

speaker: NPC #750094
anh_en: Yes, just an old habit of mine.

speaker: NPC #750094
anh_en: Once, Avinoleum was a marvel admired across all of Rinascita. But now, it's nothing more than an expanse of shadows, hanging in the sky.
I've been there before.
Actually, I just returned from there.

speaker: NPC #750094
anh_en: What? How did you...? Ah, I can sense that you are a powerful Resonator. There's no reason you would lie about such a thing.

speaker: NPC #750094
anh_en: Forgive this old man's ramblings. I've been writing a memoir… a record of Ragunna's past.
Ragunna's past?

speaker: NPC #750094
anh_en: When you were in Avinoleum, did you encounter... No, please forget it. Good luck on your journey.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The lingering frequency turns into unfamiliar voices around you.

speaker: NPC #750095
anh_en: Father… we've arrived? Is this Avinoleum?

speaker: NPC #750096
anh_en: Yes, my dear. We are here at Avinoleum.

speaker: NPC #750096
anh_en: A place blessed by the Sentinel, where divine glory converges—the Avinoleum Theological Seminary.

speaker: NPC #750096
anh_en: From this day forward, you shall study here and grow into an Acolyte strong enough to bear the burden, just as I once did.

speaker: NPC #750095
anh_en: But Father, are you leaving again?

speaker: NPC #750096
anh_en: I'm sorry, sweetheart. There are still far-off corners where the Sentinel's blessings have yet to reach. I must continue my duties.

speaker: NPC #750096
anh_en: But know this, I'll return to you whenever you need me.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Cheers from the crowds fill the air. The banks of the waterway are jammed with people.

speaker: NPC #750095
anh_en: Ragunna City is always full of cheer and joy at such times, but I never expected to see the same festive spirit at the seminary.

speaker: NPC #750095
anh_en: The banks are lined with Acolytes watching the festivities. Even our professors are dancing without a care in the world.

speaker: NPC #750097
anh_en: It's the Carnevale, a time to forget all titles and ranks!

speaker: NPC #750095
anh_en: You're right. The Carnevale is when differences and disputes are set aside.

speaker: NPC #750097
anh_en: Hey, don't just stand there! Come join us! We might even catch a glimpse of the Blessed Maiden herself!

speaker: NPC #750095
anh_en: Let's go!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (A hand-drawn map of the seminary? Just like the one I carry.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Perhaps this is not a coincidence.)

speaker: NPC #750095
anh_en: You call this dragon Echo... "Sloppy?"

speaker: NPC #750100
anh_en: That's right. It's known for its gentle, docile nature, loafing around all day. Not that it's shy. It's simply too lazy to move.

speaker: NPC #750095
anh_en: May I come closer? I just want to pet it.

speaker: NPC #750095
anh_en: Oh, it feels so cold.

speaker: NPC #750100
anh_en: Hahaha, feel free to spend as much time with it as you like.

speaker: NPC #750095
anh_en: And what about that giant dragon over there?

speaker: NPC #750100
anh_en: First time seeing it? That's the Blessed Maiden's mount, Gehinnom. It might look intimidating, but it's actually a gentle soul.

speaker: NPC #750100
anh_en: Speaking of which, the Blessed Maiden's coronation is around the corner.

speaker: NPC #750095
anh_en: Yeah, I can hardly wait.

speaker: NPC #750095
anh_en: According to the schedule, the Blessed Maiden will be crowned under the dome soon...

speaker: NPC #750095
anh_en: But why does the air feel so heavy?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I admire you. I wish I could also train with the Champion!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Do you really? It's a tough road.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: When I was little, my father took me to see this giant statue. He told me how strong this "Hero of Heroes" was and the epic battles he fought in.

speaker: NPC #850028
anh_en: Hehe, just sneaking in some free time, you know? I really love Septimontian culture, so I was over the moon when they told me I'd be sent here.

speaker: NPC #850028
anh_en: I visit the sights whenever I have time. And I'm also going to attend a gladiatorial match during the next public holiday.

speaker: NPC #850028
anh_en: My love for Septimont has only grown with time, especially since research at the Observation Tower is proceeding smoothly. At the same time, I've come to realize how terrifying the Dark Tide is.

speaker: NPC #850028
anh_en: Which is why I admire Septimont for confronting the Dark Tide head-on. And of course, who could forget the many fearless Gladiators residing in this city, like Miss Postumia.

speaker: NPC #850028
anh_en: We, too, are trying to support you as best as we can by redoubling our research efforts to understand the Dark Tide.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: But I'm... yes, I'll do my best as well.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Alright then, Champion, go ahead and record Fabius, the "Hero of Heroes" who forever watches over the land of Septimont.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Afterwards, I'll take you to the beating heart of Septimont, <color=Highlight> Capitoline Hill</color>.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Perhaps he wanted to motivate me to train harder. But I had other plans in my mind.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Books tell of Fabius, the Hero of Heroes, battling alongside Sentinel Imperator to hold back the Dark Tide. The passages were deeply moving. This statue stands as a perfect testament to Fabius' great deeds.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: To preserve history is to ensure that future generations will always remember him. Fabius was an incredibly brave warrior, and I…

speaker: NPC #850028
anh_en: Isn't this lady also a formidable Gladiator? Hello there, I'm Slovik, recently sent by the Black Shores to work at the Dark Tide Observation Tower up on the Border Mountains.
I almost forgot you're here as well.
You left the Border Mountains to slack off here?

speaker: NPC #850028
anh_en: It seemed rude to interrupt when the young lady here was having a moment of contemplation.

speaker: NPC #850028
anh_en: I also like learning about history, and I really love Septimontian culture, so I was over the moon when they told me I'd be sent here.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Miss Postumia, I'll be sure to wave your flag from the stands when you fight in the arena!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Err... thank you.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Are you ready to cross the wilderness with me on our journey to <color=Highlight>Capitoline Hill</color>?
Yes, let's get going.
I need some time to prepare.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Alright! The greenery of <color=Highlight>Capitoline Hill</color> await us!

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: No problem! I'll meet you there when you're ready.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Septimont City, Capitoline Hill, Gryphon's Fortress. This place goes by many names, just as it embodies the many qualities of the Septimontians.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: A "future" that is mine to record, which in time will turn into the "past" that our descendants will look up to. Such is my work as a historian.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: But… will it be enough? If crisis lurks in Septimont's "future," the city will need more warriors.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: If so… am I just wasting my talent, like Father said? When that time comes, will I be left with nothing but regret?
You don't have to bear that heavy burden.
What matters is doing what you want.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Thank you for comforting me, Champion. But my father, he—

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Thank you for comforting me, Champion… but I'm lost. Should I be a Gladiator or a historian, I just—

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Huh? Did you hear a strange noise?
Yeah, sounds like a big pair of ears flapping.
You have a keen sense of hearing.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Outsiders who don't understand Septimont view us as proud and overbearing, much like the city's skyline from afar.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: As expected of the Champion, you heard Ta-da's swooshing sound right away!

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: A Gladiator must keep their eyes sharp and ears open, especially when it comes to Echoes. That swoosh must have been made by Ta-da's flapping wings, right?

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: That little thing probably got lost. I guess it likes noisy places. If there's no one around, it must have become scared. Let's go find it.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: But once they get to know us, they see that our passion burns like the sun, and our honor shines just as brightly.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: No matter where you're from, you're always welcome to join us in the prosperous and vibrant heart of Septimont.
I familiar with the city's hospitality.
I know, I'm already a Septimontian.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Familiar with city's hospitality? You're our champion! Of course you're a Septimontian!

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Most definitely. The Champion is the Septimontian who represents our values!

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: We have all lived through Septimont's past hardships, and now this magnificent city bastion stands as a testament to our glorious future.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Ta-da...Ta-daaa....

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: How did this little one end up lost here? I'll take it back home.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Champion, you'd know Common Echoes are treasured in Rinascita, but did you know that ever since gladiatorial combat became popular here, they've also become an irreplaceable part of Septimont's history?

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Woe betide anyone who mistreats them. Anyway, help me snap a picture of Septimont City.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Our last stop without question is the <color=Highlight>Colosseum Olymdos</color>!

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: But first, I need to take Ta-da back to the Village of Respite. Catch you later!

speaker: NPC #850025
anh_en: I knew she felt a career in history—wait. Does she know I'm following her?
Those stories she told were for you to hear.

speaker: NPC #850025
anh_en: Those stories... about Septimont's history?

speaker: NPC #850025
anh_en: Hmm... I see. Champion, may I continue following Postumia? And please, don't tell her we spoke.

speaker: NPC #850025
anh_en: I need some time to think, and I'd like to finish her journey with you.

speaker: NPC #850025
anh_en: Thank you for your hard work.
I knew you were tailing us this whole time.

speaker: NPC #850025
anh_en: It's hard to keep secrets from the Champion, but I was so worried about my daughter, I had to find her. I'm sorry she took you on a walking history course.

speaker: NPC #850025
anh_en: Nevertheless, now that you've seen Postumia in action, you must admit it'd be a waste if she doesn't step into the arena.

speaker: NPC #850025
anh_en: She who loves Septimont so much would best leave her mark on its history as a Gladiator.
I wasn't the only one she took around Septimont.
Haven't you paid any attention to her feelings?

speaker: NPC #850025
anh_en: Not the only one? You mean—she knew I was following her?

speaker: NPC #850025
anh_en: Septimont's history... Postumia... a historian...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Why can't you understand what it means to be a Gladiator of Septimont?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Why can't you understand what I'm trying to accomplish?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Postumia, I'm starting to see why it's important to preserve Septimont's history.

speaker: NPC #850025
anh_en: Greetings, Champion. The two of you did an entire lap around Septimont. Good work.
A Gladiator is free to do what they want.
Being a Gladiator is more flexible than you imagine.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Free...? Champion, you are right, a Gladiator has the freedom of choice!

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: So... I should be a Gladiator?

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Oh, I get it. You're telling me the path of a Gladiator isn't a be-all and end-all.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: I can be a Gladiator, and much more.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: I can be a Gladiator-historian!

speaker: NPC #850025
anh_en: Postumia... does this mean you'll keep up with gladiatorial training?

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Yes, if I can do well at both, why should I give up on one?

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Though the path may be arduous, we Septimontians tackle challenges head-on. It's what we do, right, Champion?
Oh, how we soared across the land.
Yes, warrior-scholar!
You're already an excellent Gladiator.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Hehe, you're right! Maybe I'll even become the talk of Septimont. If I do step into the arena, you'd better cheer for me!

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Wow, if you put it like that, I might get too big for my britches. You'd better cheer for me when I step into the arena!

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: In any case, Champion, again, you have my gratitude.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Thank you for accompanying me to all the places I wanted to visit, and thank you for helping me to find the path forward.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Let's take one last photo of the Colosseum. May the glory and applause which echo within their walls always be with you.
It's a fruitful voyage of knowledge.

speaker: NPC #850025
anh_en: Still, I must sincerely thank you, especially for the photos you captured and the stories Postumia shared. I never realized the richness of Septimont's history before.

speaker: NPC #850025
anh_en: Every Septimontian knows about those hard years, but what Postumia said about recording our "future" so that it may become the "past" which our descendants will look up to—that truly moved me.

speaker: NPC #850025
anh_en: Her talents go beyond fighting. If being a historian brings her joy, then I must support her.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: But… Father, I now understand that being a Gladiator carries with it the warrior spirit of Septimont.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Along the way, I've realized how passionate the people of Septimont are for their Gladiators. I can't just abandon the path now.

speaker: NPC #850025
anh_en: The changes in me and Postumia wouldn't have been possible without your help. So, do you think she ought to be a Gladiator or a historian?

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Crying at your age? Come on, your old supporters would be embarrassed if they saw you like this.

speaker: NPC #850025
anh_en: I'm... I'm just very happy.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: To reach the <color=Highlight>Statue of Fabius the Hero</color>, we must first cross this sea. It's not a short trip, so let's set out now!
Yes, let's get going.
I need some time to prepare.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: You're... {PlayerName}, the Gladiator who took the champion's crown with contender Lupa!

speaker: NPC #850025
anh_en: But as I said, perhaps you can persuade her. The title of Champion means a lot to the Septimontians, I believe it means a lot to Postumia as well.

speaker: NPC #850025
anh_en: Every time we argue, she storms off to <color=Highlight>Titanbone Expanse</color> to sulk. I'll message you the coordinates.
You're not going to look for her?
Don't you worry something could happen to her?

speaker: NPC #850025
anh_en: I admit, I often bring up the subject of Gladiators with her, which is why it's not uncommon for Postumia to storm off.

speaker: NPC #850025
anh_en: I could go find her, but that would just make things worse. I should give her some time to calm down.

speaker: NPC #850025
anh_en: Although Postumia does not want to become a Gladiator, she undoubtedly possesses the skills of one. A fact which makes me regret her choice even more.

speaker: NPC #850025
anh_en: If she could fully commit herself to gladiatorial training, the result would be spectacular.

speaker: NPC #850025
anh_en: My rewards may be a trifle for the Champion, but I will still do my best to offer you something for the effort. I just hope Postumia gets back on the right path.
And if she insists she doesn't want to be a Gladiator?
Indeed, 'tis I.

speaker: NPC #850025
anh_en: Then I will try other ways. I pray she'll come around one day and accept the honor.
I won't force her.
I want to hear her side of the story too.

speaker: NPC #850025
anh_en: Understood. Whatever you say, your words will leave a lasting impression on her. After all, you are the Champion of Septimont.
What are you arguing about?

speaker: NPC #850025
anh_en: I'm Nicus. Forgive my boldness, but you've arrived at just the right time.

speaker: NPC #850025
anh_en: As Champion, you must know what it means to be a Gladiator of Septimont. I hope you can persuade her.

speaker: NPC #850025
anh_en: I once was a Gladiator too. After retiring, I hoped my daughter, Postumia, would carry my mantle, but she's always—

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: I don't want to be a Gladiator! There's no point in talking about it!
Postumia makes a face at her father, runs into a crowd, and vanishes.

speaker: NPC #850025
anh_en: Apologies, I didn't mean for you to see this. Whenever I bring this up with her, it always ends in a quarrel.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Postumia will be an outstanding Gladiator. Please help her on the path, Champion!

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Oh, it's you.... Sorry, I flew off the handle.
Because you're naturally talented.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Yes, I know. Like I said, I have immense respect for Gladiators. But I don't want to be one.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: As a child, I was captivated by the turbulent history of Septimont. I hoped every visitor here could learn of that difficult and bloody, yet glorious period in time, which embodied the unyielding spirit of our people!

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: If only Father would realize—

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Wait, maybe he can! If I can collate all the historical sights of Septimont into one book and show it to Father, he'd understand!

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Look at where we are now. <color=Highlight>Titanbone Expanse</color> is where Septimontians first made landfall.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Stone pillars stand tall here. Rocky outcrops dot the land. Our ancestors felt perfectly at home and in tune with this rugged terrain.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: That is why I come when I'm upset. To gaze at the wilderness and channel the joy that must have surged from our ancestors when they ended their wandering to set foot on this land. In these moments, I feel as if the past is encouraging me.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: How about it? Will you help me take pictures so I can finish my book?  After all, you are our Champion.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Heh, like father like daughter...)

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: I hope you understand. Even though I don't want to be a Gladiator, I've always respected them, especially Champion Gladiators like yourself.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Let me reintroduce myself. I am Postumia, Septimont's official historian in waiting!
Official historian?
So you don't want to be a Gladiator?

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Yup, I want to record the annals of Septimont's history and pass them on to future generations.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: He told you to come here, right? I'm sorry he dragged you into this mess.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: See, in the beginning, I thought I could just go through the motions of training, and eventually tell him that I don't like his plans.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: But then he piled on more training sessions, and got it into his head that the Gladiator's path was the only one for me.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Wow, that's a brilliant shot, I bet you'd also be Champion in any photography contest!
I'm an expert of all trades.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: See, that confidence would put anyone's doubts to rest. Let's head off now!

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Next stop, <color=Highlight>Border Mountains</color>!

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: I can be your local guide and tell you all about the history of Septimont. I promise won't get bored on your journey.
Just as you're about to follow Postumia, a loud noise snaps from behind. You turn to catch a blurry sight of a burly figure vanishing into the shadows.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: What's the matter?
Nothing.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (This is going to be interesting.)

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Foul tide drowns the peaks, and the great dragon wails in sorrow, pale and withered, it shrouds the land. I read that in a book written by our ancestors. It recounts their discovery of the Ashen Dragon's Crypt.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Hehe, being praised by a Champion from afar... I can't help but feel a little embarrassed.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: We built the Vale of Glory to honor the heroes who were felled by the Dark Tide. And neither will we forget the great dragons that were lost to the darkness.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: For we share this world with dragons. We must remember they once held great power worthy of respect, and let their demise serve as a warning.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Let's leave it at that for now, I want to capture the sacrifice of the Border Mountains in this picture.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: And now... we'll head to the <color=Highlight>Mournfell Canyon</color>, it's somewhat of a dangerous place, but nothing we can't handle!

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: You know, we Septimontians like to speak of strength and struggle since they have shaped our history up to modern times.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: The dragon before us once nested up in the Border Mountains. When it spread its wings, it blotted out the sky, and its roar was powerful enough to shake the entire island. No one ever questioned its strength.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: But after the Dark Tide washed over it. All that's left is nothing but their remains...
Septimont will not share their fate.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Of course not! Even when the Dark Tide engulfed Septimont, the waves eventually dashed against the towering, immovable Border Mountains.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: The mountains halted the Dark Tide, but the tide eroded its facade into that ghastly pale shape. Thus, Septimont was spared.

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Can you feel it? In times of crisis, not only will the people of Septimont fight to protect this land, but the very land itself will rise to face the menace.
That's what makes Septimont so special.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: How terrifying. What must they have felt, caught in the Dark Tide?

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Oh no....

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Hang in there! We're here to help!
You notice that the burly figure, so eager to leap into battle moments ago, has run off after the fight.

speaker: NPC #850027
anh_en: An actual Champion is giving me training advice. Understood, I must start with the fundamentals!

speaker: NPC #850027
anh_en: Since you're both Gladiators, like me, I bet you're all amazed at the sights here.

speaker: NPC #850027
anh_en: I only had to deal with the aftermath of the Dark Tide, and that left me exhausted. To think our heroes back then had to face it head-on while also ensuring the survival of Septimont.

speaker: NPC #850027
anh_en: As a present-day Septimontian, I have nothing but respect and admiration for them.

speaker: NPC #850027
anh_en: I hope I can rise to the occasion as a true warrior in times of crisis. I'm sure you feel the same, don't you?

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: I... yes, of course!

speaker: NPC #850026
anh_en: Well, Champion, it's time to photograph the corruption of the Mournfell Canyon brought on by the Dark Tide. Next, we must stop by the <color=Highlight>Statue of Fabius the Hero</color>.

speaker: NPC #850027
anh_en: Phew. Hello, I'm Kastus. I fought these things from the outskirts all the way here. I'm spent, luckily you two were able to lend me a hand.
This place is dangerous.

speaker: NPC #850027
anh_en: Yes, I understand. As you can see, the Dark Tide left many monstrosities in the Mournfell Canyon.

speaker: NPC #850027
anh_en: But where there are challenges, there will always be Gladiators like me who'll come to hone our fighting skills.

speaker: NPC #850027
anh_en: But I think I might have overestimated my abilities. Your form in combat showed me I have much room for improvement.
Stick around and learn buddy!
Start each day with 100 push-ups.

speaker: NPC #850027
anh_en: I've watched your match with contender Lupa so many times that I've memorized every blow. But seeing you fight in person is a real eye-opener.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Hello, Rover.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: The system has recognized that you have embarked on a unique journey, with your own companions and narrative.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: As previously instructed, I will set up a test for you in the Jinzhou wilderness.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Once you pass the test, a key to the unknown will reveal itself to you.
Who are you?
What test?

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: I promise to stand by you unwaveringly as you begin your journey, and as you grow stronger, I will grant you access to more keys to unravel the mysteries that lie ahead.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: There are countless unexplored parts of the world waiting for you, and I hope you’re prepared to embrace the unknown.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: I wish you a pleasant journey.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Hello, Rover.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: The system has identified multiple references to you in various folk tales, and your adventure continues.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: As previously instructed, I will set up a test for you in the Jinzhou wilderness.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Once you pass the test, a key to the unknown will reveal itself to you.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Wishing you success on your test and may your travel go smoothly.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Hello, Rover.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: The system has concluded that you have explored this realm and honed your physical and mental capabilities.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: As instructed, I will set up a test for you in the Jinzhou wilderness.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Once you pass the test, a key to the unknown will reveal itself to you.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: The responses you provide could potentially shape the future of SOL-3.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: I hope you will enjoy your journey.
