speaker: NPC #900105
anh_en: Honored guest from afar, I am relieved to finally see you.

speaker: NPC #900105
anh_en: I'm asking for your assistance in dealing with these shadows, and rest assured, you'll be well compensated.
Leave it to me.

speaker: NPC #900105
anh_en: I entrust this task to you, and I shall await your triumph here.

speaker: NPC #900105
anh_en: I'm afraid it's not right to burden you with such a troublesome matter, but I can't think of anyone else capable of handling it.
So what happened?
Heh, lucky for you, you came to the right person.

speaker: NPC #900105
anh_en: This isn't as complicated as it seems.

speaker: NPC #900105
anh_en: I knew you would be willing to help.

speaker: NPC #900105
anh_en: Recently, my family entrusted me with managing an ancestral site, where a handed-down "Terminal" still remains.

speaker: NPC #900105
anh_en: This thing... it has a certain malevolence to it, you understand?

speaker: NPC #900105
anh_en: Shadowy monsters frequently emerge from within, causing chaos before disappearing on their own.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (Something's off here. Traces of the Dark Tide's power linger...)
Investigate the corrupted Terminal

speaker: NPC #900104
anh_en: Hello, one who has passed the trial.

speaker: NPC #900104
anh_en: I don't know what kind of person you are, but your strength is undeniable, among the world's finest.

speaker: NPC #900104
anh_en: Drawing on the mechanics of the Thorncrown Rises and the Remnant Energy within Nimbus Sanctum, I have recreated powerful frequencies from various dimensions.

speaker: NPC #900104
anh_en: To amplify these frequencies to the necessary strength, we even risked harnessing the power of the Dark Tide.

speaker: NPC #900104
anh_en: We have taken on the job from Fisalia, exerting great effort and even collaborating with those from the Order, all to harness these "phantoms of salvation" and bring forth a true "savior."

speaker: NPC #900104
anh_en: Savior, no matter which family you hail from, we have prepared a generous welcome gift for you!

speaker: NPC #900104
anh_en: The "Savior's Proof," obtainable only here and forged into crest coins from the wealth of Fisalia, will bring you endless riches!

speaker: NPC #900104
anh_en: To obtain them, you must become stronger and embrace continuous challenges!

speaker: NPC #900104
anh_en: I await here, eagerly anticipating the emergence of the "Savior"!

speaker: NPC #900105
anh_en: You've returned, Victor! How did it go?

speaker: NPC #900105
anh_en: I have personal matters to attend to, so I'll take my leave for now.
Botim left, weighed down by his worries.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (He really seems unaware... It's probably best not to tell him.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I'm on it. Just a few dangerous monsters left to handle, but I'll see it through.

speaker: NPC #900105
anh_en: I'm... I'm not sure how to express my gratitude... but truly, thank you so much!

speaker: NPC #900105
anh_en: I'm not going to lie, they've entrusted this place to me, but I truly don't know how to handle that Terminal.
Tell him honestly.
It's better not to tell him.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (He genuinely seems unaware... Should I tell him the truth?)
You told Botim everything the phantom revealed...

speaker: NPC #900105
anh_en: It all makes sense now... So that's what it is... Yes, I understand.

speaker: NPC #900105
anh_en: Esteemed Savior, thank you for sharing the truth with me.

speaker: NPC #900105
anh_en: Certainly, anything you gain from the Terminal is well-deserved. If you wish, you may proceed to the Terminal at any time to undertake the trials.

speaker: NPC #700211
anh_en: Hello there, fellow student. Welcome to the Academy's virtual training platform. Interested to know more?

speaker: NPC #700211
anh_en: Oh! You wish to give it a spin? It's easy. All you have to do is sit in this simulator cockpit, and you're good to go.

speaker: NPC #700211
anh_en: And no need to be nervous, even if it's your first try. Just start off from a low difficulty and steadily move your way up.

speaker: NPC #700211
anh_en: Well, good luck!
Training platform?
What's this for?

speaker: NPC #700211
anh_en: This is a virtual combat course co-developed by the Rabelle College faculty, students, and engineers. It's to test the combat capabilities of students in extreme environments.

speaker: NPC #700211
anh_en: The Rabelle College serves as the birthplace for Synchronists. In addition to various Exostrider training, personal fitness is also a crucial factor taken into consideration!

speaker: NPC #700211
anh_en: We've gathered data from across various regions and managed to simulate highly formidable frequencies that have appeared all over the world!

speaker: NPC #700211
anh_en: We've also set in place a comprehensive evaluation system. Bring our combat results to department instructors and earn rewards!
That's interesting.
Where do I start?

speaker: NPC #700211
anh_en: So, how was it? Did the simulation go well for you?

speaker: NPC #700211
anh_en: Speaking of which, it's been years since someone managed to complete all the training objectives across every difficulty level... Which is before I was even a student here, at least.

speaker: NPC #700211
anh_en: Doesn't hurt to try it out. And I don't know why, but I feel like you've got loads of potential!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I'll come back for more runs once I get the chance.
Piece of cake.
Haven't had the time yet...

speaker: NPC #700211
anh_en: Let's see your results... Amazing! You managed to achieve such a high score on your first try!

speaker: NPC #700211
anh_en: I haven't met you before at the Rabelle College. Are you a freshman? We don't get to see such incredible freshmen very often!

speaker: NPC #700211
anh_en: We also had a new kid with crazy combat results before. What was her name again... Ae... Aemeath? It's a shame she only came here once, and I never got to see her again...

speaker: NPC #700211
anh_en: All good! You can give it a try some other time!

speaker: NPC #700211
anh_en: You know where to find me.

speaker: NPC #700211
anh_en: Every training record you produce becomes a valuable asset of the Rabelle College.

speaker: Thanh Cung
anh_en: Rover, excuse me.

speaker: Thanh Cung
anh_en: But nothing happened when I tried to touch the projection. My hand slid through it. It’s likely because I’m not a Resonator.

speaker: Thanh Cung
anh_en: So, I was wondering if I could ask you to investigate these pedestals in person. What do you think?
Leave it to me.

speaker: Thanh Cung
anh_en: Great, I’ll send you the coordinates. Thank you, Rover!

speaker: Thanh Cung
anh_en: When you are exploring outside, have you seen some pedestals with strange projections?
I’ve seen them.
Never saw anything like that.
Nice, saves me a lot of explaining.
No worries, let me explain.

speaker: Thanh Cung
anh_en: While researching, I stumbled upon these weird round pedestals with holographic projections.

speaker: Thanh Cung
anh_en: The circuit design was pretty strange. Apparently, they’re called an Imitative Sonic Device according to the records.

speaker: Thanh Cung
anh_en: I’ve always been curious about these devices, so I made a special trip just to check them out.

speaker: Thanh Cung
anh_en: The air temperature is comfortable, and the humidity level is…
About those pedestals...

speaker: Thanh Cung
anh_en: Have you investigated those pedestals? How did it go? Wait, what? They let you fight simulated monsters?

speaker: Thanh Cung
anh_en: I see... Now I can understand.

speaker: Thanh Cung
anh_en: The Court of Savantae probably created these pedestals to study dangerous Tacet Discords.

speaker: Thanh Cung
anh_en: Researchers can learn more about those Tacet Discords by studying data from simulated battles.

speaker: Thanh Cung
anh_en: Thank you for your help! By the way, I recently found a couple more of these pedestals.

speaker: Thanh Cung
anh_en: I’ll send you the coordinates. If you’re still interested, go check them out.

speaker: Thanh Cung
anh_en: Who knows, they might help you on your journey!

speaker: NPC #700994
anh_en: Fantastic work. Oh, no matter how many times I see it, watching the Route Constructor build roads always gets me thrilled.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Why keep this outdated Route Constructor around?

speaker: NPC #700994
anh_en: Well, how can I put it... rationality and rigor are essential qualities for us researchers, but what often propels us forward is a streak of romantic imagination.

speaker: NPC #700994
anh_en: When this Route Constructor was produced, every researcher present cheered for it. We knew it would become a vital asset for fieldwork in Lahai-Roi.

speaker: NPC #700994
anh_en: Now the newer Route Constructors are everywhere, playing exactly the role we hoped they would.

speaker: NPC #700994
anh_en: But this is our very first unit... We just can't bring ourselves to have it locked up inside a warehouse.

speaker: NPC #700994
anh_en: I mean, it takes a bit of extra effort, but it still works just fine, doesn't it? Haha.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (This must be the Route Constructor Rakosan was talking about.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (I don't see the researcher he mentioned. Hmmm… I'll have a look on the Route Constructor first.)

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: {PlayerName}, you need clearance before you can boot up the Route Constructor. And you're in luck, the person in charge of the route network is right over there working maintenance on it.

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: His name is Chonglin. Go talk to him, he'll update your clearance and show you how to use the Route Constructor.

speaker: NPC #100157
anh_en: Once you've gained access, you can start rebuilding the route network. That'll be a huge help to the Spacetrek Observatory, and it'll make getting around Lahai-Roi much easier for you as well.

speaker: NPC #700994
anh_en: But this Constructor before us is special. It was the very first Route Constructor ever put into use, so the materials it requires have to be custom-made.

speaker: NPC #700994
anh_en: I was hauling those materials earlier today when a Sabercat Prowler suddenly swooped down on me. You know how they can turn invisible...

speaker: NPC #700994
anh_en: But strangely enough, it didn't come after me. It just flipped my ride, stole the materials, and took off. I hid until it was gone.

speaker: NPC #700994
anh_en: I'm guessing the materials acted like fuel to Exoswarm contaminated by the Threnodian, or maybe the contamination altered their properties somehow.

speaker: NPC #700994
anh_en: That's not my field, though. You'd have to ask the Department of Voidmatters for the details.

speaker: NPC #700994
anh_en: Anyway, I need you to track down that contaminated Sabercat Prowler and get those custom materials back.

speaker: NPC #700994
anh_en: I'm counting on you to retrieve my Purified Mechanite and Refined Compressed Bedrock!
The Route Constructor can't start due to insufficient materials. Just then, a researcher comes running towards you from the other side of the hill.

speaker: NPC #700994
anh_en: Oh? You must be {PlayerName}? Rakosan already told me about you.

speaker: NPC #700994
anh_en: You're a real lifesaver—you gave us the chance to rebuild the Spacetrek Observatory. And honestly, I could really use your help now.

speaker: NPC #700994
anh_en: I actually came fully prepared to teach you how to operate the Route Constructor, but I hit a bit of a snag.

speaker: NPC #700994
anh_en: You see, to power up a Route Constructor, you need three materials:\nMechanite and Condensed Bedrock as the raw components, plus a Constructor Core as the energy source.

speaker: NPC #700994
anh_en: You might already have some on you, but without clearance, you still can't activate the Route Constructor, can you?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (There it is, the contaminated Sabercat Prowler…)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (It got the Refined Compressed Bedrock in its mouth… The Purified Mechanite it took should be nearby. I'll have to take a look around.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (That shine… this must be the Purified Mechanite.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (It's buried between these Rimewisps. I should clear them out and collect everything.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I've got both materials. Time to head back and talk to Chonglin.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: {PlayerName}! Are you okay?

speaker: NPC #700994
anh_en: {PlayerName}! Are you okay?
All good. Anything wrong?

speaker: NPC #700994
anh_en: Oh, nothing. I was just worried you might be hurt. Sabercat Prowlers are considered apex predators among the Exoswarm, after all.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I'm fine. Thanks for checking. Here's everything you asked for.

speaker: NPC #700994
anh_en: Oh, this is it! You must've gone through a lot to find these, huh?

speaker: NPC #700994
anh_en: But don't worry, every other Route Constructor is a newer model.

speaker: NPC #700994
anh_en: You'll only need standard Mechanite, Compressed Bedrock, and regular Constructor Cores to activate those.

speaker: NPC #700994
anh_en: Alright, I'm handing this boosted Constructor Core and the rest of the materials to you. You should be the one to activate the Route Constructor!

Aemeath can switch between her human and mech form by casting Resonance Skill.
Use <color=#ffd12f>Counterattacks</color> and <color=#ffd12f>Dodge Counters</color> to interrupt enemy actions.

Most of your enemy's moves can be blocked with <color=#ffd12f>Counterattacks</color>. Frequently use Counterattacks to reduce the enemy's Vibration Strength and put it into an <color=#ffd12f>Immobilized</color> state.

When the Impermanence Heron raises its wings to protect its head, it will enter a defensive state. Use the Intro Skill to reduce its Vibration Strength, putting it in an <color=#ffd12f>Immobilized</color> state.
When Inferno Rider casts its charge, you can use the <color=#ffd12f>special Echo</color> to defend. Successful defense will put it in a <color=#ffd12f>Immobilized</color> state.
You can avoid ground shock attacks by getting to a higher ground.

When Lampylumen Myriad is in the air, you can attack the <color=#ffd12f>Ice Chrysalises</color> on the ground to shoot it down. Your <color=#ffd12f>Freeze Meter</color> will grow as you are exposed to the attacks of Lampylumen Myriad, the attacks of the Ice Chrysalises, and the fog on the ground. When your Freeze Meter is filled, you will be <color=#ffd12f>Frozen</color>.
The grab attacks deal massive damage. Use <color=#ffd12f>Counterattacks</color> to block the grab attacks.
After taking a certain amount of damage, Mech Abomination shapeshifts and releases a powerful attack.

<color=#ffd12f>Destroy the legs, head, and the ancient bell</color> to greatly deplete its Vibration Strength. Using <color=#ffd12f>Counterattacks</color> against the giant ice balls will also greatly deplete its Vibration Strength, <color=#ffd12f>but it's not an easy task to achieve</color>.

After absorbing the <color=#ffd12f>Prisms</color> of different attributes, the Heron will <color=#ffd12f>recover all its HP</color> and enter the <color=#ffd12f>enpowered state</color> of the corresponding attribute. The enhanced Heron will launch fiercer attacks.

After absorbing the <color=#ffd12f>Prisms</color> of different attributes, the Heron will <color=#ffd12f>recover all its HP</color> and enter the <color=#ffd12f>enpowered state</color> of the corresponding attribute. The enhanced Heron will launch fiercer attacks.

After entering the berserk state, it will gain a shield and <color=#ffd12f>great DMG Reduction</color>. When the <color=#ffd12f>shield</color> is destroyed, its Vibration Strength will be greatly depleted.
When the Roseshroom enters the charging state, target the <color=#ffd12f>core at its head</color> with <color=#ffd12f>Pistols</color> to greatly deplete its Vibration Strength.
The Hoochief Cyclone can generate a wind field to restrict the movement of Resonators.
The Autopuppet Scout can generate an ice wall to block ranged attacks from Resonators.

The Fusion Prism is immune to <color=#ffd12f>Fusion</color> DMG. It provides a buff for surrounding enemies, which greatly increases the damage they deal.\nThe Fusion Prism can be absorbed by Cyan-Feathered Herons and Violet-Feathered Herons, providing a permanent damage bonus for the Herons after absorption.

The Glacio Prism is immune to <color=#ffd12f>Glacio</color> DMG. It provides a buff for surrounding enemies, which grant them Super Armor (their moves won't be interrupted when hit).\nThe Glacio Prism can be absorbed by Cyan-Feathered Herons and Violet-Feathered Herons, providing a permanent Super Armor state for the Herons after absorption.

The Spectro Prism is immune to <color=#ffd12f>Spectro</color> DMG. It provides a buff for surrounding enemies, which periodically grants them a shield.\nThe Spectro Prism can be absorbed by Cyan-Feathered Herons and Violet-Feathered Herons, providing a permanent shield for the Herons after absorption.

The Havoc Prism is immune to <color=#ffd12f>Havoc</color> DMG. It provides a buff for surrounding enemies, which allows them to deplete Resonators' Resonance Energy with their attacks.\nThe Havoc Prism can be absorbed by Cyan-Feathered Herons and Violet-Feathered Herons, providing a permanent Energy Depletion effect for the Herons after absorption.
When an Excarat burrows underground, you can use <color=#ffd12f>Plunging Attacks</color> to force it to surface.
The Traffic Illuminator can put Resonators in a <color=#ffd12f>stagnant</color> state.

Some special enemies on Solaris-3 are exceptionally violent and <color=#ffd12f>hard to defeat</color>. Utilize <color=#ffd12f>Counterattacks</color>, <color=#ffd12f>Dodge Counters</color> or <color=#ffd12f>Intro Skills</color> to deal meaningful damage to them.\nIt's worth noting that these special enemies do not grow stronger with your SOL Phase. If they are hard to beat now, consider leveling up your characters and try again later.\nThese special enemies will <color=#ffd12f>regenerate</color> sometime after being defeated.

The solid scales of the Lumiscale Construct form a protective barrier that reduces all incoming damage when active.\nThe Lumiscale Construct's core is exposed <color=#ffd12f>after each attack</color> and when it is <color=#ffd12f>immobilized</color>. Attack the Lumiscale Construct at this time to deal damage to it effectively.
Phase 1. Jinhsi can't move normally during Time Stop. In this situation, use the <color=#ffd12f>Stellar Movement Points</color> generated by Sentinel Jué to move.

When an enemy uses their <color=#ffd12f>Overclocking Skill</color>, a special cross-shaped <color=#ffd12f>warning</color> will appear. During this state, the enemy's resistance to interruption will be enhanced. Stay focused and avoid attacks.
Fae Ignis explodes when defeated, damaging nearby targets. This effect won't be triggered if it's defeated <color=#ffd12f>in mid-air</color>.
Chop Chop: Headless attacks with laser beams, which can be blocked with <color=#ffd12f>Counterattacks</color>.\nSuccessful Counterattacks deal great DMG to Chop Chop: Headless.
Chest Mimic can be instantly defeated by <color=#ffd12f>Counterattacks</color>.
Cuddle Wuddle can team up with Diggy Duggy, Hocus Pocus, or Lottie Lost to perform combo attacks.

In defense mode, the Sentry Construct gains high DMG Reduction and slowly restores its Vibration Strength. <color=#ffd12f>Attacking it from behind</color> disables its defense mode.\nIf attacked while in mid-air, it loses more Vibration Strength and becomes easier to immobilize.
Lorelei summons special water balls that float toward her. These water balls grant buffs when absorbed by Lorelei or the active Resonator.
Hecate's whip is an extension of herself and can be blocked with <color=#ffd12f>Counterattacks</color>.
Chop Chop: Leftless/Rightless are invulnerable until Chop Chop: Headless is Immobilized.
When Chop Chop: Headless combines with a windmill, their attacks can be Counterattacked using <color=#ffd12f>Questless Knight's Echo Skill</color>, dealing great DMG.
This Tacet Discord enters a defensive state when its Vibration Strength is low. Attack it by then to <color=#ffd12f>Break its hand defense</color> and <color=#ffd12f>immobilize</color> it.

The Aero Prism is immune to <color=#ffd12f>Aero</color> DMG.

It targets a nearby ally, granting itself a constant buff that enables it to keep attacking. Once the selected target is defeated, the Aero Prism ceases attacking.

The Aero Prism can be absorbed by Cyan-Feathered Herons and Violet-Feathered Herons, providing a permanent buff for the Herons after the absorption.

Sagittario's unique tracking arrow marks the Resonator for a certain duration after hitting them.
 
While the marker is active, Sagittario will fire a tracking arrow at the Resonator whenever they take damage.
 
Switching Resonators removes this marker.

Sacerdos can form a link with allied enemies. 

When linked enemies take damage, a wind field is generated that repels nearby Resonators. The wind field has a delay between triggers.

The same enemy cannot be linked by multiple Sacerdos.
Resonators' attacks can reflect the halbard illusions and light arcs from the Lioness of Glory back at it to deal damage to the Lioness of Glory.
When Kerasaur recovers from being Immobilized, it will be highly resistant to whichever Attribute DMG it took the most before this Immobilization.
When the Pilgrim's Shell is Immobilized. Use <color=#ffd12f>Hero's Slash</color> to instantly defeat it.
Gladiators will summon Echoes to aid them at the start of the fight.\nWhen a Gladiator is defeated, so too is their Echo.

When Cartethyia casts <color=#ffd12f>Resonance Skill, Heavy Attack, or the final stage of a Basic Attack</color>, she will summon Sword of Virtue's Shadow, Sword of Discord's Shadow, and Sword of Divinity's Shadow.

Cartethyia can recall these three Sword Shadows when performing a <color=#ffd12f>Plunging Attack</color> to increase the DMG dealt by this attack. 

Recalling the Sword Shadows also grants the corresponding <color=Highlight>Heart of Virtue</color>, <color=Highlight>Power of Discord</color>, and <color=Highlight>Mandate of Divinity</color>, which enhance Cartethyia when she turns into Fleurdelys.

Fenrico may cast Holy Summon to summon Divine Envoys at his command and start channeling Retribution.\nWhen Fenrico casts Holy Summon, Phrolova will charge up to counter the incoming Retribution.\nDefeating the Divine Envoys ensures that Prolova's charge-up remains uninterrupted and allows her to generate a Remnant Field that defends Resonators inside against Retribution. After Retribution ends, Phrolova will counter Fenrico, lowering his vibration strength.
If the Remnant Field could not be generated, Retribution will deal massive amounts of damage to any active Resonator.

Upon casting Resonance Liberation, Cartethyia turns into Fleurdelys and unlocks new moves.\n\nFleurdelys's attacks restore Conviction. When Conviction is full, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Liberation again to cast Blade of Howling Squall, dealing massive DMG.
When Hyvatia opens its Eye of Prediction, it observes and records Resonators' Dodges and Counterattacks.\nAfterwards, Hyvatia's next attack cannot be Dodged or Counterattacked.

After attacking or taking Counterattacks several times, a Vulnerable Core will be exposed on Reactor Husk's left arm. Attacking the exposed core will destroy Reactor Husk's armor, rendering it unable to attack.
Reactor Husk's special ranged attack, Cinder Cut, can be deflected back, dealing damage to the Reactor Husk and reducing its Vibration Strength.
Twin Nova: Collapsar Blade and Twin Nova: Nebulous Cannon take more DMG for a certain period of time after being hit by Tune Break.
The mechanical horns on its head can be damaged by Counterattacks. Successfully breaking the horns will reduce its attack power and range.
The mechanical antlers on the Mining Reindeer's head can be damaged by Counterattacks. Successfully breaking the antlers will reduce its attack power.
The Mining Reindeer's pulse beam can be deflected to deal damage to itself.
The mechanical antlers on the Flora Reindeer's head can be damaged by Counterattacks. Successfully breaking the antlers will reduce its attack power.
Dreamless will unleash Twilight Eve after entering Looming Turmoil. Reduce Dreamless's Vibration Strength to below 50% to interrupt the channeling of Twilight Eve.

Dreamless enters the Looming Turmoil state upon recovering from the Immoblization for the first time. During this state, Dreamless sends out deflectable Halberd of Destruction and Vectors of Ruin, which reduces Dreamless's Vibration Strength if successfully deflected. Dodging Halberd of Destruction and Vectors of Ruin cannot trigger Successful Dodges.
Hitting Spacetrek Explorer with Tune Break disables its shield generator, removing its active Shield and preventing new ones from generating.

Sabercat Prowler lacks vision and relies on dodgeable frequency waves to locate enemies.\nBefore locating an enemy's position, Sabercat Prowler will not actively attack and periodically emit positioning frequency waves to locate the enemy. Once an enemy is located, Sabercat Prowler will initiate an attack and continue emitting positioning frequency waves to track the enemy's movements.
Hitting Sabercat Prowler with Tune Break forces it out of Invisibility.

Sigillum gains a stack of Off Course when hit by Echo Skill, stacking up to 5 times. Echoes with the same name can only trigger this effect once.\nEach stack of Off Course makes Sigillum take 10% more total DMG. At 5 stacks, the total DMG taken is increased by another 30%.

The Nameless Explorer ascends into the sky, preparing to cast Reckoning of Stars.\nUse the stars on the battlefield to move to the upper platform, then use the Grapple to pull down the shadow of the fallen space station and interrupt the skill.

While in Tune Strain – Shifting, the Nameless Explorer gains an additional stack of Tune Strain – Interfered when hit by Tune Break.\nResonators can inflict up to 2 additional stacks of Tune Strain - Interfered on the Nameless Explorer.\nEach Tune Strain stack further increases the total DMG it takes by 4%.

After remaining in combat for a period of time, they will enter the Rage Feather state and be enhanced.
When hit by Tune Break, they will exit the Rage Feather state.
If they are hit by Tune Break while in Tune Rupture - Shifting, their All-Attribute RES is greatly reduced.
Successfully performing a Counterattack can damage their crest and wings, weakening their attacks and reducing the number of ranged projectiles.
Glommoth's left tusk can be damaged. Once broken, Glommoth will lose some of its combat abilities.

When Glommoth enters combat, it gains Frost Armor, which grants additional resistance.\nWhen Fusion Burst on it reaches 3 stacks, Glommoth will lose the Frost Armor, along with the extra resistance it provides.
Use Rover: Spectro's Resonance Liberation - Echoing Orchestra to break Nightmare: Adam Smasher's Sandevistan time-slowing effect and restore the flow of time.
Upon reaching certain Union Levels, you need to complete <color=#ffd12f>SOL3 Phase Ascension Quests</color> to lift the <color=#ffd12f>Union Level cap</color>.

Each Tacet Field has a unique special buff.\nThe Tacet Field located in the Central Plains periodically generates a Concerto Energy Sphere, which recovers Concerto Energy and deals <color=#ffd12f>AoE DMG</color> after you cast <color=#ffd12f>Intro Skill</color>.

A very small number of Tacet Discords with mutated appearances can be randomly found in the world of Solaris-3. They are known as "Phantoms" for their extreme rarity. Defeat them to unlock the corresponding Phantom Echoes with special <color=#ffd12f>Echo appearances</color>.

In Co-op Mode, when a <color=#ffd12f>party member</color>'s Concerto Energy is full, tap their icon to activate your Resonator's Intro Skill and their Resonator's Outro Skill. Full Concerto Energy will be automatically cleared after 10 seconds.\nEach party member can trigger this effect once.

The Tower of Adversity features four Zones: <color=#c19f51>Stable Zone</color>, <color=#c19f51>Experiment Zone</color>, <color=#c19f51>Hazard Zone</color>, and <color=#c19f51>Overdrive Zone.</color> Each Zone contains one to three Towers and each Tower has multiple Floors, each representing a unique challenge. Progress through the challenges to unlock new Towers and Zones. Clearing all challenges in a Zone unlocks the next Zone.

In the Tower of Adversity, clearing a challenge reduces participating Resonators' <color=#c19f51>Vigor</color> by a specific amount. Once a Resonator's Vigor is depleted, they can <color=#c19f51>no longer take part in new challenges</color>. Vigor does not restore over time, but you can use the [Reset] option on a Floor to recover the Vigor.
In the Tower of Adversity, environmental effects affect your combat tactics. Use them strategically to gain an advantage.

Crest Rewards in the Stable Zone, Experiment Zone, and Overdrive Zone can be claimed only once. However, the challenges in the Hazard Zone are <color=#c19f51>periodically reset</color>, along with your progression, bringing in new enemies, challenge goals, Area Effects, and rewards. Take on the challenges again to earn Crests and <color=#c19f51>claim fresh rewards.</color>

Complete the challenges and meet their challenge goals to obtain Crests. Collect a certain number of Crests to get various rewards, including Astrites and Hazard Records. Hazard Records can be exchanged for Phantom Echoes, Premium Tuners, and more at the Adversity Exchange.
In the Tower of Adversity, your skills are put to trial. Complete the specific challenge goals to earn your Crests. Collect enough Crests to earn hefty rewards.
A crafted collection of recorded music, which, when given to the Aria Mummer, adds the tracks to their collection list.

Visit the Aria Mummer to access the Archive of Melodies feature. Select a track in an album to play. You may set a selected track as the background music around Aria Mummer by enabling <color=#ffd12f>Set As Background Music</color>.

A remnant creature with an intense fixation on music. <color=#ffd12f>When struck</color>, it drops the Melody Box it has collected.\nDeliver the Melody Box to Aria Mummer to add the corresponding track to your collection list.
When steering a Gondola in Single Player mode, you can open the Cruise Share menu by pressing the <color=#ffd12f>Cruise Share button</color>.
On the Cruise Share menu, Rover can invite <color=#ffd12f>an obtained Resonator</color> to take the Gondola together.
You can steer the Gondola using movement controls. Use Dash to speed up.\nHold Exit to exit the steering mode.
Select a mask to wear it or take it off.
Check the obtained mask in your Backpack.

Negative Statuses include: <color=#ffd12f>Aero Erosion</color>, <color=#ffd12f>Electro Flare</color>, <color=#ffd12f>Spectro Frazzle</color>, <color=#ffd12f>Fusion Burst</color>, <color=#ffd12f>Glacio Chafe</color>, and <color=#ffd12f>Havoc Bane</color>.

A <color=#ffd12f>beacon</color> you once set for yourself, imbued with the strength and faith to keep moving forward.\n<color=#ffd12f>Rover: Spectro</color>'s abilities have been enhanced. Resonance Liberation <color=#ffd12f>Echoing Orchestra</color> and Resonance Skill <color=#ffd12f>Resonating Spin</color> now inflict <color=#ffd12f>Spectro Frazzle Effect</color> on the target while retaining their original effects.\nCheck the Resonator's Forte interface for more details.
A portable module for Synthesis integrated in <color=#ffd12f>Pangu Terminal</color>, developed by Huaxu Academy.\n\nCan be quickly accessed via <color=#ffd12f>Item Details</color> in your Backpack.
Go to Settings - Other to enable/disable Immersion Mode.
Upon enabling Immersion Mode, the UI icons and battle information on the HUD will be hidden, offering you an experience of complete immersion.
Familiar gateways are appearing throughout Rinascita. Interact with these gateways to enter the Somnoire.\n\nVenture into the gateway and help restore the corrupted Memory Zones!
Interact with the Fishing Spot to fish.\n\nSome Fishing Spots require specific Fishing Abilities. Acquire the corresponding Fishing Abilities to gain access to these spots.

1. As a Gondola Echo, Rachel takes damage upon colliding with hazardous creatures. Steer clear of Bampuffs, Tornadoes, and Ghost Medusas while navigating the waters.

2. Rachel's Durability decreases when damaged. If it reaches zero, it will automatically return to the dock, and all collected catches will be lost.

3. To ensure a safer and more successful voyage, you can use Riccioli Fishery Coins to restore Rachel's Durability while sailing. Keep a close watch on its Durability to avoid unnecessary loses.

Various frequencies gather beneath the waters of the Riccioli Islands. Ghost Medusas appear at night.

As you sail and fish, your Threat Level to these waters increases. Higher Threat Level attracts fiercer Ghost Medusas.

However, on a high Threat Level, <color=#ffd12f>catch quality</color> will be higher, and the chance to catch <color=#ffd12f>Mutants</color> will increase.
You may switch between Fishing Abilities on your voyage with the wheel.\n\nUsing this feature wisely makes your fishing trips more efficient and rewarding.

Under the influence of the Sentinel or the Threnodian, mutants can be found among the many species in the sea.

Mutants can always be found at the Fishing Spots of their original species.

Enhancing Phoebe's Fishing Abilities or fishing in the areas where Ghost Medusas appear at night can increase the chance of catching Mutants.

To catch the "biggest fish," you'll need a bigger ship. Captain Ahab has just one, but it really needs some repairs.\n\nProvide Queequeg with a design print, logs, and Fishery Coins, and he'll handle the rest for you.
The further you explore, the more sea creatures with unusual shapes you'll encounter.\n\nUpgrade your Cargo in Fishing Abilities to increase the available storage slots for your catches.
Scattered treasures adrift at sea, offering rewards to those who gather them.\nAfter all, their original owners have no use for them anymore.
Alertness increases over time.\nThe higher the Alertness, the more damage you take, and the stronger the enemies become.

Rover gains a new ability. Casting <color=#ffd12f>Resonance Skill</color> or <color=#ffd12f>holding Basic Attack</color> allows Rover to leap into the air.

Enhanced Mid-air Attacks, Intro Skills, and Basic Attacks accumulate Windstring.

Reach max Windstring to cast an enhanced Resonance Skill.
Collect Surveillance Datasets and pass through Wind Rings to earn points.
Reach the end of the route to complete the challenge.
Tap on a Title in the Title Page to view its details and how to unlock it. Tap Confirm to equip the Title.
Equipped Titles will be displayed in Chat and other areas.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Click Gamepad=Press} Switch Titles in your Personal Page to choose from your selection of Titles.
You can use Synergy Burst once Synergy is full.
Synergy Burst immobilizes all enemies, provides numerous battle buffs, and triggers the additional Synergy Burst from the Active Resonator's Bond.
Attacking, Dodging, Counterattacking, and other actions in battle all grant Synergy.
View Echo details at Echo Collection or Echo Overview.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Click Gamepad=Press} button with an icon of magnifying glass at the bottom left of the card to see its details. Spend Prestige Points there to unlock it.

Through dueling, you gain Duel Resonance, which increases your Duelist Level and grants abundant rewards. There is a weekly cap on the amount of Duel Resonance that you can obtain.\n\nYour dueling skill is represented by Fame Flags. Each victory grants you Fame Flags. There is no limit to the amount you can obtain.
Once you become the "Apex Duelist," Endless Challenges become available where you are free to challenge any duelist in Septimont. Show them what it means to be the best!
After unlocking new Terminal appearances, you can swap Rover's Terminal. This feature is exclusive to Rover for now.
Stickers contain harnessable Remnant Energy. These Stickers can be equipped in your Storage Bag interface to offer Resonators a variety of enhancements.

Namipon Stickers can be obtained by eliminating Tacet Discords, breaking destructible objects, or opening Supply Chests.\nStickers come in different types, which offer different enhancements and base stats.
Loot obtained in Honami City carries special frequencies and must be placed in the Storage Bag.

Stability will decrease when attacked by Tacet Discords influenced by Lament Residue. If <color=#ffd12f>all Stability is lost</color>, <color=#ffd12f>the exploration will be terminated</color>, and all items in your Storage Bag will be lost.
As you explore Honami City, the Lament Residue will slowly corrupt your Resonators. Their resistance against the corruption is shown as Stability.
Sparkling Water can be found throughout Honami City. Break them to restore some Stability and HP.
Wearing the Namipon Badge increases your Max Stability in Honami City.
Different Namipons are attached to specific Sticker sets. Equip the corresponding Stickers to activate their special effects.
Namipons will assist in your exploration of Honami City. Selecting different Namipons will allow you to cast various Support Skills while exploring.

Unlock more Namipon Support and Namipon Stickers as you investigate and venture into yet unexplored areas in search of valuable loot.\nBuild up your team's abilities as you plumb the depths of Honami City!

Although the looping crisis is over, there are still unresolved mysteries in Honami City.\nExplore Honami City with Namipon and Chisa in search of loot to enhance your combat power and upgrade Shashou Cafe. Uncover the truths behind the anomalies in the city!
While exploring, you'll come across loot contaminated by Lament Residue. Interact with the loot item to purify it and obtain rewards.

Aside from Stickers, Honami City is filled with unique collectible items that, while lacking practical effects, hold significant value. These loot items can be sold to the Sales Champ in exchange for Rice Dangos, which can be spent to enhance your exploration abilities in Honami City.
When an enemy's level far exceeds yours, its level indicator will be red. Please proceed with caution.
Due to Lament's residue, TDs in Honami City will grow increasingly dangerous over time, and enemies will deal greater Stability DMG. Be mindful of the time elapsed during your exploration.
In heavily contaminated zones, TDs affected by Irideglow may appear. Defeat them all to purify the zone and obtain higher-value loot.
Stability can be consumed to open Capsule Machines contaminated by Lament Residue, which have a higher chance of containing high-value items.
You can book the Namipon Shuttle from a Telephone Booth, which lets you safely extract at any moment. Extraction by Namipon Shuttle does not incur item loss.

Honami City is now open to free exploration. Aside from the Telephone Booth, you can also book the Namipon Shuttle from the Preparations menu. Ticking that option allows you the freedom to extract at any time.
Various Irideglow Portals might appear while you're exploring. They can randomly transport you to special areas in Honami City.
All areas in Honami City have been unlocked. You may now freely explore Honami City or continue with the story.
After activating a Namipon Lightbox, you can teleport back to its location while exploring.\nHowever, after you leave the area, the Lightbox must be reactivated before you can teleport to it again.
Missing Namipons will be marked on the map.
12 Namipons have gone missing throughout Honami City.\nFind these Missing Namipons and send them back to Shashou Cafe to earn generous rewards from Polmes.

In addition to the universal Stickers, Namipon Stickers also include exclusive Stickers that only work for specific Resonators. These stickers can alter a Resonator's skill forms or grant new effects.
The Irideglow contamination inside Neon Tower does not increase with time, but it intensifies when an enemy is defeated.
Neon Tower challenges consist of three stages, where you'll face powerful enemies in succession. Defeat each enemy to earn a large number of Rice Dangos.
Free exploration is available in Honami City after you resolve the city's major unexplainable events.
To progress the story, you must follow the Main Objectives of your journey in Honami to investigate and resolve the unexplainable events throughout the city.

When riding the expedition motorbike, you have access to features such as Acceleration, Boost, Drift, and Bounce Jump. While moving, a force field is deployed around the expedition motorbike, and the Resonator will be forced to dismount upon taking damage or being controlled after the force field is down.
You can summon the expedition motorbike or adjust the relevant settings via the Utility Wheel. The motorbike cannot be summoned while in combat or when there is insufficient space.

There is a speed limit when riding the motorbike on the Startorch Academy campus grounds, and Boosting will be restricted. There are certain areas with restricted access for motorbikes.\nRiding the motorbike and using Boost on decorated roads does not consume Energy.
You can drive the expedition motorbike in both first-person and third-person views. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Click Gamepad=Press} Switch POV to switch between different views.
The expedition motorbike helps you move faster. Its functionalities improve through upgrades.

{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} the Autopilot button to enter Autopilot Mode.\nDuring this time, Cinematic Mode can be switched on, and the game's aspect ratio will change, and automatic camera movement will occur.

On maps that support Autopilot, you can set specific markers as the destination. A recommended route will be plotted on the current road network, allowing you to reach the destination manually or via Autopilot.

Autopilot Mode allows free camera movement and will automatically avoid obstacles (such as traffic) on the road. During Autopilot, feel free to move around the camera, listen to the Heart Radio Channel, take photos, and switch to Cinematic Mode when available.
On highways, Autopilot Mode can still be activated even without a destination, and the expedition motorbike will loop along a designated route on the current road network until you exit the mode.

After placing a navigation waypoint, a recommended route will be plotted along the highway to the waypoint on the map. Once you are within range of the highway, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Autopilot to arrive near your destination.
Quickly swing the motorbike while using the rear brakes to Drift. Drifting allows you to clear turns quicker also regenerates Energy.
Quickly tilt the motorbike and jump forward to jump over obstacles or change directions mid-air.
Consume Energy to activate Boost, giving you an increase in top speed and enhanced climbing performance. Energy regenerates while not in use.

Stability Accords: A maximum of three teams can be deployed. Complete the challenge by defeating all enemies in a single round.\nSingularity Expansion: The number of deployable teams is unlimited. After defeating all enemies in a round, stronger enemies will appear for the next team to tackle.
During Double Pawns Matrix: Pilot, players are required to deploy multiple teams against four formidable foes in cycles.
During Singularity Expansion, enemies will respawn in the list's order after being defeated.
In Singularity Expansion, enemy HP increases by each round, and stronger enemy effects will be unlocked as rounds progress.
The final score is tallied based on the damage dealt to enemies.

After activating the Route Constructor, the route network will automatically undergo reconstruction.\nDuring this time, route network reconstruction will increase the Network Activity of this area and unlock various new contents.
After completing the route network's reconstruction, use the expedition motorbike's Autopilot Mode to quickly travel to the next Route Constructor and conduct subsequent reconstruction work.

Three specific materials are required to activate the Route Constructor: <color=#ffd12f>Mechanite</color>, <color=#ffd12f>Compressed Bedrock</color>, and <color=#ffd12f>Constructor Core</color>. Each material can be acquired via different methods.

Once Network Activity <color=#ffd12f>reaches a certain point</color>, project missions become available to further the <color=#ffd12f>Spacetrek Observatory reconstruction project phase</color>.\nCompleting the Spacetrek Observatory's reconstruction unlocks Weather Simulation, which enables players to change the weather in the Lahai-Roi region.

Continue tracking the locations of remaining Route Constructors to complete the route network's reconstruction.\nDuring your exploration, <color=#ffd12f>material collection</color> can be conducted across <color=#ffd12f>various locations in Lahai-Roi</color>.\nEach route network completion <color=#ffd12f>increases Network Activity</color>.
Progress the Main Quests to unlock new expedition motorbike modules with special functions.
You may switch between expansion modules on the Expansion Module menu or the wheel menu, and you can only equip one module for your motorbike.

An expedition motorbike modified by Luuk Herssen, equipped with the new <color=#ffd12f>Glacier Track</color> module. \nWith this module, the motorbike can freeze water surfaces and travel across them.

In Stability Accords, a maximum of three teams can be deployed. Complete the challenge by defeating all enemies in a single round. \nIn Singularity Expansion, the number of deployable teams is unlimited. After defeating all enemies in a round, a new round of stronger enemies will appear, following the order on the list.
The final score is calculated based on the damage dealt to the enemies in the Endstate Matrix challenges.
You are required to deploy multiple teams against formidable foes in Endstate Matrix.
Every new round increases the enemies' HP and unlocks more dangerous Escalation abilities.
In Singularity Expansion, after defeating all enemies in a round, a new round of stronger enemies will appear, following the order on the list.

<color=#ffd12f>Four rare ancient plant specimens known as Voidbane Eldertrees</color> are waiting to be restored. But Void Storms sweep through the Dimmr Plains year-round, and the trees remain stunted by Voidmatter contamination and other anomalies.\nYou must first work with the Survey Team members and the Soliskin to clear the <color=#ffd12f>Voidmatter contamination and other anomalies</color> around the Voidbane Eldertrees.

Restoratives can be obtained in large quantities from the <color=#ffd12f>recommended tasks and challenges within the corresponding sectors</color>.\nIn addition to recommended tasks, it can also be obtained from <color=#ffd12f>quests, challenges, and Supply Chests</color>.\nYou can also check which activities drop this item in the <color=#ffd12f>Exploration Progress</color> page.

Once the Restoration is completed, the Voidbane Eldertrees will resume growth, using their own energy to <color=#ffd12f>form bridges linking nearby survey sectors</color>.\nIt will also create <color=#ffd12f>support mechanisms</color> within the corresponding survey sectors.

The factors hindering the growth of the Voidbane Eldertrees have been removed, but after prolonged exposure to Voidmatter, the plants have entered an adaptive dormant state...\n<color=#ffd12f>Deliver the corresponding area's "Restoratives"</color> to restore the growth of the Voidbane Eldertrees.

Once all Restorations are complete, all Prism Fruits have been delivered, and the <color=#ffd12f>Base Camp has been upgraded to Level 5</color>, the Solvein Heartwood's energy overflow will become even more pronounced, and the Dimmr Plains ecosystem will revive once more.

Each completed Restoration grants the rare research specimen: Prism Fruit.\nDeliver it to <color=#ffd12f>I.R.I.S. at the Base Camp</color> for analysis to advance the survey and <color=#ffd12f>expand the Base Camp</color>.
While gliding, you can consume Boost Energy to dash. The motorbike will not descend during the dash.

Unlocking the Expansion Module grants Charged Leap.\nAfter unlocking it, hold the Bounce Jump button to use the motorbike's Charged Leap to gain height. Using Charged Leap from the ground will also automatically enter the gliding state.\nCharged Leap has a maximum of 3 charges, which replenish over time while the motorbike is on the ground. Charges cannot be replenished in mid-air.
The upgraded Module unlocks the motorbike's aerial capability. At a certain height, hold Glide to enter the gliding state. Gliding consumes Aerial Energy and ends when Aerial Energy is depleted.

After interacting with Corroders nearby, the <color=#ffd12f>Corroders</color> will temporarily <color=#ffd12f>follow</color> you.\nBring them <color=#ffd12f>close to Spikes</color>, and they will dissolve the golden pillar to the side, eventually dissolving the Spikes.

In the wild, where Tacetite clusters develop freely, sometimes <color=#ffd12f>Spikes</color> can be found blocking the path or <color=#ffd12f>sealing off</color> items or puzzles.\nLook closely around the Spikes for <color=#ffd12f>Corroders</color>. They will dissolve the Spikes.
Induction Cells of different colors have to be placed into the corresponding colored Induction Cell Sockets to activate the puzzles.

Use <color=#ffd12f>Levitator</color> to put the <color=#ffd12f>Induction Cells</color> into the Induction Cell Socket to turn on or off the mechanical device.\nInduction Cells of different colors have to be placed into the <color=#ffd12f>Induction Cell Sockets of corresponding colors</color> to activate the puzzles, or the Induction Cells will be popped.

Use Levitator to put the <color=#ffd12f>Induction Cells</color> into the <color=#ffd12f>Induction Cell Changer</color> to change the operating mode of the Induction Cell, and <color=#ffd12f>change</color> the current <color=#ffd12f>color</color> of the Induction Cell.
<color=#ffd12f>Fragile rocks</color> can be destroyed by means like Basic Attacks. You might find good things inside.
Touch the <color=#ffd12f>signs</color> to restore a certain amount of <color=#ffd12f>STA</color>.
After activation, it will summon enemies in the form of a projection. <color=#ffd12f>Defeat</color> all <color=#ffd12f>enemies</color> to complete the challenge and receive rewards.

<color=#ffd12f>Defeat</color> the nearby <color=#ffd12f>Tacet Discords</color> to ensure the successful activation of the <color=#ffd12f>Sound Emulator</color>. Complete the challenge to receive rewards.
After activation, <color=#ffd12f>reach the finish line</color> or <color=#ffd12f>collect a certain amount of Target Points</color> within the specified time to claim the corresponding rewards.
When a Resonator is on the <color=#ffd12f>Module: Slow</color>, STA consumed will increase and their <color=#ffd12f>Movement Speed will be reduced</color>.
When a Resonator is on the <color=#ffd12f>Module: Speed</color>, they will be <color=#ffd12f>launched</color> in the direction of the arrow.
When a Resonator jumps onto the <color=#ffd12f>Module: Jump</color>, they will be <color=#ffd12f>bounced</color> upward.
After interacting with the Signals Console, you will start the <color=#ffd12f>Decryption</color>. The Signals Hub will only be unlocked after all Signals Consoles are decrypted.

When the <color=#ffd12f>Signals Hub</color> is locked, you can use the <color=#ffd12f>Sensor</color> to locate the <color=#ffd12f>Signals Consoles</color> that are connected to the Signals Hub but hidden in a different location.

The Weight Block is placed near the Pressure Table. After the Utility is unlocked, you can use <color=#ffd12f>Levitator</color> to grab the <color=#ffd12f>Weight Block</color> and place it at the intended <color=#ffd12f>landing</color> spot.\nWhen the Weight Block is placed on the <color=#ffd12f>Pressure Table</color>, it will <color=#ffd12f>stick</color> to it.

You need to <color=#ffd12f>place an object</color> on the <color=#ffd12f>Pressure Table</color> to <color=#ffd12f>activate</color> it.\nWhen there is <color=#ffd12f>no object placed</color> on the Pressure Table, the item(s) controlled by it will be <color=#ffd12f>locked</color>.

When <color=#ffd12f>objects</color> are placed correctly on the <color=#ffd12f>Pressure Platform</color>, the locked mechanism will be <color=#ffd12f>unlocked</color>.\nMaybe something other than Weight Blocks can be placed on the Pressure Platform?

The Weight Block is located near the Pressure Platform. Use the Levitator to grab the Weight Block, and then use the Levitator again to position it at the intended landing spot.\nUnlock the Utility to access this feature.
Use the component to <color=#ffd12f>fill</color> the <color=#ffd12f>highlighted area</color> of the matrix to activate it.

After Utility is unlocked, you can use the <color=#ffd12f>Levitator</color>\nto place the scattered <color=#ffd12f>Components back to the Matrix</color>.\nWhile using Levitator, you can <color=#ffd12f>rotate</color> to adjust the direction of the Components.

The Decryption Pulse activates the Encryption Blocks as it passes through them. When <color=#ffd12f>all Encryption Blocks</color> are <color=#ffd12f>activated</color> simultaneously, the decryption is completed.

The <color=#ffd12f>Key Repeaters</color> emit the Decryption Pulses in different directions. After the Utility is unlocked, you can use the <color=#ffd12f>Levitator</color> to place the Key Repeaters on the Encryption Blocks. While using the Levitator, you can <color=#ffd12f>rotate</color> to adjust the direction in which the Decryption Pulse is emitted.
Use the <color=#ffd12f>Grapple Shooter</color> to launch temporary <color=#ffd12f>Grapple Points</color>, facilitating swift movement of the Resonators.\nUnlock the Utility to play this.
When a Resonator jumps onto the <color=#ffd12f>Flobble</color>, they will be <color=#ffd12f>bounced</color> upward.

Rewards are locked within the <color=#ffd12f>Vine Trap</color>, which cannot be destroyed by regular attacks or skills.\nResonator will be <color=#ffd12f>knocked back</color> when they <color=#ffd12f>approach</color> the Vine Trap directly.
<color=#ffd12f>Detonate</color> the <color=#ffd12f>Explosive Charge</color> that grows near the Vine Trap to ignite and <color=#ffd12f>destroy</color> it.

The <color=#ffd12f>Explosive Charge</color> triggers a violent <color=#ffd12f>explosion</color> if stimulated.\nAfter the Utility is unlocked, you can use the <color=#ffd12f>Levitator</color> to grab the Explosive Charge on branches.

After grabbing an Explosive Charge, you can throw it to a distance to trigger an explosion. By <color=#ffd12f>Aiming</color>, you can <color=#ffd12f>precisely control</color> its landing spot.\nExplosive Charges scattered on the ground cannot be controlled with Levitator, but you can <color=#ffd12f>attack</color> them directly to trigger an <color=#ffd12f>explosion</color>.
Interact with the switch to adjust the position of the <color=#ffd12f>Holographic Baffle</color>, creating a <color=#ffd12f>different pathway</color>.

In addition to the regular Magnetic Conveyor, there are special <color=#ffd12f>Teleport Tracks</color>. The Teleport Tracks always <color=#ffd12f>appear in pairs</color>. When the Magnetic Cube enters one of the Teleport Tracks, it will <color=#ffd12f>immediately be teleported</color> to the location of the other Teleport Track.

Following the instruction on the track, <color=#ffd12f>attack the Magnetic Cube</color> to move it along the specified direction. When Magnetic Cubes <color=#ffd12f>reach</color> specified <color=#ffd12f>Magnetic Conveyors</color>, the challenge is completed.

Transform into <color=#ffd12f>Cruisewing</color> to take on a flying challenge and collect as many Coins as possible within a specified time to earn points.\nThe higher your points, the better rewards you can unlock.\nDuring the flight, <color=#ffd12f>rotate your view</color> to change your route. Hold the Accelerate button to <color=#ffd12f>speed up</color>, and hold the Decelerate button to <color=#ffd12f>slow down</color>.

These mysterious Tacet Discords are scattered across the world, holding a special interest in human items. Unexpected rewards often await where they linger.\n<color=#ffd12f>Blobflies</color> follow a <color=#ffd12f>fixed route</color>. If they fly too high, try shooting it down using <color=#ffd12f>ranged attacks</color>.
After gliding through the <color=#ffd12f>Gravitation Vortex Ring</color>, you will be granted <color=#ffd12f>acceleration</color> in the specified direction.
Tap the button briefly for short signals. For longer signals hold the button for a while and release it according to the signal length.
Tap the button when the frequency signal reaches the designated area.
Use Lingyang's Plunging Attacks to destroy the obstacles or avoid them along the path to your destination.

After interacting with the puppet mechanism, you will enter the <color=#ffd12f>Puppet Control</color> state.\nIn this state, you can leave the puppet where it is <color=#ffd12f>whenever necessary</color> and <color=#ffd12f>switch back</color> to control your Resonator.\nUtilize the puppet to access places beyond your reach and deactivate the laser mechanisms obstructing your way.
Interact with the special mechanisms to rotate and shift the scene.
Use <color=#ffd12f>Plunging Attacks</color> to hit the mechanism on the ground to match the random patterns with the <color=#ffd12f>Target Patterns</color>.
Use the <color=#ffd12f>Spinning</color> Device to <color=#ffd12f>connect pathways</color> and complete the information transmission.
There are multiple groups of strings of the same color on the Terminal panel. Ensure that there are no overlappings between the lines connecting them.

The areas contaminated by toxic spores are highly dangerous. Prolonged exposure may cause limited visibility and difficulty in breathing. If you encounter such areas during exploration, please <color=#ffd12f>leave</color> the contaminated areas as soon as possible.
After the challenge starts, use the <color=#ffd12f>Explosive Charges</color> and other means reasonably to <color=#ffd12f>hit</color> as many <color=#ffd12f>targets</color> as possible.

After the challenge starts, reach the finish line within the specified time while collecting as many Hologram Tokens as possible. Upon reaching the finish line, challenge points will be calculated based on the number of Hologram Tokens collected. Reach higher points for better rewards!
The Overdash Club has set up various modules in the tracks. You can utilize them strategically to reach the finish line faster, but be sure to avoid the traps at the same time.
The Overdash Club has set up various tracks for the challenge. You can choose any one of the unlocked tracks for your challenge.
Connect the strings of the same color on the Terminal panel to complete decoding.
After the Utility is unlocked, you can use the Levitator to restore the incomplete mural on the left to its original pattern.
You can accumulate energy by hitting the enemy with Basic Attacks. The skill will be available once the energy is full.
When you are too far from the target in the chase, Dash to quickly catch up.
Transform into Mourning Aix to start an aerial chase battle.\nWhen the lock-on halo appears, use your Basic Attack to hit the enemy.
Collapsed walls and debris line the Suspended Ruins. Use <color=#ffd12f>Pull</color> to manipulate or destroy these obstacles.

Move the timeline to the <color=#ffd12f>right</color> to <color=#ffd12f>fast forward</color> time in its effective range.\nMove the timeline to the <color=#ffd12f>left</color> to <color=#ffd12f>rewind</color> time in its effective range.\nAfter finishing your adjustments, the objects affected by the Chronosorter will maintain the state they were in after the most recent timeline adjustment.
Use the Chronosorter to alter the flow of time in a small area, changing the state of certain items within that space.

Photonvaults usually appear in sets and emit golden energy paths connected to the Photon Barrier.\nBoth <color=#ffd12f>Ranged Attacks</color> and <color=#ffd12f>Melee Attacks</color> can deactivate Photonvaults. Disabling all Photonvaults in a set will deactivate the Photon Barrier.\nOnce the Photon Barrier is down, the stationary enemies inside will become active again.

Flare Crests typically come in sets and are used to seal the entrance of a ruin or other devices.\nEach <color=#ffd12f>Flare Crest</color> corresponds to one <color=#ffd12f>Flare Stone</color>. Flare Crests can be extinguished by approaching and activating the corresponding Flare Stones.\nAfter all Flare Crests of a set have been extinguished, the seal will be lifted.
Observe the <color=#ffd12f>pattern of the ice cubes</color> and sit in the <color=#ffd12f>right spot</color> as the Clang Bang and <color=#ffd12f>face the right direction</color>.
Transform into Clang Bang and fill in the missing ice cube to complete the challenge.\nMake sure to <color=#ffd12f>face the right direction</color>.
Transform into Clang Bang and use the <color=#ffd12f>Leap Device</color> to launch yourself at the <color=#ffd12f>Ice Walls</color> to break through it.
Transform into Clang Bang, <color=#ffd12f>jump</color> and then launch a <color=#ffd12f>Plunging Attack</color> to break through the <color=#ffd12f>Ice Caps</color>.
Interact with the mechanic to start the Echo Challenge: Clang Bang, and transform into Clang Bang.
Stand on the Leap Device for a moment to launch yourself in the target direction. \nThe Leap Device can also be used while you transform into Clang Bang.

Windchimers are scattered across Mt. Firmament and can be collected using <color=#ffd12f>Basic Attack</color> or <color=#ffd12f>Ranged Attack</color>. Someone has a keen interest in them. Gather Windchimers to exchange for valuable resources with her.
Smash Ice Piles with attacks, and they might drop unexpected rewards.
A light-receiving device that activates after being <color=#ffd12f>continuously</color> illuminated by the Light Emitter for a certain period.
A light-emitting device capable of activating the Light Gatherer.
Use the nearby <color=#ffd12f>Pressure Platform</color> to raise or lower a stone pillar.

While skiing, move left and right to pass through the <color=#ffd12f>Acceleration Rings</color> and <color=#ffd12f>Point Rings</color>.\nPassing through an Acceleration Ring will boost your skiing speed for a limited time.
Passing through a Point Ring grants you a certain number of points.
Passing through a Bonus Ring grants you a large number of points.

After activating Tactical Hologram: Ski, throw the Grapple at the <color=#ffd12f>Grapple Point</color> ahead to begin skiing.\n\nSki: Earn <color=#ffd12f>points</color> as you ski and reach the finish line within the specified time. Aim for higher points to receive better rewards!

A special creature that huddles up and hides underground to protect itself when approached or attacked head-on.\nAttack the <color=#ffd12f>weak point on Frostbugs' backs</color> <color=#ffd12f>from a distance</color> to defeat them.

The last step of the Rite of Offering can only be completed after the Loong's Pearl is placed on the rite platform.\nIt is necessary to stand in the position in the light and <color=#ffd12f>change the viewing angle</color> to align the <color=#ffd12f>Loong's Pearl</color> on the rite platform with the <color=#ffd12f>mouth</color> of the dragon-shaped peak of Mt. Firmament in the distance.

The Offering Site's entrance. Some entrances are still inaccessible due to the lack of a <color=#ffd12f>Meteor Key</color>.\nUse the <color=#ffd12f>Levitator</color> to put the Meteor Key into the opening at the center of the entrance to open the Offering Site.
Your HP will recover over time while bathing in this unique natural hot spring of Mt. Firmament.

The Chrono Sign can be used to activate the Chronopins in the Court of Savantae ruins, <color=#ffd12f>temporarily stagnating</color> the <color=#ffd12f>flow of time</color> in its effective range.\nYou may use the Chrono Sign to render <color=#ffd12f>enemies or mechanisms</color> within its range in stasis for 10 seconds. Use it again during the stasis to <color=#ffd12f>end</color> the effect early.
The Prototype Chronosorter in Woodveil Hall is locked due to failed defense nodes. Find and reboot them to unlock the Chronosorter.
Several malfunctioning Stone Lifts move up and down automatically and cannot be manually controlled.
Use <color=#ffd12f>Plunging Attacks</color> to hit the mechanism on the ground and match its pattern to the design on the wall.
Stand on the Bounce Pad to be propelled into the air.

Outlier: Tacet Discord cannot be attacked initially. You need to upgrade your Data Hub level to unlock it. Deliver <color=#ffd12f>KU-Cass Cartridges</color> to KU-Cass to upgrade your Data Hub.\nDefeat Outlier: Tacet Discord for the first time to claim rich rewards.
When KU-Key approaches the corrupted core, it can decode and remove it, thereby cleansing the surrounding corrupted data.
Pass through the portal to traverse space.
You cannot create a portal on the back side of the Data Wall.
You can control KU-Key to shoot energy pulses at the Data Wall to open a portal.

While in Stellar Matrices, KU-Key's abilities are enhanced by the presence of the Shorekeeper, allowing it to open both yellow and blue portals simultaneously. KU-Key can also switch the type of energy pulses it fires, but only one portal of each color can be active at a time.
As you glide, try to avoid the <color=#ffd12f>red rings</color>.
Glide across the sea and collect the scattered Aetherfins to guide them back home! Touch the <color=#ffd12f>blue rings</color> periodically to prevent your energy from running out.
Some mutated enemies have appeared in the data space. They will <color=#ffd12f>explode</color> upon defeat, so be sure to avoid the blast.
Put the key on the base to activate other mechanisms.
Barriers will block Resonators and other items, but KU-Key's energy pulses can still pass through.
Follow the mysterious butterfly. It will show you the way.
KU-Key can pass through the portal to destroy the core of corruption on the other side.
When the portal appears black inside, it is not activated. To activate it, you must open a second portal to create a connection between the two.
When Sync Energy is full, cast any Resonator's Resonance Liberation to enter the Illusive Sync state.
The Illusive Sync only lasts 10 seconds. If you don't cast the next Resonator's Resonance Liberation within that time, you'll lose all Sync Energy, and the sync will end.

Casting Resonance Liberation while in Illusive Sync triggers the Dream Link state and activates the Link Field.
When the Link Field is active:
1. All team members' ATK, Crit. Rate, and Crit. DMG are significantly boosted, while Resonance Skill cooldowns are greatly reduced.
2. A Stagnation Zone is generated, immobilizing enemies within the Link Field.
3. Nearby enemies are pulled toward your Resonators upon activation.
4. When the Link Field ends, your team gains continuous HP regeneration.

Deal damage to accumulate Sync Energy. When the Link Energy is full, get ready to activate Dream Link.\nSuccessful <color=#ffd12f>Dodges</color> and <color=#ffd12f>Counterattacks</color> provide a lot of Sync Energy.
In the Illusive Sprint state, attack to dash toward enemies and deal significant damage.
Hold Dash to enter the Illusive Sprint state after picking up the white cat's blessings.
Carrying a flower seed reveals hidden Blossom Paths.\nFlower seeds can be picked, but they can only be placed on blooming Camellia flowers.
Camellia can remove the thorns with her Skill "Ephemeral."
Spin the platforms while holding a Seed to generate new Blossom Paths.
Follow the Wind Rings to stay on course. Pass through them to earn challenge points!
Flying along the Wind Trail allows you to <color=#ffd12f>automatically</color> follow the wind's direction.
Smash the floating containers with the Gondola or your attacks and collect the treasures within!

Across Rinascita, you may stumble upon these fragile containers scattered around. Shatter them to uncover hidden treasures within.\n\nKeep a close eye on those bearing the Montelli family crest, as they contain Monnaies—an old currency that can be redeemed for rewards at Averardo Bank.
Select a color on the right and apply it to the blocks on the palette to the left. The new color will spread to all connected blocks of the same color.
Different Overflowing Palettes have different move limits. Plan your moves carefully to return the land to its former vibrancy!

These collapsed morph paintings drain frequencies and energy from their surroundings to maintain their forms, causing the minerals, plants, and even animals nearby to lose their vibrancy and color.\nThe absorbed colors transform into chaotic color blocks on the Overflowing Palette. <color=#ffd12f>Adjusting all the blocks into a designated color</color> will restore the environment's former vibrancy.

After a <color=#ffd12f>Resonance Beacon</color> is activated, you can open the Map and <color=#ffd12f>fast travel</color> to an activated Resonance Beacon.\nHead to a Resonance Nexus or Resonance Beacon to <color=#ffd12f>heal</color> injured or downed Resonators.
The <color=#ffd12f>Resonance Nexus</color> stores information on the surrounding area. Activate it to obtain the corresponding <color=#ffd12f>Map</color> data.

<color=#ffd12f>Defeat</color> the nearby <color=#ffd12f>Tacet Discords</color> to ensure the successful activation of the <color=#ffd12f>Sound Emulator</color>. Complete the challenge to receive rewards.

The product of a collapsed Sonoro Sphere, found throughout the world. It records undistorted memories of the past.\nUse Grapple to hook and quickly approach the Sonance Caskets in Ragunna. The Plushie Echoes in the Garden of the Lost are collecting them—perhaps a visit will reveal more.
A village of Plushie Echoes in the Garden of the Lost. The villagers are gathering Sonance Caskets throughout Ragunna to unlock the Sonoro Sphere within a morph painting.

While steering a Gondola, you can use Waterfall Surge to swim up a waterfall.\n<color=#ffd12f>(Please note that this function can only be used in safe waters. Protect your Gondolas, and protect yourselves.)</color>
A special Gondola that cruises along the most scenic spots in Ragunna City, often called the city sightseeing water bus.\nBoard the Gondola to relax and enjoy the voyage.
The link will automatically break once you reach the highest point.\nThe Wingray will return to its starting point after a short time.
Aim your Grapple at the Wingray. When the visual cue appears, cast Grapple to link yourself to the Wingray. It will carry you upward.

When in Flight, use movement keys (or the control stick) to ascend or dive.\nAs you dive, you gain momentum for the Echo Wings, allowing you to ascend higher.\nTry diving to restore momentum when it depletes.

{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} the Ultra Flight button to activate <color=#ffd12f>Ultra Flight</color>.\nThis mode allows you to defy gravity completely but consumes <color=#ffd12f>more STA</color>.\nCompared to level flights, your STA consumption rate increases when ascending and reduces when descending.
Boost Unit: Flight is a reward for <color=#ffd12f>Exploration Progress</color>. It increases <color=#ffd12f>max STA</color> while Flying.
The settings menu offers an option to invert ascending and diving input, allowing you to customize controls to your preferences for smoother experience!

Use Utility: <color=#ffd12f>Flight</color> to leap into the air and start flying. Flight is a Utility specific to Jinzhou (including Mt. Firmament), the Black Shores, and Rinascita regions. Available only while out of combat.
Once the challenge begins, follow the ground cues to avoid the Vitreum Dancers dashing toward you.

When you reach a Leap Spot, using Utility will activate Echo transformation automatically. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} the Utility button to transform into a Cuddle Wuddle and jump.\nAim your camera to the next Leap Spot and {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} the Utility button to leap again.
Reach the final Climbing Spot to perform the Leap for the Top!

When you reach a Climbing Spot, the Utility will automatically become Echo transformation. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} the Utility button to transform into a Cuddle Wuddle for the climbing challenge.\nAim your camera toward the next Climbing Spot and {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} the Utility button to climb again.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} the button while the pointer is in the highlighted section to speed up the progress. The rock will break once the progress bar is full.
When the pointer enters the orange zone, activate Powerful Punch mode. Rapidly {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} the left and right buttons to speed up the smashing.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Utility button to transform into a Cuddle Wuddle and smash the Seamrock. Ready to throw this Plushie Punch!
Press the Utility button to transform into a Cuddle Wuddle and break the Friable Rock with a single punch!

Nightmare Clouds of ghostly flames. \n\nObserve the number of flames and absorb Nightmare Clouds <color=#ffd12f>in the correct order</color>. Absorbing them in the wrong order will reset the challenge.

Nightmare Clouds that keep multiplying.\n \nLottie Lost must use the <color=#ffd12f>Finished Book</color> and <color=#ffd12f>Hold</color> the Enhanced Absorption button to <color=#ffd12f>absorb</color> and eliminate all Nightmare Clouds at once.
Ordinary Nightmare Clouds can be absorbed into Lottie Lost's picture book, transforming them into beautiful paintings.\nAbsorb Nightmare Clouds to earn rewards!

Lottie Lost draws power from the stories in the <color=#ffd12f>Finished Book</color>, enhancing her ability to absorb Nightmare Clouds.
 
<color=#ffd12f>Hold the Enhanced Absorption button</color> to absorb all Nightmare Clouds within her radius.
 
The Enhanced Absorption state lasts for a limited time and can be refreshed by reading the Finished Book again.
Guide Lottie Lost to collect the lost pages by following the sensed trail as closely as possible.\nOnce all the pages are collected, the Unfinished Book will be fully restored.
Lottie Lost can resonate with the Unfinished Book, sensing the trail of its lost pages.
Restore all the monuments, and you might uncover something unexpected!
Stand right before the monument base, then use Grapple to pull the misplaced monument back to its base to restore the monument.

Approach the base and interact with the flickering point to read the <color=#ffd12f>inscription</color>.\nFind the painting mentioned in the text and use Levitator to place it on the <color=#ffd12f>matching base.</color>

Dreamscape Nodes gather various dream frequencies, each presenting unique challenges based on the dreams and emotions they contain.\n\nClear the Dreamscape Tacet Discords and meet all <color=#ffd12f>challenge goals</color> to link the Node to Somnoire. You can interact with the node's core to retry challenges as many times as needed.
To complete the challenge, <color=#ffd12f>meet all challenge goals within the time limit</color> or defeat the Nightmare Tacet Discords directly.
Some special Dreamscape Nodes feature <color=#ffd12f>enhanced</color> Nightmare Tacet Discords.
Beware of Nightmare Tacet Discords in some waves, which can <color=#ffd12f>deal greater DMG</color> on the Dreamscape Nexus.

The Dreamscape Nexus serves as a central point for transmitting frequencies and dreams to Somnoire. Protect it from being destroyed within the time limit. Each defeated wave of enemies <color=#ffd12f>reduces the remaining defense time.</color>
Fae Ignis from the Dreamscape doesn't die when its charge is interrupted. However, when defeated, it will always explode and release fireballs at a faster rate.

Once Cuddle Wuddle enters the synergy with other plushies, they will launch Coordinated Attacks. However, if Cuddle Wuddle's <color=#ffd12f>HP drops below 30%</color>, the synergy will end, and Cuddle Wuddle will be paralyzed.

Cuddle Wuddle enters a prep phase of synergy when its HP drops below 80%. During this time, you can interrupt the synergy by dealing DMG equal to 20% of Cuddle Wuddle's max HP or defeating the other Plushies Echoes.
<color=#ffd12f>Counterattacking</color> the Vitreum Dancer's strikes can break its weapon, which makes the Vitreum Dancer enter an Enraged state and become even more powerful.

Questless Knights, Diurnus Knights, and Nocturnus Knights can enhance their weapons, indicated by a glowing effect. Counterattack them three times to remove the enhancement, or they will continue to enhance their weapons repeatedly.
Face the Nightmare Clouds and use Utility to transform into a Lottie Lost. <color=#ffd12f>Hold the button</color> to absorb the Nightmare Clouds with her picture book!
When the Roseshroom charges for shooting a laser, shoot the core at its head to interrupt the charging.
When a black piece lands on the outer circle, it <color=#ffd12f>opens all gates and maze walls in that direction.</color>
You can pause the game at any time, and <color=#ffd12f>all pieces will stay in place.</color>
Press the <color=#ffd12f>Reset button</color> to restart the game.
The game ends when either side's pieces form a straight line.\n<color=#ffd12f>If black pieces connect, you win</color>; if white pieces connect, the Lifer wins.
Select a piece to preview its landing point, then select the point to move the piece.
Submit a <color=#ffd12f>Stake of Imbalance</color> at a Terminal to remove the buffs.
After submitting the Stakes, you can freely <color=#ffd12f>turn The Lifer's buffs on or off</color> through the Terminal.
Use <color=#ffd12f>Sensor</color> to locate the Terminals granting buffs to the Lifer.
<color=#ffd12f>When only the player is within the altar's range</color>, the steles charge most efficiently.
<color=#ffd12f>When there are Tacet Discords within the altar's range</color>, the steles stop charging.
<color=#ffd12f>When the player is out of the alter's range,</color> the steles stop charging, and the energy begins to drain.

Each of the three altars is connected to the Discipline Steles around it.\nStand on the altar platform to charge the steles, but <color=#ffd12f>Tacet Discords will appear</color> to disrupt the effort.
The Macabre Torch's light can dispel the Shadow state of Tacet Discords, making them vulnerable again.
There are certain enemies who will try to extinguish the nearby Macabre Torch after taking specific amounts of damage.
In the dark area not illuminated by the Macabre Torch, Tacet Discords are enhanced, entering the Shadow state that makes them <color=#ffd12f>immune to all attacks.</color>

Place the collected pieces onto the missing parts of the stained glass.\nA <color=#ffd12f>golden glow</color> will appear if the piece fits correctly.\nA <color=#ffd12f>red glow</color> will appear if the piece doesn't fit.
Use Levitator to collect the stained glass pieces.
