Go through the Tacet Mark protruding from the ground to enter the Tacet Field in another dimension.\n\nAfter clearing the Tacet Field, you can consume Waveplates to obtain various Echo development materials and collected Echoes of the corresponding Sonata set.
Disabling the security system or defeating patrolling enemies will lower Alertness. When Alertness reaches 100, the Echoes guarding the Vault will come for the intruders.
Use the "jewelry set" to shoot the surveillance cameras and disable them for a while.
Surveillance cameras are used to scan for suspicious activities. Staying within their view increases Alertness.
Shooting the patrolling Vitreum Dancers with the "jewelry set" will paralyze them for a while. When all the Vitreum Dancers in the room are paralyzed, they will permanently stop patrolling.
Vitreum Dancers patrol the Vault, charging at intruders and dealing DMG on impact.
Scatter Prisms greatly enhance Carlotta's Forte. Shooting them with the "jewelry set" disables the surveillance cameras and Vitreum Dancers within a large area permanently.

Alertness indicates how alert the Vault's security system is to your actions. It increases when you are detected by Vitreum Dancers, spotted by surveillance cameras, or engage in combat. You can lower it by disabling security systems or defeating enemies. If Alertness reaches 100, you will be forced to retreat and restart from the previous area.
Defense Lasers block certain pathways and deal DMG to anyone who touches them.
Use the Fae Ignis Echo's ability to ignite an extinguished Macabre Torch.

After completing <color=#ffd12f>all Dream Patrol challenges in an area</color>, the evil thoughts buried deep in the dreamscape will materialize as Tacet Discords.\n\nThese special Tacet Discords are stronger foes. Defeat them to obtain <color=#ffd12f>special Echoes</color>.

Use the Clearance Device to <color=#ffd12f>shoot the target mechanisms</color>. This will change their status, allowing you to turn cameras on and off, switch track directions, and control security mechanisms within the vault.

Upgrade your Clearance Level to unlock more functions.

Board and steer the Echo Train, choose its path, and control mechanisms along the way.

Some tracks within Averardo Vault are under maintenance. Use the switches to ensure the train stays on <color=#ffd12f>tracks that allow passage</color>.\n\nIf the train is on the wrong track, it will automatically return.
Board the train Echo and steer it along the tracks.
A device designed to switch train tracks. The displayed direction on the device shows the current track the train is following. Use the Clearance Device to change the track direction.

Use the Clearance Device to <color=#ffd12f>shoot the target mechanisms</color>. This will change their status, allowing you to turn cameras on and off, switch track directions, and control security mechanisms within the vault.

Upgrade your Clearance Level to unlock more functions.

You can control various mechanisms within the vault with this device.

A Clearance Device specially prepared by Carlotta, granting you the highest level of access within Averardo Vault. Verify your clearance at designated security rooms in the vault to increase your Clearance Level and unlock additional functions.

The Clearance Device can only control a limited number of Echoes. Once this limit is reached, you won't be able to control any additional Echoes.

Upgrade your Clearance Level to increase the number of Echoes you can control simultaneously.

*Controllable Echoes are marked by a golden aura.

Use the Clearance Device to turn the hostile security Echoes in the vault into allies. In this state, they will prioritize the safety of the clearance holder above all else.
 
If an allied Echo is too far from the Clearance Device or the Clearance Device is not equipped, it will revert to its hostile state.
 
*Controllable Echoes are marked by a golden aura.

Upgrade your Clearance Level to unlock more functions.

Clearance Command - Security Mechanism: Upgrade your Clearance Level to gain access to a broader range of security mechanisms.


Authorization Command - Echo Control:

Level 1: Converts the target to your ally, making it prioritize the safety of the clearance holder above all else. However, this effect will be revoked and the Echo will return to its default state if a friendly Echo is not within the effective range of the Clearance Device or when the Clearance Device is not equipped as Utility.

Level 2: The controlled Echoes will actively attract enemies' attacks.

Level 3: The number of Echoes you can control is increased to 2.
Interact with the mechanisms in the security rooms to upgrade your Clearance Level and unlock more functions.
Due to limited functionality, the Vitreum Dancer can only perform straight-line dashes in four directions. \n\nKeep it within the camera's authentication range to unlock security doors.
You can use the Clearance Device to control the movements of the silenced Vitreum Dancers.

The <color=#ffd12f>hilt platform</color> of the Statue of Divine Justice radiates strong Remnant Energy. Before proceeding, adjust your gravity direction to be <color=#ffd12f>perpendicular to the platform</color>.
Casting a <color=#ffd12f>Plunging Attack</color> above the hilt platform will cause the Statue of Divine Justice to descend, triggering a section of the ruin to move.

Vines formed from remnants of the Dark Tide entangle the hovering statues. Use <color=#ffd12f>Cartethyia's abilities</color> to purify the statues.\n\n<color=#ffd12f>Purify nearby statues</color> to clear the corruption on connected statues.
The vines block Phaom's path forward. Locate and use <color=#ffd12f>Remnant Sparks</color> to clear the way!
<color=#ffd12f>Throw the Remnant Spark</color> at the vines to purify them.
Entering the "Door of Unity" transports you to a new area and changes the direction of gravity.
The obelisks and chains are interlinked. Smashing an obelisk also breaks the chains attached to it.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Click Gamepad=Press} the direction indicator along the wheel to change the gravity. <color=#ffd12f>The yellow indicator shows the direction guided by Cartethyia</color>.
Cartethyia infuses the Gravity Calibrator with special energy. \n \nUse the Gravity Calibrator to <color=#ffd12f>change the gravity direction</color>, enabling access to unreachable areas.
Use <color=#ffd12f>Whistle from Utility</color> near waters with matching gravity to summon Cartethyia's companion, Phaom, for a ride.
In certain waters, the Gondola will cruise along a fixed route.\n\nSimply control the Gondola's left and right movement.
Use Utility: Flight to chase the light spark along the Wind Trail.

Ride the Gondola and follow the light spark until you reach the end of the route. \n \nPass through <color=#ffd12f>Power-up Rings</color> to maintain your cruising speed and avoid <color=#ffd12f>Obstacle Rings</color> along the way.
In the Sea of Ghosts, remnants of jellyfish float in circular areas. Use the lamp within these zones to travel to different dimensions.

Twisted frequencies permeate the castle, giving birth to a Sonoro Sphere where past and future intertwine. <color=#ffd12f>Use the lamp given to you by Cantarella</color> in certain areas to travel between different dimensions.

Coming in contact with the <color=#ffd12f>umbrella of a Bouncy Jellyfish</color> will <color=#ffd12f>bounce</color> the Resonator upward.\n \n<color=#ffd12f>You can only interact with Bouncy Jellyfish in the current dimension</color>. Bouncy Jellyfish from other dimensions appear as visions and cannot be interacted with.

Enemies from alternate dimensions are shrouded in shadows, granting them <color=#ffd12f>immunity to all forms of attack</color>.\n \nUse the lamp and <color=#ffd12f>switch to their respective dimensions</color> to clear their shadows and make them vulnerable to attacks.

The late head of Fisalia's obsession is in a special shadow state, making them <color=#ffd12f>immune to all forms of attack</color>.
 
During combat, the lamp's energy can be charged <color=#ffd12f>by performing Dodge and Counterattack</color>.
 
Once fully charged, the lamp will emit a powerful light to dispel the shadows, making the enemy vulnerable to attacks.
Some Overflowing Palette paintings contain Colorblocks formed by abnormal frequencies. <color=#ffd12f>These blocks cannot be colored normally</color>.
Complete the Drake's challenge by evading lightning strikes within a given time period.
Some Resonators' abilities are limited in certain gravity environments.

The Nimbus Wraith has left special pattern hints on the ground.\n \nFollow its guidance and <color=#ffd12f>walk along the highlighted path as accurately as possible</color> using Sensor to complete the pattern.
Thanks to Phaom's awesome sailing ability, you can ride up waterfalls to reach <color=#ffd12f>areas with different gravity orientations</color>.
When Capitaneus adopts a defensive stance, <color=#ffd12f>attacking from behind</color> will cause the stance to break, turning the situation to your advantage.

Attack the Sequence Mechanism continuously to fully charge it and unlock certain mechanisms and entrances. \n\nThe charging progress is shown as the <color=yellow>highlighted portion</color>. The charge will begin to drop if you stop attacking.

Turn the Messenger Statue to the correct direction to activate the mechanism. Different mechanisms require you to turn the Statue in different ways and different directions. Look for nearby <color=yellow>hints</color> to solve the puzzle.
Strong airstreams flow through the activated ventilation tunnel. Follow Zani and stay within the <color=yellow>protection zone</color> created by her shield. Otherwise, you may be blown off course.
Activate the drain on the spiral column to release water from the tunnel and create a new passage. \n\nAdjust the spiral column to control the water level.

When in the Challenge Zone, your <color=#ffd12f>Glory Level</color> is shown on the top left corner of the screen.

Search for and defeat Tacet Discords or occupy Banners of Conquest to gain Hunt Points. Hunt Points are used to increase Glory Level and acquire buffs.

The difficulty of the challenges will decrease as the Glory Level gap between you and the enemy narrows.

The competition does not end when you're downed in the Challenge Zone, but your Glory Level will decrease to the number of your <color=#ffd12f>Trial Level</color>. However, you will gain a Hunt Points bonus, which remains in effect until your Glory Level recovers to the highest level you've ever achieved. Please take note of this when fighting tough opponents.\n\nYou can gain Trial Points by occupying Banners of Conquest. Trial Points will increase your Trial Level, which will only be effective in this competition and does not reset when you are downed.

Areas of greater danger house Tacet Discords of greater Glory Levels. It might be wise to obtain Buffs by raising your Glory Level first before facing Tacet Discords of a higher Glory Level.\n\nThere are five areas in the Old District. Each area contains a special Tacet Discord that has the highest Glory Level of that area. Defeat them to obtain <color=#ffd12f>abundant rewards</color>.

Draining of floodwaters in the Old District has revealed a large number of Tacet Discords. The Gladiators of Septimont have now launched a competition to hunt them.\n\nDefeating Tacet Discords in the Challenge Zone and occupying Banners of Conquest will increase your Glory Level, granting you <color=#ffd12f>powerful buffs</color>.  Make good use of these buffs to claim victory and glory in the challenge!

Banners of Conquest can be found in the Challenge Zone.

Interacting with the ones marked by a yellow light grants you Hunt Points and Trial Points.

Interacting with the ones marked by a blue light grants you Buffs.

Some Banners of Conquest in the Challenge Zone have been overrun by Tacet Discords. Defeat them and occupy the Banners of Conquest to gain Hunt Points and Trial Points. Trial Points increase your Trial Level. Defeating the Tacet Discords will occupy the Banner. Once occupied, the Banner of Conquest will no longer be interactable.

Counterattacks, Dodge Counters, and Attacks in combat grant <color=#ffd12f>Battle Engagement Points</color>, which can <color=#ffd12f>temporarily raise Glory Levels</color> by 100 levels as Hunt Points do.

Upon taking damage, only Glory Levels added by Battle Engagement Points will be lowered. But not the Glory Levels provided by Hunt Points.

The Glory Levels added by Battle Engagement Points will rapidly decrease when out of combat.

These Dreamscape Tacet Discords have been affected by Contagion and are much tougher than their regular counterparts. You must find their weaknesses to defeat them. Completing Challenge Goals or casting Special Moves grants powerful buffs against the Tacet Discords in Dreamscape Contagion.
Septimont's Dreamscape Nodes gather various dream frequencies, each presenting unique challenges based on the dreams and emotions they contain.
Counterattack can Immobilize Kerasaur. When a Kerasaur is Immobilized the second time, its ATK and RES will be reduced.
Dodge the Drakes' attacks several times to decrease their RES. Defeating one Drake in the group makes them unable to coordinate their attacks.
Continuously attack a Gladiator with a raised shield to break their defenses and instantly defeat them. Doing so also decreases the RES of other Gladiators.
Dodge Counter greatly reduces the Vibration Strength of Pilgrim's Shell. Attacking an Immobilized Pilgrim's Shell deals Electro DMG to targets within a certain range.
After taking the gladiator spear, follow the interaction prompt to throw the spear and destroy the Tidal Blight on the giant statue.
Find the Patrol Units and help them reach the platform so they may activate it to get you the gladiator spears.
The Hero's Legacy Armor will unlock the <color=#ffd12f>Hero's Slash</color> Skill in certain scenarios when the enemy is in a certain state. Use this Skill to instantly defeat or weaken the enemies.

Aim at the mechanism, then press the highlighted button to don the Hero's Legacy Armor and gain the <color=#ffd12f>Hero's Slash</color> Skill. Aim and {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} the corresponding button to slash.
Hold the Skill button and release once Rend is fully charged to cast the skill, destroying all destructible objects nearby.

Gather three Recollections of Heroes to charge the Hero's Legacy Armor. When the armor is charged, aim at the mechanism and {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} the highlighted button to don the Hero's Legacy Armor and access a powerful <color=#ffd12f>Hero's Rend</color> Skill.
Some stubborn Bitter Resentments can only be cleared by using <color=#ffd12f>Hero's Rend</color>.
Frequencies of bitter resentment are flowing in these strange threads...\nWhen Bitter Resentment is shelled up, use <color=#ffd12f>Hero's Slash</color> to eliminate them.
Try switching rails to collect more energy and obtain more points.
You can jump to the rails on the left or right.
Some Tactical Hologram: Vitreum Dancers have a slowing debuff. During the Hologram challenge, zones that greatly slow you down will appear.
Use <color=#ffd12f>Hero's Slash</color> to destroy more Aftertune Figments in a short time. Slash Vibration Figments to release a blast of energy to destroy multiple Figments nearby at the same time.
Destroying Cacophany Figments lowers your points. Try to avoid them.
Touch Ta-da's Protection and then use Dash to enter the Speed Hooray mode, dashing forward and running much faster.

Banners of Conquest: Medium and Banners of Conquest: Major are occupied by powerful Tacet Discords with high Glory Levels. Defeating these enemies allows you to occupy the Banners and gain a large amount of Hunt Points. Defeating other powerful enemies in the vicinity also grants additional rewards.\n\nBanner of Conquest: Medium and Banner of Conquest: Major can be interacted with after you occupy them. Doing so resets all Tacet Discords in the area, but will not reset the occupation status of the Banners.

Upon completing all the challenges in the "Banners Never Fall" event, TD respawning in the Challenge Zone will resume to the normal state, and Special Buffs will remain available for that area.\n\nThe Banners will no longer be interactable in a completed Challenge Zone, but any unopened Trophy Chests will still be there.

If your Glory Level is below the recommended level for the next Banner, you may raise your Glory Level by <color=#ffd12f>activating Banners of Conquest, exploring the current area, or defeating TDs</color>.
Orchestration consumes energy. Energy gradually recovers when not Orchestrating.

Orchestration is one of Phrolova's Resonance abilities. It can tap into an object's essence and change its state. After Orchestrating, the behaviour of nearby objects will be affected for some time. Orchestration can be ended early.
Special Grapple Points will appear during Orchestration. They function just like normal Grapple Points.
Enemies cannot hit you when you're in Orchestration.
During Orchestration, each attack slows the enemy's attack speed. After taking 5 attacks, the enemies will be locked. All locked enemies will be instantly defeated when the Orchestration ends.

Micro Echo Brooders are stored centrally and require significant space. To preserve valuable manufacturing floor area, they are usually concealed within structural partitions.\nThese units deploy rapidly when activated and may bump into surrounding objects. You can control them via Orchestration.
Defective Power Controllers will periodically release large shockwaves that damage anything nearby. Use Orchestration to fix the Power Controllers.
During Polyphone Orchestration, drag to link the music notes by number in ascending order up to number 5.

After connecting the numbers in ascending order, the missing notes on the top of the screen will be restored, and the Orchestration will be complete, returning the chaotic melody to its original form.
If there are multiple notes, link all notes up to number 5 of their corresponding colors.

Special music stands are found around the Orchestration Altar. Put a complete Music Sheet on the stand corresponding to the altar to activate the Orchestration Altar and initiate Polyphone Orchestration mode.
Use the up and down movement keys (or the control stick) to ascend and dive. Use the left and right movement keys to control your direction.
Use Grapple to enter the special water current that can rapidly transport you between connected areas.
Energy pipes supply large amounts of energy to various areas and connect to an array of opening and closing valves. Operate the valves by sending energy through the pipes to the correct place.
The Breaker is one of the safety devices for the Energy Pipes. Press on the pedal to reconnect the disconnected Energy Pipe.
The Prayer Rite must be performed exactly as specified by the Order of the Deep for it to be considered a display of devotion. Failure to do so warrants expulsion from the group.
Rotate the items given by the prophecy seekers to find and activate hidden "Omens" on them. These Omens give clues about each seeker.
When the Triptych Chest displays 3 identical icons, hit its button to open the chest.
Find Iuno's specter within the Chaos. Take her hand and walk with her to relive her past and complete the Anchoring.
Inspect all the found "Omens" to gather enough information and glimpse the future of the prophecy seeker.

Hold the hand-holding icon to release Iuno's hand. Moving more than 5 meters away from her specter will break the Anchoring and cause you to become lost in the Chaos. If you do not take her hand again within 15 seconds, the Anchoring will end, and you will return to the last Anchored memory.
In this battle against the Dark Tide, Iuno can use certain skills to heal allied Gladiators nearby. After reaching a certain amount of health, Gladiators will return to combat.
Insert the <color=#ffd12f>Anchor Stone</color> into the <color=#ffd12f>Anchor Obelisk</color> to activate it. Once activated, it repels the Dark Tide fog and boosts the Sacred Flames in Maroonwood.

The awakened Hollow Figure can be <color=#ffd12f>shattered</color>. Approaching a Hollow Figure will cause it to <color=#ffd12f>charge up</color> and explode, thus summoning Tacet Discords. <color=#ffd12f>Shattering</color> the Hollow Figure before it completes <color=#ffd12f>charging up</color> can prevent the summoning.
The moving "light dots" will awaken the sleeping <color=#ffd12f>Hollow Figures</color> along the way. Proceed with caution.
Interact with the Waystone to enter or exit Sonoro at any time.
Watch your surroundings. When a <color=#ffd12f>Grapple Point</color> appears near a gaint rock, you can use <color=#ffd12f>Grapple</color> at the right moment to pull it down and stun enemies below.

Interact with the Dreamscape Nodes in the Sanguis Plateaus to unlock the challenges and clear the Nightmares sealed within.\nThere are three challenges in a Node. Completing a challenge unlocks the next one. Complete all challenges to obtain rewards.

During combat, Augusta slowly builds up her Momentum. When the <color=#ffd12f>Momentum Bar</color> is full and turns <color=#ffd12f>yellow</color>, she enters the <color=#ffd12f>Attack Preparation stage</color>. After a while at yellow, the <color=#ffd12f>Momentum Bar</color> will turn <color=#ffd12f>red</color>, and Augusta will <color=#ffd12f>launch her attack</color>.\nCasting <color=#ffd12f>Resonance Liberation</color> <color=#ffd12f>interrupts</color> Augusta's attack and she'll recharge Momentum from the start.
Distorted temporal zones exist throughout the Plane of Dark Tide. Use the Lantern of Napoli the Second to separate and switch between "worlds" in the Dark Tide.
Influenced by the Journeying Paradise frequencies, Tidespawn in the Plane of Dark Tide will gain Paradise Shelter and take less damage.
Once the Lantern of Napoli the Second switches you to another "world," Paradise Shelter will be broken, leaving the Tidespawn vulnerable.
Battles with Tidespawn in the distorted zones will disturb the power of the Lantern. You'll need to build up frequency to reactivate it.
Your battle further destabilizes the frequency of this "world." Annihilate your foes by striking at the moment you switch worlds.
Galbrena's "cassette tape" stabilizes your frequency. Your Concerto Energy and Resonance Energy will steadily increase as it plays.\nSeize this chance to fight your way out.

Galbrena imbues Feather Blades with Shadow Fiend's power. Aiming and throwing them at a point allows her to move instantly to that point.\nIf an enemy is at the target point, she slays them as she moves.
Galbrena summons Chimera and uses its power to change the "world" in the Dark Tide, uncovering new pathways via another "world."
In Beholder's Vision state, Galbrena's attack style changes.\nAnd she can also unleash a special skill to sweep away all obstacles ahead.
Galbrena has entered Beholder's Vision, allowing her to detect weak spots and openings. Using the TD power within her, she can swiftly traverse the battlefield to eliminate enemies.
Clear the Void Storm Zone for the first time to earn rare Tidal Heritages.\nEnemies within the Void Storm Zone respawn daily. Repeat the challenge to earn Modding EXP for your expedition motorbike.

There are two waves of enemies within the Void Storm Zone.
Due to the Void Storm, Resonators lose HP each second, and their Healing received and Healing Bonus are halved.
Resonators will be inflicted with Warp upon being hit, increasing their damage taken.
Unleashing Tune Break on enemies during Wave 2 deals massive amount of damage, restoring HP for Resonators and removing their Warp.
Inside the Solisylum, the Heliogyre has been deactivated.\nRotate six <color=#ffd12f>Stars</color> to realign their beams toward the Heliogyre and reactivate it.
While in the Transition interface, aim in the direction you wish to Transition.
Use the Grapple to reach the Mechascout: Transition's hand.
The motorbike gains a speed boost after driving onto a ramp and another when passing through the blue screen, allowing you to perform unique stunts.

After passing through the barrier area, you enter a slow-motion hacking mode.\n<color=#ffd12f>Rotate the camera to aim</color> at multiple targets. Once a target is marked,  {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} the button to complete the hack.
Drive through the blue screen to enter Owlwatch Hacking
Interact to quickly travel to your destination.
The motorbike is equipped with an Adaptive Hook module that has a variable range when the player is mounted or dismounted.
After finding Soliskin, you will receive Soliseed of Essehalo from them, which can be delivered to the <color=#ffd12f>Giant Soliskin at the Monument of Returning Soliseeds</color> for rewards.
Some Soliskin gone astray way across Lahai-Roi. Find and guide them back to Bjartr Woods.

While inside the giant trees of Solvein Canopy, certain devices can only be activated with the help of the Soliskin's powers. Locate the <color=#ffd12f>Solis Orb</color>, and assemble enough Soliskin to activate these devices.
If you leave Bjartr Woods during the quest, Soliskin will stay and rest in the Woods until you return.\nAfter the quest is completed, Soliskin return to Solvein Canopy and will no longer follow you.
During Exploration Quest “Where Light Takes Shape,” Rovers will need to gather Soliskin, which will accompany you as you travel through <color=#ffd12f>Bjartr Woods</color>.

When a "Cassette" bearer is lost to a Void Storm, the Cassette is corrupted and its data disrupted. It becomes a Tape of Last Words.\nNow, a mech in Solsworn attire seeks these Tapes of Last Words to cleanse their Voidmatter contamination and restore the data within.
You can utilize the Adaptive Hook module on the motorbike to grab resources, Sonance Caskets, and other items over long distances.
Resonance Beacon is activated automatically when you ride through its range.
You and your Terminal's interaction ranges increase while riding the motorbike.
The expedition motorbike's force field can break destructible obstacles on the road.

You may view and equip all available Echoes in the edit page. Use Utility: Projector to call out the selection menu and choose the Echo to be projected. Some areas present puzzles that require special interactions. Use the Projector to create the appropriate Echo Projection to help your exploration.
In Lahai-Roi, Zip Zap can detect immobilized Spacetrek Explorers nearby and release an electrical pulse to get them back online.
In Lahai-Roi, Zip Zap can detect broken power lines nearby and release an electrical pulse to reconnect the line.

Geospiders S4 in Lahai-Roi gravitate towards places bathed in Lumiglow where they perform Lumiglow Revelation. Once the revelation is complete, the Lumiglow fades, revealing the hidden objects inside.

In Lahai-Roi, Mining Reindeer can sense nearby Soliskin sealed inside special Luxites. The reindeer can fire a sustained laser beam to break the rock's outer shell, allowing you to free the trapped Soliskin.

When approaching a glide rail, the Jump button will light up and switch to a Rail Glide button. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} this button to make the motorbike leap onto the rail and enter Rail Glide. Landing on the rail from the air will also trigger Rail Glide.
You can use certain environmental structures as glide rails while riding the motorbike.
While riding on the Cruise Conduit, you can jump to adjacent Cruise Conduits. Use Jump while holding down directional buttons to jump off the conduit in the corresponding directions.

You earn Riding Points by Rail Gliding. Use Rail Drift to collect points on both sides of the rail. Use Bounce Jump to collect points in the air. Earn enough Riding Points to claim Shell Credits rewards.
When aproaching the rail, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} the Jump button to enter Rail Glide.
Riding the motorbike through rings of three separate colors restores various amounts of Energy in descending order: Gold, Pink, and Blue.
Ride the expedition motorbike through Score Rings to <color=#ffd12f>collect points</color> while riding toward the finish line.
While riding the expedition motorbike, use the Pathfinder's Trailer Ramp to jump.
Startorch Academy's holographic printers can print device components from the Academy.
Photonic Beam can be fired when Energy Pulse is 100% charged.
Photonic Beam deals massive damage to the Voidworm.
Voidmatter Orbs are spawned as the Voidworm burrows and surfaces from the ground.\nRide the motorbike and collect Voidmatter Orbs to increase the Energy Pulse charging progress.
Spacetrek convoys strap Supply Packs on the exterior of their vehicles. Certified expedition motorbikes can use Adaptive Hooks to acquire these supplies.
Sometimes, Outcasts with ill intentions and Tacet Discords would stop passing traffic along the Lahai-Roi route network. Handle these troubles and restore order in the route network.
Move the Cube Blocker to complete the Smartprint Cube compilation and reactivate the Smartprinter for access to printing services for various objects.
In the frostlands, Glommoths can sense and shatter massive ice formations.\nShattering the ice reveals paths and objects once sealed by the cold.
In the frostlands, Glommoths can interact with Soliskin hiding within caves.\nLook for glimmering caves where the Soliskin hide, then use the Glommoth Projection to uncover the secrets they conceal.

Use the Support Module to break the ice and activate the Voidmatter Forcefield, then enter it with the Grapple Point.\nEntering the forcefield while riding your motorbike will charge it up, launching you into a powerful leap.\nEntering the forcefield on foot will cause you to glide automatically and ascend into the air.
Activate the Glacier Probe to shatter ice and reveal objects that were once frozen beneath the glacier.
In certain environments, the expedition motorbike can use the <color=#ffd12f>Glacier Track Module</color> to create frozen tracks, allowing it to travel across the terrain.
The expedition motorbike now has access to additional features. When approaching targets a Support Module can destroy, the module will be summoned automatically to aim at them.
Use the Module Adapter to shoot the Unstable Frequency Cores, switching them between their tangible and intangible states.
When the Module Adapter is equipped, certain Stable Adaptive Modules will automatically respond and form a persistent route.
When the Module Adapter is equipped, you can pass through the Unstable Barriers.
In regions with stable signals, you may find Module Adapters at bases left by Startorch Academy. \nThese devices detect frequencies disrupted by Voidmatter and manifest them as Adaptive Modules.
Void Barriers cannot be passed through, even with the Module Adapter equipped.
When the Module Adapter is equipped, you can detect and collect Exoenergy affected by Voidmatter. After collecting it, you can proceed along the designated route at a higher speed.
After interacting with the Mass Relay Device, you can use it to jump between different sector platforms within the space station.
The Mass Relay Device's energy core can restore the Etheric Sea Droplets disrupted by Voidmatter to a stable state, clearing obstacles that block your path.
When the Soliskin absorb the Reactor's rays, some excess energy spills into the surrounding environment. Collecting it grants a movement speed boost.

A path formed from Adaptive Modules has appeared on the field.\nFire a projectile at the <color=#ffd12f>Unstable Frequency Core</color> to shift nearby <color=#ffd12f>Adaptive Modules</color> between their two states.\nHowever, <color=#ffd12f>Solidified Modules</color> (shown in gray) cannot be altered by the <color=#ffd12f>Unstable Frequency Core</color>.

Soliskin can move along a continuous line of materialized <color=#ffd12f>Adaptive Modules</color>.
They can jump up one level and will automatically jump down when encountering a gap.
Once a Soliskin determines that it can reach the Giant Soliskin, it will begin moving on its own.
Adjust the <color=#ffd12f>Adaptive Modules</color> on the field and guide all Soliskin safely to the Giant Soliskin.
Across the frostlands, Void Storms are contaminating the Soliskin.\nGuide the Soliskin toward the corrupted Giant Soliskin to help cleanse it.

There are two waves of enemies within the Void Storm Zone in the Frostlands Surface. \nDue to the Void Storm, Resonators lose HP each second, and their Healing received and Healing Bonus are halved. Resonators will be inflicted with Warp upon being hit, increasing the DMG they take. \nUnleashing Tune Break on enemies in the second wave will trigger Recurrence Impact. This impact deals AoE damage, restores HP to the active Resonator, and removes all stacks of Warp.
Upon approach, the entry Switchgate will moderately pull you toward it. Touching it will teleport you to the corresponding exit Switchgate.

Keyboards stashed randomly in the Dark Side. They are divided into three octaves. Resonators can activate the Note displayed in each octave by stepping on the two keys in an octave. Activating three Notes generates a Note Windfield.
A rune that grants control over the Switchgates. Use it to flip the status of both the entry and exit Switchgates in the current environment.
A rune that represents "lock." Once it is unlocked by the Rune: Key, it reveals a new passageway.
A rune that represents "key." Once activated, it transforms into a light orb and flies toward the Rune: Lock.
A rune that traps Rune: Key and Rune: Lock. Must be manually removed through Plunging Attacks.
Drum Sets randomly stashed in the Dark Side. The cymbals will tilt to the side when Resonators step on it.
Drum Sets randomly stashed in the Dark Side. You may step on the drumhead, and when you move across it,  the vibration will launch you upward while emitting a rhythmic sound.
Giant speakers randomly placed in the Dark Side. After receiving the frequency from the microphone, the speaker then emits a massive sound wave that launches anyone on it upward.
Microphones randomly placed in the Dark Side. Attacking them causes the microphones to emit sound waves, which travel along the signal cables to the speakers.
The more rows or columns you clear at a time, the more bonus points you get.
Drag the blocks to complete a row or column and clear blocks to earn points.\nNew blocks will be supplied on the right side once the current set is used up.

There are many mysterious caves throughout the Dimmr Plains. Interact with the Light Builder at a cave entrance, then rotate the Exostrider components inside until the projection matches the pattern on the wall to open the cave.
Voidcreeps release Voidmatter to erode the surrounding environment. Entering the affected area will continuously drain HP and restrict movement.

Attack or use the Hoverdroid to shoot the Solvein Heartwood Branch to activate a Lumescribe Component. It can also be activated by the light from another Lumescribe Component.\nInteract with a Lumescribe Component to move it between rails.
Sometimes obstacles will block the light from a Lumescribe Component. Attack the obstacle to destroy it.

Lumescribe Components can suppress Voidmatter and cleanse Voidcreeps. A Voidcreep's tendrils exposed to light will close up, and its main body will shrink and explode after prolonged exposure.\nStanding within a Lumescribe Component's range protects you from the Voidcreeps. The Voidcreep tendrils in the area will only disappear after all Voidcreeps in the area have been removed.
While standing within a Lumescribe Component's range, your Hoverdroid is empowered. Use it to deal a deadly blow to enemies.

The Reactor Drive energy within the Stalaglow Cavern is being eroded by Voidmatter. Purification cannot be completed until the Threnodian creations have been driven off.\nUse Lumescribe Components to drive away the Threnodian creations. If the illuminated target is a clone, the clone will be destroyed. If it is the real body, the real body will be shot down.
Align the scattered rune fragments with the runes on the stone to reveal the complete rune.
When you approach a Royan rune fragment, the rune carved by Sigrika will react. Casting the selected rune power allows you to see the rune fragments scattered throughout the area.

A special monster left behind in the Voidthirst Cradle. It seems to have no physical form and cannot be attacked or destroyed.\nIt will relentlessly pursue intruders and drag them into the void, but remains completely still while being observed.\nWhen you see Voidmatter contamination effect at the edge of the screen, she is getting close. Press the button to turn around quickly at such moments.
Aligning the main body and its reflection triggers resonance, releasing a directional beam that activates nearby mechanisms.
Soliskin Platform still obeys the laws of light and cannot pass through opaque objects.

Soliskin Platform is created when Soliskin energy is released through a scientific instrument once contaminated by Voidmatter.\nThe platform itself is made of unstable Soliskin energy. As you move across it, the unstable platform tilts toward your position.

When the platform is tilted at the proper angle, you can ask Hiyuki to freeze the Soliskin Platform beneath your feet. A frozen platform temporarily stops tilting.\nUse the frozen platform to reach higher ground and continue forward.

A branch of the Solvein Heartwood. It seems to still bear traces of Exostrider creations and can store a small amount of Soliskin energy.\nTry striking it to awaken the Soliskin energy within, which can be guided to and reactivate the nearest abandoned mechanics.\nThe Dimmr Plains are abound with such abandoned mechanics: Lumescribe Emitter, Lumescribe Component, and Soliskin Platform.
Dodge the falling blocks and climb upward using the path they form. First things first, catch up to Denia.

Before a block falls, it will track horizontally above you for a limited time. You can rotate the block by 90 degrees with the Rotate button.\nOnce you are in the right position, you can manually drop the block.

While dodging the blocks, be careful not to let the stack rise beyond the ready zone. If it does, the game will also fail.\nWhen Voidmatter Blocks fill an entire row, that row is cleared, reducing the stack height.
In Voidmatter Blocks, you must dodge the falling blocks until the countdown ends to win the game.

Before a block falls, it will track horizontally above you for a limited time. You can rotate the block by 90 degrees with the Rotate button.\nOnce you are in the right position, you can manually drop the block. Manually dropping a block grants bonus points.

While dodging the blocks, be careful not to let the stack rise beyond the ready zone. If it does, the game will also fail.\nWhen Voidmatter Blocks fill an entire row, that row is cleared for a large score bonus. The more rows cleared at once, the greater the bonus.
In Voidmatter Blocks: Infinite, you must dodge falling blocks while also adjusting positions and orientations to earn points. Reach certain milestones to claim rewards.
One side of it is a smooth, mirror-like surface. When struck by the Origami Construct's energy, it forms crystals that reflect beams. Can be rotated after interaction.
A construct issued by the Spacetrek Collective to members of the Dimmr Plains Survey Team for protection against Voidmatter threats. While aiming, it can alter the state of Rock Mirror.
Once activated, it condenses Exostrider energy into a beam that can clear Voidmatter contamination and certain obstacles.
A construct issued by the Spacetrek Collective to the Survey Team. Can be freely used in the Dimmr Plains. Aim it at the Rock Mirror's mirror-like surface to crystallize it with the device's energy.
Once activated, the Speed Pipe propels the gliding expedition motorbike forward without consuming energy.
Touch Score Rings to gain points and restore energy.

Advance on a designated track, get past any obstacles in your way, and earn enough points to complete the challenge.\nUse Drift to slide under barriers or Bounce Jump to leap over obstacles. You may also use Drift to swing out the motorbike through certain spots to grab more points.
After interaction, a large number of motorbike mechanisms and score items will appear in the field. Earn enough points within the time limit to complete the challenge.
Hiyuki has left traces of her frequency throughout the Dimmr Plains. You can activate the power sealed within them in the face of threats.
A special plant found in the Dimmr Plains. Use the Projector to blow it away for a possible surprise reward.
After the Stridergate incident, faint traces of Voidmatter still remain in Lahai-Roi. Use the Voidwing Moth Echo to dispel the Voidmatter residue.

In the Dimmr Plains Void Storm Zones, when a Resonator takes enemy damage, they gain 1 stack of Warp, increasing all DMG taken by 10%.\nCasting Tune Break Skill on the second wave of enemies restores HP to the Resonator and removes Warp. When the Resonator attacks enemies or inflicts Negative Statuses, enemies lose HP over time for a certain duration. This effect can stack.
Drag the photos to the target area to project the memory into reality.
Lucilla can use her Forte "Memory Palace" to project her memories on the corresponding Projectors.
Lucilla preserves her memories in the form of photos. Locate and use the corresponding Projectors to project them.
Some photos have been smeared due to contamination. Drag the two calibration bars to the correct positions to restore the photos.
System will begin hacking once an option is selected, and upload the hacking command automatically. Hacking will be complete upon successful upload.
Time will be slowed during the hacking process. Exit the Quickhack interface for quick upload.
Access Quickhack through the Utility wheel. Aim the camera at targets to show hack options available
You can also use Quickhack through Camera.
Control cameras to gain a different perspective to survey the surroundings.

In the Breach Protocol Interface, start from the first row of the code matrix. After selecting the first code, the next one must be chosen from the column of the previously selected code. After that, you must select from the row of the new selection. This row-column alternation continues throughout. Selected codes will be shelved in the buffer for matching with the target sequence.

If the selected sequence does not match the target sequence in the exact order, you'll need to start from the beginning.

The hack will fail if the number of unfilled slots in the buffer is less than the number of unmatched segments in the Target Sequence.

The hack will succeed only when all Target Sequences are fully completed.

In the Breach Protocol Interface, select the code sequence required to upload from the code matrix and shelve the sequence in the buffer.\n\nTo complete the hack, match the code sequence in the buffer with the sequence required to upload.
Quickhacks can also be used to attack targets.\nPerforming Quickhacks consumes RAM, which recovers over time.
When there are multiple targets within your view, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=click Gamepad=press} on the targets to commence hacking in order.
Quickhacks have a limited input window. Complete the hacking within the time limit to overcome your obstacles.
Immune to interruption when HP is above 50%.
RES to all Attribute DMG is increased by 200%.
When hit by a Counterattack, Vibration Strength Reduction is increased by 50%.
HP is increased by 25%.
ATK is increased by 25%.
Damage dealt by allies within the range is increased by 100%.
ATK is increased by 100% every 20s. This effect can stack unlimited times.
Immobilized state duration is reduced by 50%.
Explode upon being defeated, dealing DMG equal to 100% of their ATK.
After taking no DMG for 2s, restore 10% of their Max HP every second. This effect resets upon taking DMG.
Dealing DMG increases ATK by 20%, stacking up to 4 times. All stacks will be removed if they don't deal any DMG in 6s.
Knock back nearby enemies when taking DMG equal to or greater than 25% of their Max HP in 1s, dealing DMG equal to 100% of their ATK.
Dealing DMG inflicts 1 stack of Aero Erosion on the target. This effect can be triggered once every 6s.
Dealing DMG inflicts 1 stack of Electro Flare on the target. This effect can be triggered once every 6s.

Restore 20% HP for nearby allies upon being defeated.
Deal Fusion DMG equal to 2% of the target's Max HP per second to the nearby enemies. This effect does not stack.
Immune to Electro DMG when HP is below 50%.
Receive 100% more damage when inflicted with Spectro Frazzle.
Increase nearby allies' ATK by 60% for 15s upon being defeated.
Receiving DMG increases DMG dealt by 10% for 8s, stacking up to 10 times.
At the beginning of the challenge, gain a shield equal to 20% of your Max HP. After not taking any DMG for 3s, gain a shield equal to 20% of your Max HP.
Hitting the target increases your ATK by 20%, up to a max of 80%.
Every 5s, provide a shield to all friendly units within 15 meters.
ATK is increased by 30% for 5s when friendly units are within 15 meters of you.
As your Cube moves forward, it will collect rewards from all the pads it passes.
In each round of the race, you'll encounter Resonator Cubes. Meet them to activate their special Cube Bonus!
After each round of the Race, you'll see a Summary where you can view the Cubes met, the rewards earned, and other Race data. Close the Summary to move on to the next round!
Complete Training Tasks to obtain Magic Dice and move your Cube forward. Roll the Magic Dice and watch your Cube advance based on the roll.

Your rescued Cube companions from Abbowser Castle will help with Ceremony preparations.

As the preparation progresses, the Anniversary Cake will change in stages.

Freed Cubes will stick around in the Cube World. Maybe they'll have a story to share?

Cube companions will fight alongside your Resonators in Abbowser Castle. 

Use Echo Skills to make your Cubes cast <color=#ffd12f>powerful attacks</color>.

Some Cubes can even cast themselves to form Combos with Resonators or other Cubes.

Conquer Abbowser Castle with your Cube companions to free the other trapped Cubes.

Utilize the resources in Abbowser Castle to level up your Cubes until you're ready to defeat Abbowser.

Gather all your Cubes and host the Ceremony together.
Cubes can be equipped with Data Modules to gain extra powers in battle.\n\nData Modules come in many types. Be sure to <color=#ffd12f>equip them to the corresponding slot</color>.
Extra Data Modules can be <color=#ffd12f>decompiled</color> and recycled into upgrade materials.
Defeated Elite or Boss enemies may drop Data Modules.

There are 3 types of Data Modules for your Cubes. \n\nAside from Abbowser Castle, Abbowser's Shop also has powerful Data Modules. To shop there, collect the coins obtained by conquering Abbowser Castle.
Leveling up Cubes <color=#ffd12f>unlocks</color> more of their Data Module <color=#ffd12f>slots</color>, allowing them to be equipped with more Data Modules.
Equip Ability Modules to give your Cubes the Abilities of other Cubes. \nAn Ability Module <color=#ffd12f>cannot be equipped</color> if the Cube already has <color=#ffd12f>that same ability</color>.
A Cube's final slot is unlocked when it reaches Level 10. Equip an Awakening Module to this final slot to completely change the Cube's Ability.

Each day from 8:00 to 19:30, players can support their favorite Cube by predicting that it will be the match winner. Each day, the match starts at 20:00, and the match winner will be decided on the same day.

During a match, Dice rolls decide which Cubes move first and how far.

Cubes on the same pad <color=#ffd12f>stack</color>. When the bottom Cube moves, it will <color=#ffd12f>carry along</color> all Cubes stacked above it.

During a round, <color=#ffd12f>there is a chance</color> for a Cube to trigger its own special <color=#ffd12f>Ability</color>.

In each match, the <color=#ffd12f>No. 1 Ranked</color> Cube wins. Players who <color=#ffd12f>supported</color> the winning Cube will <color=#ffd12f>receive</color> Popularity Rewards.\n\nThe Popularity Rewards are determined by the Popularity consumed in Support, and the Cube's <color=#ffd12f>Underdog Odds</color>. These odds <color=#ffd12f>refresh regularly</color> based on how much Support the Cube receives.
Each match is split into the 1st Half and 2nd Half. The rankings in the 2nd Half will determine whether a Cube <color=#ffd12f>advances</color> to the next match.
Players can <color=#ffd12f>support</color> a <color=#ffd12f>Cube</color> by <color=#ffd12f>predicting</color> that it will be the match <color=#ffd12f>Winner</color>.
When Cubes are stacked, if the bottom Cube moves first, it will carry along all the Cubes stacked above it. Among stacked Cubes, the higher up a Cube is, the higher its rank.

During the Support Phase, players can <color=#ffd12f>support</color> their favorite Cube by <color=#ffd12f>predicting</color> that it will be the <color=#ffd12f>Match Winner</color>.

<color=#ffd12f>Supporting</color> a Cube consumes a player's Popularity. <color=#ffd12f>Popularity</color> can be obtained by completing the event's <color=#ffd12f>Daily Tasks</color>.

If the Cube you Supported wins, you will <color=#ffd12f>receive Popularity Rewards</color> based on [Popularity Given] x [Underdog Odds].

Don't worry, you'll get back 80% of the Popularity you gave in Support if your prediction turns out wrong!

The Support Phase lasts from 08:00 to 19:30 every day.

Based on the Support a Cube receives and its starting position, the Cube's <color=#ffd12f>Underdog Odds</color> are <color=#ffd12f>refreshed</color> daily at 12:00 and 18:00. 

Your Popularity Rewards for correctly predicting the winner will depend on the Cube's Underdog Odds. Be sure to keep an eye on any changes to those odds!

During a match, Dice rolls decide which Cubes move first and how far.

<color=#ffd12f>There is a chance</color> for a Cube to trigger its own special <color=#ffd12f>Ability</color> to try to reach the finish line first.

Cubes that arrive later at the target pad will stack on top of those that arrived earlier.

Each Group Stage is split into the 1st Half and the 2nd Half.
A Cube's ranking in the 1st Half will determine its starting position in the 2nd Half.

After the 2nd Half ends, only the <color=#ffd12f>frontrunner Cubes</color> will <color=#ffd12f>advance to the next Stage</color>.

The top 4 ranking Cubes from each Group Stage will advance to the Quarterfinal Stage. The top 2 from the Quarterfinal Stage will move on to the Final, where the champion will be decided.

After each match ends, the Match Recap page will allow you to watch the match replay. \n\nIf the match that just concluded was the 1st Half, a "2nd Half Starting Position" button will appear on the main page. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Click Gamepad=Press} to view the starting positions of the Cubes for the 2nd Half.

The Race Page shows all stages of the Race and who's advancing.

The Race consists of 5 stages: Group A, Group B, Quarterfinal A, Quarterfinal B, and the Final, with 10 matches in total.

During the Support Phase, the current Contenders and match will be highlighted. After each match is over, the page will update with the Contenders for the next match.

{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Click Gamepad=Press} Echoes in the list on the left to add them to your deck.\nEach deck can contain Echoes of up to 2 Attributes. To change Attributes, remove Echoes with the Attribute you are replacing from the deck first.

<color=#ffd12f>Core Echoes</color> have 8 DMG and are Overlord or Calamity Class Echoes in Solaris. Each deck must include exactly one Core Echo. Its overwhelming power makes it the cornerstone of a strong build.\n<color=#ffd12f>Normal Echoes</color> have 1 to 3 DMG and are Common or Elite Class Echoes in Solaris. You must include 20 Normal Echoes in your deck to begin a duel.

A deck is comprised of 21 Echoes, one of which must be a Core Echo and the remainder, Normal Echoes. The number of Echoes in a deck is subject to an upper limit and a minimum requirement that must be met to proceed with the duel. \n\nEchoes have different Skills. Some Skills complement or boost other Skills. Please keep this in mind when building your deck.

The number of Dreamland Coupons earned each day is affected by the Echoes, Props, and Dream Block types.
Up to 20 Echoes can be placed on the field.
At the start of each new day, Echoes on the field will randomly change positions.
If the field is full when a new Echo arrives, the newcomer will be placed off the field and may appear on the field the next day.
As Phases progress, the rarity of Echoes available for recruitment will gradually increase up to the Gold rarity.
In the Dreamland Detail page, you can view all Echoes currently on and off the field, as well as your daily yield.

In each Phase, you must reach the required revenue target within a given duration to progress to the next Phase.\nEntering a new Phase means a more difficult target. Completing all the Phase Goals will clear the Stage.\nEach new phase grants some Frequency Crystals and will automatically deduct the required Dreamland Coupons of the previous Phase.

Echoes with this Dream Attribute center around <color=#ffd12f>Gradation</color> as their core ability.
Certain Echoes will <color=#ffd12f>trigger Gradation once and obtain buffs after staying on the field for a set number of days</color>.

To maximize your gains, <color=#ffd12f>try placing as many Gradation Echoes in the early days as possible</color> if you select Dream of Gradation.

Echoes with this Dream Attribute center around <color=#ffd12f>Devouring</color> as their core ability. 
Certain Echoes grow stronger in the Dreamland by Devouring. <color=#ffd12f>When a powerful Echo absorbs a weak one, its Daily Coupon yield increases.</color>
Certain Echoes grant additional buffs upon being Devoured.

To maximize your gains, <color=#ffd12f>make sure you have enough Echoes on the field that can be Devoured</color> if you select Dream of Devouring.

Echoes with this Dream Attribute center on <color=#ffd12f>Exchange</color> as their core ability. After staying on the field for a set number of days, some Echoes will remove themselves and leave behind various buff effects.
<color=#ffd12f>Certain Dream of Exchange Echoes can produce Echoes with the ability to Exchange. Whenever Exchange is triggered, this type of Echo becomes buffed.</color>

To maximize gains, <color=#ffd12f>make sure you can produce enough Echoes with the ability to Exchange</color> if you select Dream of Exchange.

Echoes with this Dream Attribute center on <color=#ffd12f>Integration</color> as their core ability. Some Echoes can reshape the Dreamland through Integration. <color=#ffd12f>When conditions are met, certain Echoes will merge with another Echo on the same row into a brand-new Echo and grant various buff effects.</color>\n\n<color=#ffd12f>Try Integrating many Echoes of the same rarity</color> to create powerful Echoes if you select Dream of Integration.

Echoes with this Dream Attribute have no core ability. <color=#ffd12f>They are suited for synergizing with Echoes of other Dream Attributes.</color> These Echoes will automatically be added to Echo Recruitment after being unlocked, without the need to specifically select this Dream Attribute.

There are three terrain types in the Tidal Defense Simulator: ground, wall and ceiling. Combat Machines can only be deployed on specific terrain based on their type.\n\nIn each Preparation phase, you will receive a certain number of Sim Credits. You will also earn a small number of Sim Credits by defeating Tacet Discords.

Once Combat Machines are deployed, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=click Gamepad=press} Start to begin the simulation. Tacet Discords will advance along preset routes.\n\nIf Tacet Discords reach the Energy Matrix, they'll reduce its Durability. The amount of depletion depends on the Tacet Discord type. The simulation fails if Durability drops to 0.

Tacet Discords enter through invasion points. During the simulation, they won't attack you directly but will follow preset routes. You can see these routes as marked lines in the Preparation phase.\n\nAdditionally, the Preparation phase shows previews of Tacet Discords moving along these paths. Use this info to strategically deploy your Combat Machines based on their movement patterns.

After completing a simulation, you'll be granted Rating Stars based on the remaining Durability of the Energy Matrix.\n\nRating Stars can be used to unlock Overwatch Protocols, granting tactical advantages for future simulations.

In the Tidal Defense Simulator, you need to deploy Combat Machines to fend off waves of Tacet Discords aiming to destroy the Energy Matrix.\n\nTacet Discords attack in waves. During the <color=#ffd12f>Preparation</color> phase before each wave, you can consume Sim Credits to deploy various types of Combat Machines.

In the Total Defense Test of Deathtrap Mode, Tacet Discords do not stop attacking and become more powerful with each wave. Defend against an unending stream of enemies and strive to set your highest wave record!

In Deathtrap Mode, you'll be able to choose a Tactic during the Preparation stage before each wave. Tactics grant powerful combat buffs.\n\nEach Tactic belongs to a specific Tactic Set, where you can view detailed descriptions and effects.

In some stages of the Tidal Defense Simulator, certain paths will be blocked at the start of combat.\n\nOnce a specific wave is reached, these paths will open, creating new invasion points and changing enemy routes.
You can use the purchased items by {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tapping PC=pressing Gamepad=pressing} the corresponding buttons. Consumables will be depleted upon use.

Use the wheel to quickly switch between your carried items.\nYou can only carry a limited number of items. Different items have different carry limits. Once you reach the limit, you won't be able to purchase more.
KU-Money's Shop appears after every certain waves, spend your Sim Credits there to purchase items.
Once samples of the same Attribute are connected, all other single samples of that Attribute will become fixed. Drag the connected samples to link with the fixed ones.
Connect all frequency samples of the same Attribute within the move limit to complete the analysis and win the challenge.
Drag frequency samples of the same Attribute (color) to connect them.

In this simulation, some Tacet Discords are Shielded. Shielded Tacet Discords are immune to Slow effects.\n\nUse pulling-in-type Combat Machines (Vortex Generator and Whirlpool Device) to directly remove Tacet Discords' Shields.
Use knockback-type Combat Devices and KU-Roro's Weapons to push Tacet Discords off the edges, instantly defeating them. Tacet Discords defeated this way will not trigger their Deathsound effects.
Tacet Discords with Passive - Fortified have very low HP, but the DMG they take is fixed at 1 for each hit.
Tacet Discords with Domain - Disable periodically disable nearby Combat Machines for a short time.
Tacet Discords with Passive - Invisibility do not trigger Combat Machines on walls and ceilings.
Tacet Discords with Domain - Barrier periodically grant Shields to nearby Tacet Discords.

The <color=#ffd12f>Frequency Neutralizer</color> removes Frequency Contamination.\nWhen <color=#ffd12f>carrying</color> Frequency Neutralizers, you can deploy Combat Machines to contaminated areas. The system will <color=#ffd12f>automatically consume</color> the required number of Frequency Neutralizers for the deployment.\nCertain Combat Machines can also clear contamination using their Optional Modules.

Your companions have their own special skills that may turn the tide of the game.

Making a drink consists of four steps:
1. Select the first drink base.
2. Select the second drink base.
3. Select add-ins.
4. Select a topping.

Elites are tougher enemies with higher HP. Defeat them promptly, or the biker will fail to dodge them and take damage.

Drag Echoes from your hand into the Deployment Zone to Deploy them.\nThe left side is the Frontline, and the right side is the Backline. Position your Echoes strategically according to their attack range.

Drag Echoes from your hand or the Deployment Zone to the Reconstruction Area on the right to Reconstruct them.\nReconstructing the Echo shuffles it back into the card stash and restores 1 Energy. You may draw the Reconstruted Echo again in later rounds.

Each Echo has four basic stats.

Strength (STR): Affects the DMG dealt during the Battle Stage.
Constitution (CON): Represents the Echo's ability to withstand DMG.
Energy Cost (Cost): Represents the Energy required to Deploy or Modulate this Echo.
Damage (DMG): At the end of each Battle Stage, surviving Echoes deal DMG to the opponent equal to this value.

Generally, higher values indicate more powerful stats.

The Deployed Echoes surviving the Battle Stage will deal damage to the opponent equal to the sum of all of their <color=#ffd12f>DMG</color>. Certain Echo Skills may also affect the DMG dealt by the Echoes.\n\nEach duel lasts a maximum of 8 rounds. After the 8th Round. The duelist with more HP wins.
Using Transform may sometimes consume or refund additional Energy. The exact amount depends on the skill's effect.
Echoes with Transform in the Deployment Zone can also be dragged directly to the Transform Area to activate it. Echoes used this way will also be consumed.

Some Echoes possess the special <color=#ffd12f>Transform</color> Skill.\nDrag an Echo with <color=#ffd12f>Transform</color> Skill to the Transform Area to activate it. However, this Echo will be consumed, and you won't be able to draw it again for the rest of the duel.

Echo A will replace Echo B in the Deployment Zone upon Modulation, inheriting Echo B's DMG (the inherited DMG will add to Echo A's original DMG). Echo B will be shuffled back into the deck after Modulation and may be drawn again in later rounds.

Modulation activates an Echo's Modulation effects. The full effects are dependent on the specific Skills.\n\nOnly on-hand Echoes can be Modulated. You cannot Modulate a Deployed Echo with another echo in the Deployment Zone. Stacking two Echoes that are both in the Deployment Zone will only result in them swapping positions.

A Deployed Echo can only be Modulated twice.\n\nTo Modulate a Cost 3 Echo, it must be stacked on top of a Modulated Echo. In other words, you must Modulate a Cost 1 Echo first before you can Modulate a Cost 3 Echo.
Drag Echo A from your hand onto Echo B in the Deployment Zone to perform a Modulation.
When you Modulate Echo B on the Deployment Zone using Echo A from your hand, Echo A inherits Echo B's Special Skills and activates them.
Every Echo in the Deployment Zone can be Modulated at most twice.
Some Echoes possess a Special Skill that only activates under specific conditions.
Deploying a Core Echo costs no Energy. It will stay on-hand throughout the duel before being Deployed, but cannot be Reconstructed or Modulated.
Core Echoes are extremely powerful. It is recommended that you complete the Trial so that you can use the Core Echo to win the duel.
Each Core Echo has its own Trial. During the duel, you can only add Core Echoes to your hand after completing the corresponding Trial.

Novelties can be placed onto the Deployment Zone like Echoes, but do not directly participate in the Battle Stage. Instead, they influence the duel with unique abilities, such as Quick-Deploy, drawing extra cards, or boosting stats.\nKeep in mind that Novelties usually last for a limited time or have a set number of uses, and will be shuffled back to your deck after their duration or uses are finished.\nWhile you can only deploy up to 4 Echoes, Novelties have no such limit.
Novelty is a new card category added to the Lahai-Roi version of Peaks of Prestige. They are items with unique powers.

You may only include one Domain card in your deck. Each Domain features a powerful Active Skill, such as Energy recovery, drawing extra cards, and Quick-Deploy. They can even gain new effects if your deck meets certain requirements.
Domain is a new card category added to the Lahai-Roi version of Peaks of Prestige. These cards possess extremely powerful abilities that can shift the tide of any duel.

Use <color=#ffd12f>Directional Input</color> to control the Blocker's movements. Move the <color=#ffd12f>Cube Blocker</color> to the <color=#ffd12f>Endpoint Module</color> to bring the Smartprint Cube back online.\nLong Cube Blockers (1x2) must be perfectly aligned to trigger the Smartprint Cube's compilation.\nUse the <color=#ffd12f>Reset</color> button to reset the progress.

<color=#ffd12f>Cube Blocker</color> is the core component of the Smartprint Cube. It can be moved along the circuit as long as there is enough secure space along its path.\n<color=#ffd12f>Cube Blockers</color> come in two forms, each with different secure space requirements to move.

Bounce Modules launch the Cube Blocker two blocks in the arrow's direction, allowing the Blocker to bypass faulty components on circuit modules.\nLong Cube Blockers must be perfectly aligned to trigger this module.\nThe module will not be triggered if there is not enough secure space for the Blocker in the target direction.
Move the Blocker to the button connected to the Faulty Component to break the component.\nLong Cube Blockers must be perfectly aligned to trigger the module.
Faulty Components in the circuit cannot be passed through and can be destroyed through other means.
The module will crack and disappear after the Cube Blocker passes through.

Some compilation processes will involve multiple Cube Blockers. All Cube Blockers must reach the corresponding Endpoint Module to complete compilation.\nYou can only control one Cube Blocker at a time. Use the <color=#ffd12f>Switch</color> button to change between Blockers.
Core Echoes are extremely powerful. It is recommended that you complete the Trial so that you can use the Core Echo to win the duel.

When a Cube Blocker passes through a <color=#ffd12f>Data Expansion Module</color>, all <color=#ffd12f>Digital Shadow Modules</color> on the circuit will <color=#ffd12f>switch their form</color>.\nHowever, if another Cube Blocker is already positioned on a <color=#ffd12f>Digital Shadow Module</color>, this <color=#ffd12f>Digital Shadow Module</color> will not switch its form.\nLong Cube Blockers (1×2) must be perfectly aligned with the Data Expansion Module to trigger its effect.

There are two forms of <color=#ffd12f>Digital Shadow Module</color> in the circuit:\n- <color=#ffd12f>Tangible Module</color> that can block the Cube Blocker.\n- <color=#ffd12f>Intangible Module</color> that won't block the Cube Blocker.
When a Cube Blocker comes into contact with the laser emitted by a\n<color=#ffd12f>Laser Beam Module</color>, it will be instantly fused, causing the Smartprint Cube to reboot.

<color=#ffd12f>Laser Beam Modules</color> continuously fire laser beams. These beams can pass through <color=#ffd12f>Intangible Digital Shadow Modules</color> but are blocked by <color=#ffd12f>Tangible Modules</color>.

When Resonators enter the <color=#ffd12f>Sea of Flames</color>, they become eroded by the Incinero Petal Pollens, causing a <color=#ffd12f>steady decline in their HP</color>.\nThis effect will gradually disappear within seconds after the exposure stops.

Resonators can use the <color=#ffd12f>Shooting Mechanism</color> to train their shooting skills. Hitting different targets will trigger different effects:
Normal Targets: Yellow. Hit all of them to proceed to the next stage.
Explosive Targets: An explosion symbol marked on it. When hit, it will trigger an explosion, breaking the surrounding targets.
Trap Targets: A prohibition symbol marked on it. When hit, your points will be deducted.
Connect the pipelines to ensure the fuel in the tank smoothly reaches the ignition device, enabling the flames ejected to achieve the firepower required to activate the sensor.

After the Utility is unlocked, you can use the Levitator to connect the <color=#ffd12f>fuel pipelines</color> to the remaining section. Adjust the direction of the <color=#ffd12f>fuel pipelines</color> by rotating them with the Levitator.

A poor-quality spear barrel will be destroyed after the Hit Gauge is full, granting the Resonator a temporary <color=#ffd12f>Immunity</color> to the surrounding Incinero Petal Pollens.\nA good-quality spear barrel will not be destroyed after the Hit Gauge is full. It can be used to assemble the <color=#ffd12f>Explosive Spear</color>.
Attack the spear barrel with your weapon to build up the Hit Gauge displayed at the top.

After the Utility is unlocked, you can use the Levitator to throw the <color=#ffd12f>Explosive Spear</color> at the enemies, dealing AoE multi-stage DMG.\nDefeat all Tacet Discords and protect the three Sound Emulators to complete the challenge.
You can crush the scrapped vehicles and boxes along the road. They may contain useful materials.

Transform into the Inferno Rider and speed along the track created by the floating highways.\nAs you race, you can control the Inferno Rider to wield its blade to <color=#ffd12f>destroy</color> obstacles in your path and <color=#ffd12f>avoid</color> road signs.

You can equip an <color=#ffd12f>Ultrasonic Pulse Chip</color> to launch a Water Vortex. The Water Vortex can <color=#ffd12f>clear</color> the mud along the path. Upon hitting the enemies, it can <color=#ffd12f>remove</color> the enemies' <color=#ffd12f>Mud Shields</color> and knock them back. Upon hitting the Swamp Vortex, it can trigger an <color=#ffd12f>AoE DMG</color>.

The Swamp Vortex <color=#ffd12f>knocks back</color> the units it hits and deals <color=#ffd12f>minor damage</color>. The Water Vortex released by an Ultrasonic Pulse Chip can dispel the Swamp Vortex, dealing <color=#ffd12f>a large amount of damage</color> to the enemies within the range.

After activating the Suppressor, you must <color=#ffd12f>remain within its range for a period of time</color> to advance the repair progress. When <color=#ffd12f>mud</color> and <color=#ffd12f>enemies</color> appear within the range, the Suppressor will cease to function.

The mud <color=#ffd12f>blocks the mechanisms and grants the enemies special Mud Shields</color>. The Water Vortex released by an Ultrasonic Pulse Chip and the Swamp Vortex can remove the mud and the shield it grants.

To address the issue in the Dim Forest, try to eliminate the Offshoot Cores.\nWhen the drones light up, use either <color=#ffd12f>melee or ranged</color> attacks to rotate them, directing the sound wave emitted by the central drone towards the Offshoot Core. If successful, you'll eliminate the Offshoot Core and obtain a valuable Offshoot Core sample.
<color=#b49f50>Use Waveplate</color> to claim rewards and gain EXP. Accumulate EXP to level up Union Level.
Various Utilities are available on your Terminal, making your exploration easier. Utilizing these tools well helps you uncover more mysteries.
Sensor\nThe Sensor can reveal valuable content within a certain range of area, such as <color=#b49f50>collectible items, enemy weaknesses or Acoustic Prints</color>.

Sensor II\nYou may find some Acoustic Prints concealing special information during your exploration. When you approach them, they will display certain appearance changes. Use the Sensor to uncover hidden mechanisms or supply chests.
Grappling Hook\nGrappling Hook can assist Resonators in crossing over terrains. Use it in open areas to make a leap upward, or look for Grapple Points in the map for even further travels.
Levitator\nLevitator allows you to control highlighted objects and throw them at specific targets for different effects. Use levitator to capture and manipulate these objects as needed.
After activating a Resonance Beacon, you can open the Map and fast travel to the activated Resonance Beacon.
The Resonance Nexus stores information on the surrounding area. Activate it to obtain the corresponding Map data.
Head to a Resonance Nexus to <color=#ffd12f>heal</color> injured or downed Resonators.

Injured or downed Resonators can rally at a<color=#b49f50>Resonance Nexus</color> to recover to their optimal state. \nIf you're temporarily unable to reach the nearest Resonance Nexus, you can <color=#b49f50>Cook</color> and consume food to restore Resonators' HP.

Resonance Terminal preserves relevant enemy data. Use <color=#b49f50>Sensor</color> installed with Resonance Terminal to reveal enemy <color=#b49f50>Weaknesses</color>. Attack their weaknesses with certain methods to deal more damage.
Once you reach certain Union Level caps, it is necessary to clear Ascension Quests to increase your SOL3 Phase.
The first clear of a Tacet Field will reward <color=#b49f50>Waveplate Plate</color>, which can be used to exchange for rare materials in cities.
Relic Merchant Chenpi is collecting Sonance Caskets. He's willing to pay you with various rewards in exchange for the Sonance Caskets you found.
Use the equipped Zoom Camera to locate the targets.

Certain obstacles that have been eroded with Wutherons cannot be destroyed using normal methods. It can only be broken by using Levitator to grab a nearby Tacetite Fulminates to trigger an explosion by throwing onto it.
