speaker: NPC #701094
anh_en: Students of Startorch Academy, the new season of the Startorch Race is about to begin!

speaker: NPC #701094
anh_en: Tracks with more dynamic designs, more thrilling challenges, and even richer rewards are all waiting for you!

speaker: NPC #701094
anh_en: Hop on your motorbike, head for the track, feel the thrill of the rush, and push the very limits of speed!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Hey there! Want to sign up for the Startorch Race?

speaker: NPC #700212
anh_en: Hey there! Want to sign up for the Startorch Race?

speaker: NPC #700212
anh_en: Just like Rider Huafeng, who took three championships across the seven major tracks years ago—who knows, maybe the next legend out there is you!

speaker: NPC #700212
anh_en: Alright, your registration's all set. Now shout it with me: Startorch Race—Rev it up!!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (She's really fired up.)

speaker: NPC #700212
anh_en: I'll register your details on the entry list right now so you can jump straight into the race!
Wow, that's too much.
I haven't decided whether to race yet.

speaker: NPC #700212
anh_en: The Academy is sponsoring this year's event more generously than ever before. Huge rewards, brilliantly designed tracks... there's no way you can miss it!

speaker: NPC #700212
anh_en: The buzz around the race has been fading these past few years, but our Startorch Race Fan Club will never let this event die out!

speaker: NPC #700212
anh_en: Our seniors in the club have worked for years to finally convince the Academy to raise the budget for the race!

speaker: NPC #700212
anh_en: I believe that as long as we have enough racers, a true star rider will emerge and keep this competition burning bright.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Sniff, sniff… I'm so moved. This is it… this is the Startorch Race!

speaker: NPC #700212
anh_en: Sniff, sniff… I'm so moved. This is it… this is the Startorch Race!

speaker: NPC #700212
anh_en: Anyway, while the Startorch Race is on, you can keep challenging the track as many times as you like until you set a time you're happy with.

speaker: NPC #700212
anh_en: Alright, then one last time with me—Startorch Race—Rev it up!!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Startorch Race—Rev it up!!
Startorch Race—Rev it up!!

speaker: NPC #700212
anh_en: Go! Heh heh, now that you've raced, you can feel the magic of the Startorch Race too, right? Tell me, what did you love most?
The crowd's cheers.
The thrilling tracks.
The rewards for finishing.

speaker: NPC #700212
anh_en: Great! You noticed it too! We've got more spectators this time than ever. Seeing it live... Well, that experience is something they'll never forget.

speaker: NPC #700212
anh_en: Right you are! The dodging, the outsmarting, the powering through of every trap on the track while speeding away—that's the best part of the race!

speaker: NPC #700212
anh_en: Exactly! Our club wanted everyone to unwind from classes and research, have a blast at the rally, and even walk away with real rewards. That was a major point when we negotiated the budget with the Academy!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: And here we are. This is the <color=Highlight>Synthesizer</color> Uncle Wei mentioned.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Aside from crafting materials and beefing up their quality, you can also whip up some basic potions here. It’s like a one-stop shop for all your needs, whether you’re kicking it in the city or out on an adventure.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: I’ve got some synthesis materials right here. Go ahead, give it a try.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: It might seem a bit tricky just hearing about it, but once you try it hands-on, you’ll get the hang of it real quick.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: How do you feel? Quite handy, huh?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: With technology getting fancier by the day, life’s becoming a breeze around here.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: I’m kinda curious, though. If we rallied everyone up again and asked them to bust out their most prized grub, what do you think they’d bring this time?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Oops, got a bit carried away there. Let’s hustle back to Auntie Panhua’s restaurant! Who knew making a dish would be such a mission...
Upon returning to the restaurant, you and Chixia recounted the entire tale to Panhua and shared the authentic recipe for Essence Medley Soup with her.

speaker: Speaker_193_Title
anh_en: ...I see. So that’s how it is. The Essence Medley Soup isn’t a fancy dish, just a simple recipe that’s often made and enjoyed at home. No wonder everyone’s talking about it being made from the finest Jinzhou ingredients and distilled into a single bowl.

speaker: Speaker_193_Title
anh_en: And the reason it’s so prestigious isn’t necessarily because it’s mind-blowing in terms of taste... In that case, I suppose I won’t be needing this recipe after all.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Auntie Panhua, how about giving me and {PlayerName} a shot at it together?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: While it may not end up being a regular menu item, we’ve put in a lot of effort to gather the ingredients, so it would be a shame not to at least try it. Besides, there are loads of folks out there dying to give it a try.
Can’t agree more.
We won’t know how it tastes until we give it a shot.

speaker: Speaker_193_Title
anh_en: True. You’ve gone through all the trouble to gather the ingredients. It’d be a shame not to give it a try. Come on, everyone. The stove’s right here. Let’s whip it up together!
After some dedicated effort, you successfully prepared the Essence Medley Soup together.
No, I was just invested.
Maybe I’m the legendary God of Cooking.
Looks like I’ll have to start calling you teacher.
That’s not flattery. I’ve got eyes, and I saw you handle each step with ease.
Alright, after all this effort, it’s time to take a rest.

Here you go, everyone. The rewards I promised. Three meal vouchers. Anytime you’re craving Auntie’s dishes, just swing by. One voucher equals one free meal, and there’s no limit on how many dishes you can order!
You, Chixia, and Panhua taste the Essence Medley Soup together.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The combination of bitter medicine and delightful ingredients creates a unique taste on your tongue. You notice the same intricate expression mirrored on the faces of the other two.
Well, how can I put it... It’s not exactly terrible, but...
Not good either. At the very least, it’s a far cry from the other dishes you make.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Oh no, we've come this far. Like in a typical story, it's time we proudly declare, "Thanks to our persistence, we've discovered the perfect flavor," right?
Is this one of those lessons from Hero Plays?
It’s not just “typical”, I guess.

speaker: Speaker_193_Title
anh_en: Seems like Rover's got some skill in the kitchen. Even though it's not a complex dish, you handled it like a pro, especially for a novice cook.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Wow, can you believe we’ve covered almost half of Jinzhou in just one day?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: So, while we’re in Jinzhou, let me shoulder your worries and troubles, alright?
Looks like I can’t say no.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: You can bet on this Jinzhou Speedster’s determination!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Tiring, but so worth it! I’m usually tied up with patrols, so catching up with so many friends all at once like this is a total first for me.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Introducing you to everyone, shooting the breeze... It’s like reconnecting with old friends all over again. Wait, didn’t I promise to treat you to a meal? How did it end up with you being my tour buddy instead?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: But hey, thanks to you, I finally get why folks rave about the Essence Medley Soup as they do.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Brewed from the finest Jinzhou ingredients, with every essence distilled into a single bowl... The real treasure lies in everyone’s willingness to share their most prized grub, don’t you think?
That’s the true Jinzhou flavor.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Exactly! If we were back in wartime, Auntie Panhua reminding me to eat on time, Uncle Mahe caring about my work, Koko fretting over my safety, Uncle Wei dropping knowledge bombs on me, and all the other folks in Jinzhou...

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: They’d all without a doubt open up their pantries and share their most cherished grub with us.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: As for me, I wanna be someone who can protect every single soul in Jinzhou... including you! I wanna keep you safe too! I’ve had a great time hanging out with you.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Hey ya! Long time no see, {PlayerName}. How’s it going?
Great! When should we go?

You know, that’s what I like. But hey, no pressure if spicy isn’t your thing. Auntie Panhua’s a culinary genius, whipping up many treats like Poached Chicken, Rising Loong... you name it! It’s all authentic Jinzhou cuisine!
Didn’t expect you to be a foodie too. Next time I’m on patrol and find something tasty, I’ll make sure you get a taste.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: So, we’re on for a date, right?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Let’s meet at Panhua’s Restaurant on Gourmet Street. Time-wise, just let me know before you’re ready.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: I’ll be eagerly waiting to hear from you!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Well, just calling to see what you're up to. Are you free now?
What happened?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: No worries at all! It’s no biggie, really. Well, not as huge as diving into those tokens, that’s for sure.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Remember my promise? About treating you to a nice meal? Well, since I’ve got a few days off and figured you’d be around, now’s the perfect time to cash in on that promise and invite you out.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: So, what do you say? How about this Jinzhou Speedster takes you on a culinary adventure at Auntie Panhua’s Restaurant?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: The Maocai she cooks is an explosion of spice and flavor! One gulp and you’ll feel the buzz in your bones!
Alright, it sounds spicy just as I expected.
Where there’s delicious food, there’s me.
After arriving near Panhua's Restaurant, you message Chixia and wait for a moment...

speaker: Speaker_193_Title
anh_en: Oh dear, then I must show {Male=him;Female=her} something!

speaker: Speaker_193_Title
anh_en: Any preferences or dislikes? Sweet, salty, sour, spicy, just let me know what you like. There’s always a Jinzhou cuisine for every taste!
I prefer something light, something that lets the ingredients shine.
Spicy! Give me the thrill!
I’m not picky. Chixia, any recommendations?

speaker: Speaker_193_Title
anh_en: Alright, something light... Find yourselves a spot inside. The dishes will be ready soon.
Before long, Panhua served up the dishes. The delicious pairing of sweet Candied Caltrops and slow-cooked Jinzhou Stew made you hungry.

speaker: Speaker_193_Title
anh_en: Alright, something spicy... Find yourselves a spot inside. The dishes will be ready soon.
Before long, Panhua serves the dishes. The saucy Poached Chicken, complemented by the spicy and numbing Mapo Tofu, whets your appetite.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Hmm... The Candied Caltrops is fresh with just the right sweetness; the Poached Chicken sauce is Auntie Panhua’s original, unmatched anywhere else. Oh, and the Jinzhou Stew! It’s something you can only find here. I bet you’ve never tasted anything like it! Trust me, you don’t wanna miss out on this!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Hey there, Rover! Finally found you! Hope I didn’t keep you waiting!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: I’ve decided. Let’s get all of them.
Thanks, but it’s unnecessary.
That’s too much... Can we finish them all?
We Patrollers don’t get paid a lot, but I love treating my friend to a feast once in a while. It’s just one meal, I won’t go broke!
To cater to all appetites, Auntie Panhua’s rolled out a small portion menu. Same fantastic flavors, just less food waste. So, no need to fret about over-ordering!

speaker: Speaker_193_Title
anh_en: Alright, find yourselves a spot inside. The dishes will be ready soon.
Before long, Panhua served up the dishes. The delicious mix of Candied Caltrops, Poached Chicken in sauce, and Jinzhou Stew made your mouth water.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Rover, you enjoying the meal?
Yeah, it was amazing. I’ll certainly be back for more.
Not bad.
Felt like forever. My stomach’s rumbling already.
I want something special this time.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: You got it! Next time, we’ll bring Yangyang and Baizhi along. Food’s always better with more pals, right? But what should we get then?
If you come next time, I’ll have to treat you to a taste of my famous Essence Medley Soup.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: That’s all? Seriously? Not even Auntie Panhua’s culinary magic can shake you?
Looks like I’ll have to introduce you to the wonders of the Essence Medley Soup.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Something special? Hmm, give me some time to think.
In that case, I’ll have to introduce you to the wonders of the Essence Medley Soup.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Essence Medley Soup? What’s that?

speaker: Speaker_193_Title
anh_en: It's brewed from the finest Jinzhou ingredients. Every essence is simmered and distilled into a single bowl. Some gourmets claim it's the epitome of Jinzhou's flavor, captured in a nutshell.
Don't tell me you're thinking of trying it right now...
No worries. Delicacies are always worth the wait.
Why the eager expression?
It sounds super delicious. I’m eager to give it a taste myself.
Even though I just polished off my plate, there’s always room for soup in my second stomach. Rover, fancy trying it out? Auntie Panhua, can you whip it up for us?
Whoa, did you hear that? Brewed from the finest Jinzhou ingredients! My taste buds are tingling already... Rover, fancy trying it out? Auntie Panhua, can you whip it up for us?

speaker: Speaker_193_Title
anh_en: It's not that I'm unwilling to make it right now... In fact, it's an old wartime dish, a recipe lost to the ages. We keep it alive through word of mouth, preserving its memory. Now, about its taste, people have a lot of fun debates about it, but one thing's certain: it's like a warm, fresh hug, absolutely delightful and unforgettable.

speaker: Speaker_193_Title
anh_en: However, while searching through old books, I stumbled upon its recipe. Though, calling it a recipe might be a stretch. See, back then, they used names for ingredients that are like riddles to us now. “Red beads,” “sweet roots,” “Monkvyrid,” “golden handle spoon”... I have no idea what they are.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Speaking of peculiar ingredients, it does remind me of someone...
Who?

speaker: Speaker_193_Title
anh_en: Stop beating around the bush. Just tell me. I won’t take offense.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Well… it’s Uncle Mahe!
Ah, my bad! Let’s not dilly-dally any longer. Trust me, once we munch, you won’t wanna stop!

speaker: Speaker_193_Title
anh_en: Hmph, he’s always bragging about how he can get any ingredient, but if he’s clueless about these, he’s just wasting his time in this business.

speaker: Speaker_193_Title
anh_en: Just so we’re clear, I won’t go to him for answers, but if you want to give him a shot with this recipe, it’s your call.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Auntie Panhua! You’ve got the sweetest heart. I always knew it!

speaker: Speaker_193_Title
anh_en: Alright, I’ll copy the recipe for you.
I’ll take a stroll around the city with Chixia to get a feel for the place.
Once the soup’s done, don’t forget to let us have a taste!

speaker: Speaker_193_Title
anh_en: Don’t worry! I won’t let you do it for nothing! Auntie here will make sure you eat your fill!
Aw, you’re too kind, but eating always comes first! Let’s dive straight into ordering and kick-start this feast!

speaker: Speaker_193_Title
anh_en: Ah, well, look who’s here! Our little Xiaofang has brought a friend along today. How delightful!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: No, no, no, Auntie Panhua, just forget that name! I’m begging you!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Yeah, exactly! Meet Rover, my awesome new friend! Today’s treat’s on me, so I brought {Male=him;Female=her} here to experience your culinary magic.

speaker: Speaker_192_Title
anh_en: Well, well, look who’s here. Chixia, back at it with the deliveries, eh?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Their dynamic is something else, like straight out of a Hero Play, you know? She’s all caring, and he’s all caring, but she’s playing it cool like she doesn’t care. You catch my drift?
I see. They’re doing that whole "acting-cold-but-secretly-caring" thing, right?
Oh my, it’s like a puzzle! Impossible to crack.
Chixia, you seem to know a lot.
Oh yeah! That’s right! Didn’t realize you had such a knack for summarizing. You must be a big fan of Hero Plays, am I right?
Never mind. Relationships are like tangled webs, even I can’t untangle them!
Of course! I’m like a walking encyclopedia for all things in Jinzhou! Worries and woes, they’re all part of the package when dealing with relationships!

speaker: Speaker_192_Title
anh_en: ...Ah, I see. This recipe seems to be quite old. It uses old-fashioned aliases instead of the ones we’re familiar with, making it tricky to decipher.

speaker: Speaker_192_Title
anh_en: Let me see... The red gems here must be Gemberries. Sweet roots are Caltrops, and there’s also Kudzu, Honeysuckles... Lucky for you, I’ve got all these ingredients. I’ll sort them out for you later.
Uncle Mahe’s got quite the collection here.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Nah, that makes me sound like a delivery person. Besides, I’ve got a whole bunch of other stuff on my plate, you know? But hey, I’m here to ask you to check out this recipe.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Absolutely! Uncle Mahe’s the go-to guy for anything and everything in Jinzhou. Not only food ingredients, he can get you many strange things!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: If there’s anything you wanna buy, just come take a look.

speaker: Speaker_192_Title
anh_en: Chixia, you’re being too kind. It’s entirely all thanks to everyone in the neighborhood supporting my business. If you need anything, just let me know.
Sure, I will.
Thank you, Uncle Mahe.

speaker: Speaker_192_Title
anh_en: But here's the snag: the recipe calls for water from the Monkvyrid, and there's this other ingredient called golden handle spoon. Honestly, I'm clueless about these two.

speaker: Speaker_192_Title
anh_en: I know every food alias in the book, and these two are clearly not food ingredients.

speaker: Speaker_192_Title
anh_en: I’m not good at cooking, but this recipe looks like it could be a medicinal cuisine or a chowder because it has many different ingredients in small amounts. What’s your take?
Are we looking in the wrong direction?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Maybe...? I got it! If it’s a medicinal recipe, we can go ask Koko at Shifang Pharmacy! She’s all about that medicinal recipe life, so she might just have the hookup.

speaker: Speaker_192_Title
anh_en: Haha, but I truly owe you big time for lending a hand. You’re the reason those elderly folks with mobility issues get their goods on time. Thanks!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Thanks for the inspiration! Uncle Mahe, how much are these ingredients? I’ll cover the bill.

speaker: Speaker_192_Title
anh_en: Hey, they’re free. You’ve been an enormous help, and I appreciate it. Plus, I have a thing for Panhua... er, for what Panhua wants to make. Count me in for a taste, alright?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: You betcha! If Auntie Panhua whips this up, you’re getting a front-row seat to taste it!

speaker: Speaker_192_Title
anh_en: You’re always on the go, I see. You’re always there to help, whether it’s on patrols or off duty. I suppose deciphering this recipe is just another one of your good deeds?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Well, yeah... But fun fact, it’s Auntie Panhua who gave me this recipe.

speaker: Speaker_192_Title
anh_en: What? Is she in trouble? Hand over the recipe!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: After listening to your explanation, Mahe scrutinizes the old recipe.
Hmm? There’s clearly something going on between them!
Hey, Uncle Mahe, did you catch any hints?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: We’ve covered more ground from Gourmet Street to here. Bet you haven’t had many city strolls like this before, huh?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Even though it’s a bit of a trek, I’m thrilled to show you around my hometown. We’re nearing the Main Street, where things get even more interesting.
Hello there, how can I help...? Oh, Ms. Chixia?
Alright, let’s cut to the chase. {PlayerName} and I are here to get you to check out this recipe Auntie Panhua handed us.
Essence Medley Soup? I felt like I heard it from my grandmother or someone of her generation.
Really? C’mon, wrack your brain for it! Uncle Mahe thinks it’s more of a medicinal cuisine than a regular dish.

Let's see... Caltrops, Kudzu, Honeysuckles, a handful of Gemberries, and some pulled poultry breast. Simmer with water from the Monkvyrid. Once it's boiled, give it a stir with a golden-handled spoon... Water from the Monkvyrid? Isn't that the medicinal soup made from Coriolus, Perilla, and Lemongrass?

speaker: Speaker_125_Title
anh_en: Who knew the medicinal soup could serve as a base... In a way, it leans towards medicinal cuisine. But with so many ingredients, wouldn’t it dilute the medicinal effect? There’s always something new to learn in dietary therapy.
Since we know the ingredients required, Chixia and I will head out and grab what we need.
Are you interested in dietary therapy?
No need to go through all that trouble. Remember where you are? A pharmacy! I’ve got some pre-made medicinal soup right here.
Good medicine often tastes bitter, so I've been thinking of ways to make it more palatable.
By making it into medicinal cuisine, we preserve its healing qualities while getting rid of the bitterness, so it’s enjoyable for everyone.

speaker: Speaker_125_Title
anh_en: What brought you here? Picking up medicine for someone else, or feeling under the weather? Any injuries? Have you seen a doctor? Need any prescriptions?

speaker: Speaker_125_Title
anh_en: This recipe seems ancient. The Monkvyrid water is an old term from pharmacies, referring to that medicinal soup. Hold on, I’ve got the pre-made stuff for you.

speaker: Speaker_125_Title
anh_en: Oh, and here are some new recovery and synthesis potions. Consider them a bonus.

speaker: Speaker_125_Title
anh_en: But even with potions to treat your injuries, stay safe out there, alright? Always keep your guard up when exploring.

speaker: Speaker_125_Title
anh_en: Don’t be like Chixia, just barging in and scaring everyone.
Thanks for reminding me.
Trust me. I won’t.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Are you for real right now? My reputation as the Jinzhou Speedster is...
I-I had no other choice! How can I remember all those safety rules when there are bad guys coming at me? They’d only slow me down... Okay, okay, next time, I’ll watch out!

speaker: Speaker_125_Title
anh_en: So, are you two heading back to help Auntie Panhua with this Essence Medley Soup? If so, count me in on learning that recipe too!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Just let Auntie Panhua know. It should be cool for you to join in!
Wow, quite the enthusiastic welcome there.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: But there's still one last piece of the puzzle to crack: the golden-handled spoon. If we whip up the soup without figuring out what that is about, the flavor might not hit the mark, right?

speaker: Speaker_125_Title
anh_en: Wait, isn’t the golden handle spoon that big pyrite spoon from Uncle Wei’s shop? I thought you both knew.
The answer was right in front of us all along.
That makes sense... After all, pyrite is called fool’s gold.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Seriously? No way! Who’d have guessed that!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Oops, looks like I gotta step down from my role as the Jinzhou encyclopedia. I’ve never even heard of that pyrite spoon!

speaker: Speaker_125_Title
anh_en: Haha, no worries. I spotted that spoon the last time I dropped off medicine at Uncle Wei’s and asked out of curiosity.

speaker: Speaker_125_Title
anh_en: Why does the best weapon maker in Jinzhou have a big pyrite spoon tucked away? Well, I’m counting on you to solve that mystery, along with the last step of the recipe.
It seems you get worried for her pretty often.
Oh no, it’s just a habit I’ve picked up from running this pharmacy. Sometimes people struggle to describe their symptoms, so I ask a lot of questions to get a clearer picture.
Yeah... Hold up! Rover, what’s that supposed to mean? Obviously, I...
Obviously, just like this {Male=gentleman;Female=lady} said, once you get carried away, you forget your own safety!
Ms. Chixia, you’re the reigning champ on our pharmacy’s medication leaderboard. While I wholeheartedly appreciate your support, topping the charts won’t result in any discounts here.
Seriously, don’t you have work to do? Who keeps tabs on this stuff anyway!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Check it out. That’s Uncle Wei’s weapon shop right over there.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: He’s the top-notch weapon maker in Jinzhou! If you have any weapon-related questions, just go ask him.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: How’s your weapon maintenance? Once we figure out what that big spoon deal is, you can ask him to check it for you!

speaker: Speaker_102_Title
anh_en: Well, well, if it isn’t our Xiaofang. Back so soon? Didn’t I just fix up your pistols last week? You broke them again already?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: The recipe says we need to stir it with a golden-handled spoon once it starts bubbling. And Koko mentioned you happen to have a pyrite spoon with that exact name, right?

speaker: Speaker_102_Title
anh_en: Ah, I see.

speaker: Speaker_102_Title
anh_en: That’s right. The golden handle spoon, indeed the pyrite spoon I have. And let me tell you, I have a bit of history with this Essence Medley Soup. Any guess what this soup is all about?
A secret medicinal cuisine.
A secret dish.
A chowder.
Just a simple brew of herbs, really. Barely qualifies as medicinal cuisine in my book.
Well, I don’t think it’s a formal dish, seeing as we just throw a bunch of ingredients together.
Haha, you have the point. It’s indeed a chowder, but not an ordinary one.

speaker: Speaker_102_Title
anh_en: You youngsters didn’t witness the making of this soup. Back then, Jinzhou was still under construction, right around the year-end. Every household would bring out their cherished foods to share. And if they had nothing, they’d whip up some medicinal soup. If that wasn’t an option, they’d pitch in however they could.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: ...Aw, please don’t call me Xiaofang! It’s Chixia!

speaker: Speaker_102_Title
anh_en: And that’s when I forged this large pyrite spoon. Made stirring that big pot a breeze. What a shame though, those border guards insisted on every bit of metal being used for weapons. Otherwise, you’d still see it around.
So that’s the authentic Essence Medley Soup.
So that’s the real recipe.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: No wonder Auntie Panhua said it’s passed down through word of mouth, sparking debates over its flavor.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Seems like this recipe is more of a shopping list than a detailed guide.
I know it must be delicious.
Is it really going to taste good?
Absolutely! Every household pulled out their secret stash of ingredients to brew up this soup. It’s gotta be divine.
Even if it doesn’t require any fancy cooking techniques, those good reviews can’t be bogus, right? Just like Auntie Panhua said, it’s brewed from the finest Jinzhou ingredients...

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Now I’m even more eager to get a taste, knowing the backstory! Uncle Wei, mind lending us your big pyrite spoon?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Oh no, I'm doomed. It seems everyone knows my other name now.

speaker: Speaker_102_Title
anh_en: The reason that the spoon affects the soup's flavor is because it releases a few minerals while stirring. You could use a smaller pyrite spoon instead.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: That makes sense... By the way, doesn’t Auntie Panhua already have one on standby?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Since we’re here, might as well make the most of it. Can you lend a hand and check out my friend’s weapon?

speaker: Speaker_102_Title
anh_en: Ah, I remember you. New to Jinzhou, right? You’re that... that...
{PlayerName}.
Rover.

speaker: Speaker_102_Title
anh_en: That’s right. Madam Magistrate mentioned you’re Jinzhou’s guest.

speaker: Speaker_102_Title
anh_en: Let’s have a look at your weapon... Hm, this wear and tear... Can’t let youngsters like you wander around with a weapon in this state.

speaker: Speaker_102_Title
anh_en: Here, take these unused <color=Highlight>casting molds and ores</color> the Ordnance Division gave me. They’re the building blocks of a weapon. With these, you can forge a new one.
I feel bad for taking them...

speaker: Speaker_102_Title
anh_en: Haha, you’re exaggerating. As far as I know, only we, your old pals, are calling you that.
Thank you so much.

speaker: Speaker_102_Title
anh_en: Kid, materials are meant to be used. If you want to thank me, put them to good use.
Uncle Wei, no need to tease her.
Got it now, Xiaofang.
Cool, cool. Let’s get to business then.
{PlayerName}, you too?! No, please no... Let’s keep that name between us, alright?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Anyway, we're here to help Auntie Panhua recreate the Essence Medley Soup.

speaker: Speaker_102_Title
anh_en: Well, this weapon looks decent enough. Take care of it, alright?

speaker: Speaker_102_Title
anh_en: If you don’t like what you’re currently using or want another one made, come find me anytime. As long as you've got the <color=Highlight>casting molds and ores</color>, I'll make it for you.
Thank you, Uncle Wei.

speaker: Speaker_102_Title
anh_en: No need to be so formal, kid. I’m not really useful for much else besides tinkering with weapons.

speaker: Speaker_102_Title
anh_en: Just so you know, the ores and materials I just gave you aren’t top-notch. For higher-quality stuff, you’ll want to check out the Synthesizer.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Oh, I heard about it! It's a new type of device the Academy introduced a couple of years back, right over there!

speaker: Speaker_102_Title
anh_en: Well, since you know the place, how about having Chixia show you the way there? If you’re short on materials, I can...

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Hey, no worries, Uncle Wei. I just snagged some synthesis materials recently. Rover can borrow mine!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Once we check out the Synthesizer, we’ll head straight back to Auntie Panhua’s restaurant. Just sit tight for the good news about whipping up that Essence Medley Soup.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: Hello, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: Ah, you're quite optimistic, young one.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: You've seen the crisis at Mt. Firmament, yet you're not scared, are you?
What do you mean?

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: You remind me of Xinyi the first time I saw her.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: You are both someone who lived through turbulent times and stood tall against all odds.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: Forgive me, I've lost myself. I wanted to see you because I have something to give you.
Uncle Fu takes out a scale-like object and hands it over to you solemnly.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: Here you are.
This is…?

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: When I first became the Mayor of Hongzhen, I came across this thing on one of my walks in the mountains.
Hello, Uncle Fu.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: At first, I was intrigued by its peculiar shape, so I brought it back to town with me. But afterward, it revealed some truly amazing power.
What is it?
Can it turn back time?

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: Well, no... Listen, I might be old, but I've always let nature take its course.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: People age and die, even in Hongzhen. The Sentinel's power could only slow down time but not reverse it.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: This scale—It seems like it has captured Hongzhen in a frozen slice of time.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: A few nights after I found it, I dreamed of the moment I picked it up.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: The dream felt as real as life. I could even see the falling snow clearly—as if time had frozen.
How incredible…
Amazing.
Hello, and you are…?

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: Yeah, I was elated by the surprise like you did.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: I kept going back to it for the better half of a month until I finally realized I wasn't dreaming that night.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: Though small, this scale contains unimaginable power. When I carry it, it records my experiences and lets me relive them later.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: I call this ability "Chrono Tracing". With it, I can see and hear everything I've experienced before and even talk to those people in the Chrono Trace…

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: I used this ability to record every detail in Hongzhen. It certainly made the compilation of the Hongzhen Chronicle much easier.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: During the day, I'd go through the archives and visit residents. At night, I used this magical token to organize the information I'd gathered.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: As I was ankle deep in the governing affairs... I couldn't picture what a lousy job I would have done on my official duties without its help.
...Can I really have it?
Maybe it's better to give it to Xinyi?
Why don't you keep it yourself?

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: Haha, what a polite young {Male=lad;Female=lass}.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: Hahaha, before I answer your question, let me ask you one.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: Guess what I recorded the most with this scale?
Important events.
Important people.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: At first, I used it solely for important events. But as time passed, I changed the way I handled it.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: You're right. After I had stepped down as the Mayor of Hongzhen, I was no longer involved in Hongzhen's affairs.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: When I handed over the position to Xinyi, I gave this scale to her as well.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: But she was a considerate one and soon returned it to me.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: For she saw that I found I needed it more. So rather than using it to archive the nitty-gritty of her work, she allowed me to record the people I cherished.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: I watched many kids in Hongzhen grow up and leave.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: I'm the one who had witnessed Hongzhen grow into what it is today before I handed it over to Xinyi.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: At first, I thought they’d come back someday, but I realized I'd never see many of them again.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: Over the years, I've really missed those young folks who left Mt. Firmament for new lives.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: So, I used the scale to create a Chrono Trace for nearly every resident in Hongzhen.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: Whenever I missed them, I visited and talked to them in those Chrono Traces.
Uncle Fu…

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: Alright, enough talk about me. Let's talk about you, {PlayerName}?

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: Something tells me this scale is related to Jué.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: Back then, I thought Hongzhen needed Xinyi more than me, just like Jinhsi did Jué.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: I've built my life around this town, but you, {PlayerName}, you're not bound to Hongzhen or even Huanglong.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: There's a world of expanse out there awaiting your exploration and many interesting souls for you to bond with.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: Alas, let the past stay in the past… Just call me Uncle Fu.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: You'll need this scale more than I do... Or, rather, you two fit right together.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: You can give it Chrono Traces that I can't, showing it truly important moments.
Thank you, Uncle Fu.
I'll make good use of it.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: Haha, you're welcome.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: I have a feeling you're different from those who never return.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: However far you go, when you're tired, you're always welcome back to Mt. Firmament.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: You know where to find me. Let me know when you want to catch up over a pot of tea.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: So, what do you think about Hongzhen nowadays?
Something's brewing up.
Better days are ahead.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: There you are! Right on time, {PlayerName}.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: ...No, it wasn't us.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: This is a first for us as well. The invitation undeniably carries the deep dream frequencies of the Somnoire, but… that's a dreamscape. Objects from a dream aren't supposed to manifest in reality.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: We have two theories. One, the Somnoire has developed a consciousness of its own. Two, someone within the Somnoire possesses an ability powerful enough to shatter the boundary between dreams and reality, someone we never knew existed.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: And now, they've sent an invitation. Maybe a path to the deeper layers of the Somnoire has finally opened.
That sounds like trouble.
Or… maybe it's just a new film festival?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: It does. While we can't determine the host's true intentions yet, one thing is certain: neither of us Gatekeepers can access the deeper layers. Only you can.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: You're right. There's no reason to dismiss that idea. The Somnoire is a place of endless possibilities. Maybe something new has come into existence, and it doesn't necessarily spell trouble.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: But neither of us Gatekeepers can access the deeper layers. Only you can.
What happened?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Looks like I don't have much of a choice.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: If it turns out to be safe, enjoy the festival. We'll be waiting for your return.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: Don't worry. There's no immediate crisis that requires your attention… at least, not yet.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: This time, it's an invitation we never saw coming.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name

Did you two organize this?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen

Did the Order anticipate this situation?

speaker: NPC #300067
anh_en: Ah, yes. We've set aside some Sacred Salt in the Fabricatorium for times like this. It's kept in the Triptych Chests and other places...

speaker: NPC #300067

It's a deal.
What's going on?

speaker: NPC #300067
anh_en: I'm collecting Sacred Salt for future needs.

speaker: NPC #300067
anh_en: There is no room for errors in the work of a Steward. I must take great care of the Acolytes' welfare.

speaker: NPC #300067
anh_en: The martyrs sacrificed everything for the cause of saving Ragunna. Even in failure, they are entitled to live out their days in peace...
So the Sacred Salt is for them?

speaker: NPC #300067
anh_en: Yes. For they hold onto the belief that anything untouched by the Sentinel's grace on this blessed land could be potentially tainted or cursed by the Threnodian.

speaker: NPC #300067
anh_en: That's why I would perform cleansing and consecration rites with Sacred Salt on all provisions before their eyes.

speaker: NPC #300067
anh_en: To lead them into thinking they're taking the Divinity's nurturing meal, drinking holy blood that grants enlightenment. So they have no reason to refuse.

speaker: NPC #300067
anh_en: Thank you for your help and devotion. Please, take a look and see if anything catches your fancy.

speaker: NPC #300067
anh_en: May the Sentinel always bless you.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Like this? No, that's not it... How...

Any longtime client benefits?

speaker: NPC #800091
anh_en: The data from this experiment looks positive as well...
About the Academy's research project...

speaker: NPC #800091
anh_en: Hi {PlayerName}. Have you given our latest technology a whirl yet?

Not yet.

speaker: NPC #800091
anh_en: Everyone back at the lab was really excited when they heard you would be assisting our research again.

speaker: NPC #800091

anh_en: I'm sorry, but I can't tell you now. Not yet.

anh_en: You have keen eyes. As I expected.

How did you learn about this research project?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: This should be the projection thing Qinggong was talking about... I should try it out.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: {PlayerName}, I've just sensed a Dreamscape Node being restored in the Sanguis Plateaus. And no surprise, it was your doing.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: How extraordinary... If it's not too much trouble, could you restore the remaining nodes, {PlayerName}? I'll mark their locations for you.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: If my suspicions are correct, the answer to the sword's origin is hidden within the remaining nodes.

speaker: NPC #50161
anh_en: You describe what happened to the Ebony Gatekeeper.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: A dark sword burning in flames, with Nightmares bearing Dark Tide frequencies coming out of it when touched? Could it be...
It was suppressing the Nightmare Tacet Discords.
Was it guarding the Dreamscape Node?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Indeed... That appears to be the case. The question is,  who placed the sword there?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: I cannot say for certain. It might have been placed there solely to suppress the Tacet Discords. But... by whom?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Was it a unique Resonator who could perceive the Dreamscapes, or could this power originate from the Somnoire itself?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: When that sword disappeared, I felt a warm frequency in the wind.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: {PlayerName}... Many years ago, I learned a line of a poem... in a dream, from someone in Huanglong.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Ah, yes. I've discovered something interesting within the final Node of the Sanguis Plateaus.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: As their long-awaited hero, you should take it.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: It goes... "Their forms did fall, yet souls endure unbound. Valiant in death, as heroes they are crowned."

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Sounds like you've figured out those swords?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Yes. And it would seem I've made an error of judgment on my part.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: They originated from neither a Resonator nor a Somnoire... There was no need for them to be "unique." They are merely the dreams of the fallen from Septimont, who couldn't reach the Somnoire.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Merely dreams?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Indeed. Dreams. No matter how much they burned, the warriors could not eliminate the Nightmares. The best they could do was trap them, biding their time until the arrival of a "hero."

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: And that was why the frequencies that constituted those swords ultimately faded, reaching for Septimont...

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: They were hoping to return home. The warriors of Septimont would much rather return to their homeland than find eternal peace in Dreamscapes.

speaker: NPC #300052
anh_en: Beep... Come get your rewards! The victory is yours!

speaker: NPC #850306
anh_en: Step away from my statues if you do not wish to taste defeat.

speaker: NPC #850306
anh_en: You! Show me what you're made of.

speaker: NPC #850306
anh_en: I have been outmatched. I am humbled.

speaker: NPC #850306
anh_en: Is that all?

speaker: NPC #850306
anh_en: Back for more? Take this!

speaker: NPC #300052
anh_en: Beep... Banners stand tall, victory always calls! Banners stand tall, victory always calls! Beep...

anh_en: Beep... Greetings, fearless Gladiator! Here in Septimont, our champions revel in sculptures, hunts, and the roaring cheers of horns. But remember, a peaceful Septimont depends on every hero to track down those pesky Tacet Discords!

speaker: NPC #300052
anh_en: That's why we are throwing a simulated hunt in the chaotic twists and turns of the drained Old District!

speaker: NPC #300052
anh_en: Are you ready to fight? Heart pounding, blood burning? Hunt down those Tacet Discords, rack up points, and charge into the next round!
Any rewards?

speaker: NPC #300052
anh_en: Beep... You have successfully conquered the highest difficulty! Victory is yours! Victory is yours!

speaker: NPC #300052
anh_en: Beep... Challenge complete! The victory is yours!

speaker: NPC #300052
anh_en: Beep! You are the final winner! Congratulations!

speaker: NPC #300052

speaker: NPC #300052
anh_en: And now, you may receive the Blessings of the Banners.

speaker: NPC #300052
anh_en: Beep... Caution caution caution! If you accept the Blessings of the Banners, all your enhancements will be removed, and some changes may occur in the Old District. HOWEVER! In exchange, you'll be granted special blessings! Beep!

speaker: NPC #300052
anh_en: Beep... Behold! This is the Banner of Conquest, provided by the Septimont Agon Committee. Activate it, and it'll help you clear the Tacet Discords!

speaker: NPC #300052
anh_en: A large banner like this can only be activated when no Tacet Discords are nearby. Of course, it'll provide a greater boost boost boost! Beep—

speaker: NPC #300052
anh_en: Caution caution caution! Some banners have been claimed by stronger enemies! Don't let your guard down! They're not easy to tackle! But if you can defeat them, we'll reclaim those areas!

speaker: NPC #300052
anh_en: So, in this challenge, our goal is—
To defeat the enemies and claim victory.
To get the banners and reclaim the areas.

speaker: NPC #300052
anh_en: That's right! You caught on real quick! Onward, Fearless Gladiator! The banners stand tall, victory always calls! May you be showered in the cheers of triumph!

speaker: NPC #300052
anh_en: These banners are scattered across the Old District, waiting for you to discover! Beep!

speaker: NPC #300052
anh_en: For these small banners, you can activate them directly.

speaker: NPC #300052
anh_en: Beep... Wow, that was impressive! The victory is yours!

speaker: NPC #300052
anh_en: Beep... You're truly the greatest Gladiator! The victory is yours!

speaker: NPC #900094
anh_en: Oh... my soulmate, my king of inspiration... what has happened to you...

speaker: NPC #900095
anh_en: *Buzz—buzz—whirr—clickety-clack—*

speaker: NPC #900094
anh_en: Oh... my soulmate, my king of inspiration... what has happened to you...

speaker: NPC #900094
anh_en: Once I finally finished my work, I realized Melody had already ended up like this...

speaker: NPC #900095
anh_en: *Buzz—buzz buzz—whimper—*

speaker: NPC #900094
anh_en: It can no longer perform entire melodies. Even its voice shows signs of "distortion"... Melody... without you, how am I supposed to live?
Maybe it's because it has listened to too many different things...
All work and no play makes even the sharpest mind dull...

speaker: NPC #900094
anh_en: Sure... It seems likely... Ah, my friend, judging by your posture and attire, you must be a seasoned adventurer.

speaker: NPC #900094
anh_en: Have you heard or recorded any particularly memorable music during your adventure?

speaker: NPC #900094
anh_en: Could you share them with Melody? This might ease its "symptoms"...

speaker: NPC #900095
anh_en: *Buzz—buzz—whirr—clickety-clack—*

speaker: NPC #900094
anh_en: Transform? Melody can't do that, I'm afraid... Hello, traveler from afar. My name is Tommaso, and I am a musician. This here is my Echo partner, the "Aria Mummer" Melody.

speaker: NPC #900094
anh_en: Melody possesses the ability to capture every melody it hears and orchestrate its surrounding "Melody Ensemble" to replay them.

speaker: NPC #900094
anh_en: I have known Melody for many years, and it is thanks to its presence that I can savor those fleeting melodies, with an endless stream of inspiration flowing to me each day.

speaker: NPC #900094
anh_en: We often venture out together to gather inspirations, but lately, with preparations for the Carnevale, I've been caught up and had to leave Melody to handle it alone in the city.

speaker: NPC #900094
anh_en: Friend, during our adventure, have you ever heard or recorded any music that left a particularly deep impression on you?

speaker: NPC #900094
anh_en: Could you share them with Melody? This might ease its "symptoms"...

speaker: NPC #900094
anh_en: Oh... oh! Yes! This is the sound Melody was meant to have! This... this is true music!

speaker: NPC #900094
anh_en: I have always believed, alongside Melody, that great music has the power to touch others and inspire change.

speaker: NPC #900094
anh_en: Please accept these as a token of my gratitude for your help!

speaker: NPC #900094
anh_en: Hmm... So, what you're saying is, these are the things you've gathered through countless adventures in this vast world? Like a... response from the world to you?

speaker: NPC #900094
anh_en: During your adventure, if you happen to gather other "Melody Boxes," please lend a hand to the other "Aria Mummers" as well.

speaker: NPC #900094
anh_en: Thank you! Traveler from afar! This… "Melody Box" in your hands, where did you find it? Such wondrous music, captured on a tiny disc like this...
Just a stroke of luck.
Adapted from True Experiences.
I am merely a porter in this world.

speaker: NPC #900094
anh_en: I once heard a saying: All the music in this world is prewritten by the divine, scattered across the land. It is the duty of musicians to discover and record them.

speaker: NPC #900094
anh_en: It seems Melody and I should venture beyond Ragunna City and explore the wider world.

speaker: NPC #900094
anh_en: In the cacophony of the world's sounds, the lifelong challenge for every musician is to distill the purest melodies... and "Aria Mummers" are no exception.

speaker: NPC #900094
anh_en: Perhaps within Rinascita, you may encounter other "Aria Mummers." They might be facing similar challenges.

anh_en: Ack... My hand. Age is finally catching up to me, I guess...

anh_en: Look. Up there! He can't get down!

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: Help, help!
Leave it to me.

anh_en: Our job is to take pictures and share the beauty of the world with people who can't travel.

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: I've been working hard for this goal. I may not look the part now, but when I was younger, I traveled across mountains and rivers, taking countless photos, and some of which even won awards!

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: But all of that is in the past. I'm getting old and close to retirement...

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: And now my hand is busted, which is just great. *sigh* With only three places left to go, too. I guess I won't be able to finish the last set of photos before I retire...

It's not a big deal.
How should I do it?

anh_en: Ah! Take my camera. All you need to do is aim it at the scenery you want to shoot and press the shutter release, and the moment will be forever captured...

speaker: Bác Văn

speaker: Bác Văn

speaker: Bác Văn

speaker: Bác Văn

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: That's how I started learning photography, which got better and better by the day. And so did Jinzhou started to thrive.

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: There were more people on the streets, more shops, and businesses more prosperous. It was a good time.

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: Okay, I think that’s enough mumbling. Please excuse me, I can't stop thinking about things like this once I start.

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: We should move on to the next scenery. And the place is...

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: Oh! I’ve got an idea! Do you like cats?
I do.
Sorry. I'm a dog person.
Meow.

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: That's great! Little kitties, fluffy and adorable. Everyone loves them!
Here you go.

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: Haha, dogs are nice too! But...

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: You sure know how to be a cat!

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: Next, I would like you to take a picture of a cat. Sounds good?
Not a problem.

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: I'll mark the location for you. Off we go.

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: Let's see here... It's spectacular! You're quite natural for photography, aren't you?

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: Just look at the transparency of this pond!

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: I really liked this place when I was a kid. I’d always come here by myself to play.

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: My parents was worried that I might end up go swimming in it or something on my own, so they gave me a camera.

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: My dad said if I saw anything I liked, I should take a picture of it.

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: Well, with something expensive in my hands, I wouldn’t dare jump into the water with it.

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: But I ended up taking a lot of photos because of it.

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: Right there. See those cats, you can go give them a pet if you’d like.

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: Well? Let see that cute furball.

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: Then one day I happened to pass by and saw these kittens. There were also people coming over to feed and take care of them.

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: I even asked around, and to my delight the calico ended up being adopted by a lovely family.

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: *chuckle* That's my story with cats. Now there’s only one more place left to go. And I have a favor to ask.

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: I’d like to ask you to take a picture of me in the residential area. I wish to make it the the final photo of the collection.

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: I need to make some preparations. Why don’t we meet there in a bit?
Here you go.

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: Beautiful photo. Look how relaxed he is taking its nap. He looks so comfortable.

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: There used to be some small kittens around here as well. I’d come see them whenever I was back from a business trip.

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: And there was a calico just like this one. He grew pretty close to me.

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: I’d often come see him, bring him something to eat, stroke his hair.

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: It’s a shame that I was busy with work and traveled a lot, so I couldn’t bring him home.

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: One time, I was away on a long business trip and I couldn’t find him anywhere after I came back.

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: It made me a bit sad so I stopped visiting for while.

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: How’s the photo? Let’s give it a look.

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: Yeah. I really appreciate your help today. If it wasn't for you, it would’ve been really hard for me to fulfill my wish of capturing the moments of Jinzhou!

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: I plan to mail these photos back to the publishing, crediting your name on them. Oh, dear. We’ve been so preoccupied with the photos, I haven’t got the chance to get your name yet.
The esteemed Rover, at your service.
{PlayerName}.

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: Got it. I am in your debt!

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: You must accept these as your reward. Keep my camera as well.

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: It's an old pal of mine. Visited countless places with me over the years. I believe it deserves to continue its journey of capturing the beauties of the world with you.

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: I trust you and your talent. Also, how about considering becoming a journalist in your free time?
Here you go.

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: Oh, I'm so sorry. I’ve stared at it for too long.

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: I used to take pictures here with my family, just like that family.

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: It’s a family thing for us to take a picture here each year. I used to stand in the middle, with my dad having to hold me up just to get in the picture frame when I was younger.

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: After I grew older, I got big enough to wrap my arms around my parents' shoulders for the pictures.

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: The amount of family photos grew less after I left home for my job. Now, they're not here anywhere, but...

speaker: Bác Văn
anh_en: Taking another photo here at the same spot, can count as telling them I'm doing pretty well, right?

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Hello, {PlayerName}. Can you hear me...? It is I, the Ebony Gatekeeper.
Hello?
You're breaking up.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: The dreamscape seems to be experiencing some kind of interference... Ah, there, it's working again.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: If possible, I'd like to speak with you in person. I'll be expecting you, Dreamwalker.
Come again?
Why are you calling me?
Hello, and I'm the Ivory Gatekeeper.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Ahem. I am the Administrator of the <ano=domain of dreams>Somnoire</ano>, the Ebony Gatekeeper.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Well... to see you about matters concerning Somnoire naturally.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Ahem. Maybe save the jokes for later, Dreamwalker.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: I was wondering if you have noticed... A gateway to the Somnoire has started to appear in Rinascita.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: (Muffled voice)

speaker: NPC #700101
anh_en: Ah. {PlayerName}. You have arrived.

speaker: NPC #700101
anh_en: Ahem... Well... Yes, you're absolutely correct. It was me who you spoke to.

speaker: NPC #700101
anh_en: I indeed owe you an apology for engaging you in the experiment to test out the new Gateway through a false identity. It was all part of my plan to save those dreams... One which you've thwarted.
Okay, out with it. What are you up to this time?

speaker: NPC #700101
anh_en: Please, Dreamwalker. I assure you that I have no secrets to hide.

speaker: NPC #700101
anh_en: I've been optimizing the memory storage logic of a few Memory Zones, and if all goes accordingly the Somnoire should be able to house more dreams with its current space.

speaker: NPC #700101
anh_en: Yet I've discovered impurities lingering within the dreams of Rinascita. When the Dreamscape Nodes in Rinascita were activated, these impurities flooded in Somnoire along with the dreams.
What are these impurities?

speaker: NPC #700101
anh_en: Unlike what we've handled before, they are composed of something more sinister than negative emotions in nightmares. Something that's close to a spiritual plague. However, I have yet to achieve a definitive answer.

speaker: NPC #700101
anh_en: More Memory Zones fall under their influence as we speak. If left untreated, they could not only put my work on hold but also undermine the integrity of the Somnoire itself.

speaker: NPC #700101
anh_en: Dreamwalker, I wish to seek your aid in handling these impurities. But not for me, for the entire Somnoire.

speaker: NPC #700101
anh_en: Emm... I gather you must be puzzled by my current appearance. I can assure you I am the Ebony Gatekeeper who contacted you earlier.
Fine. Not the first time I've done this.
I won't work for free.

speaker: NPC #700101
anh_en: Rest assured, there will be plenty of rewards waiting for you inside the dreamscapes. I will also be available to assist you in any way my abilities allow.

speaker: NPC #700101
anh_en: About the Somnoire gateway in Rinascita I mentioned to you earlier... In order to prevent further spread, I have sealed the impurities in the Memory Zones behind it.

speaker: NPC #700101
anh_en: As you progress, I will periodically open more gateways located across various areas. The Somnoire will also have necessary utilities in place at your and your comrade's disposal.

speaker: NPC #700101
anh_en: Proceed to the gateway and restore Memory Zones affected by impurities, Dreamwalker.
That time when I met "Dorothy"...
You're inside Encore's Cosmos?
...I see how it is. It was you who I spoke to that time!

speaker: NPC #700101
anh_en: I'm afraid Ms. Encore has no involvement in this. This entity is a replica of memory fragments from the Somnoire. I am merely borrowing its appearance for the time being.
Okay...

speaker: NPC #700101
anh_en: Now, then. This is unrelated to the topic we're about to discuss.

speaker: NPC #700101
anh_en: That-that time?
That time when I used Echoids against the TDs.

speaker: NPC #700101
anh_en: Dreamwalker, to the Somnoire you are a variable of incredible weight. You bring about a change...
What kind of change?

speaker: NPC #700101
anh_en: A change for the better. After years of lying dormant, the colossus is now experiencing transformation. Together, we shall preserve even more... treasures.

speaker: NPC #700101
anh_en: Whilst deep inside the Memory Zones, I'm sure you came across plenty of familiar views and occurances.

speaker: NPC #700101
anh_en: Go, Dreamwalker. In the realms of dreams, only the dream itself holds the answers we seek.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: {PlayerName}. Can you hear me?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Well, then that'll make explaining all the easier. It has been troubling us ever since we first learned of the invitation's existence. After all, the Deep Water Zone has always been a realm we've yet to peer into its secrets.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Data samples collected from Septimont reveal a similar frequency. We reckon this was how the invitation made its way to you after traversing the Deep Water Zone through utilizing the frequency's unique signatures.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Worry not. Long story short, we managed to form a general idea of the reason behind the sudden burst in activity of the Somnoire's depths.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: However, we still lack sufficient samples to verify our hypothesis. If you don't mind, we'd like to have you take out the remaining Nightmare Tacet Discords.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Their coordinates have been sent to your Terminal. Per usual, you will be rewarded for your hard work. We appreciate your aid, {PlayerName}.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: I've just received confirmation that some of the Nightmare Tacet Discords that appeared in Septimont have been eliminated—under your blade as usual. Wonderfully done.
Just a walk in the park.
Just a friendly tourist who happened to pass by.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: That walk you had certainly gave us a surprise. As a matter of fact, we've managed to discover something unique from the Septimont Dreamscape Sample.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Whether it's purely by chance or a work a fate is something worth pondering. As a matter of fact, we've managed to discover something unique from the Septimont Dreamscape Sample.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: I'm sure you still have memories of that invitation you received to the Somnoire Film Festival, yes?
I do.
Not really.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: We've confirmed and gathered all Dreamscape Samples, {PlayerName}. Well done.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Yet, so far, we are unable to identify the frequency's origin.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: Our theory is that the Dark Tide might be the reason behind it! The Nightmare samples we collected has signs of Dark Tide all over!

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: How many times do I have to tell you I'm the one making the report! Keep those unreasonable imaginations to yourself!

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Well, then. The situation within the Deep remains unclear, but there is no doubt that the Somnoire and Rinascita will continue to fall victim under this frequency's influence.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Be sure to keep an eye out for any Nightmare Tacet Discords you may come across during your travels to other regions of Rinascita, {PlayerName}.
What did you find?
I'll be taking my rewards.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: Hate to break to you, {PlayerName}. Things are more complicated than we thought. Meow! We even found that cinema from last time in these samples.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: Don't worry, you'll get your rewards. We promise. Meow! Guess what, {PlayerName}? We found that cinema from last time in these samples.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Do not interrupt. I am the one in charge of reporting!

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: ...Meow.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: I'll keep it brief. Nightmare Tacet Discords of Septimont carry a unique frequency which can restore connection with the Deep Water Zone, similar to the moment when the invitation was sent.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: One thing is certain that the severed connection of Rinascita's Somnoire has something to do with it.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (A call from an unknown contact... What could it be?)
As if the world around it has lost its color?
As if the world around it has lost its vitality?

speaker: NPC #50090
anh_en: Sure, it seems you've encountered them already. The Pioneer Association refers to those Tacet Discords as "Overflowing Palettes," and the areas they affect are known as "Faded Zones."

speaker: NPC #50090
anh_en: Such strange phenomena have quietly spread throughout Rinascita, leaving ordinary people completely helpless…
I've just restored a spot.

speaker: NPC #50090
anh_en: Wait... you did? I knew you were the right person to talk to.

speaker: NPC #50090
anh_en: Please find me in Egla Town when you have a moment. I have a favor to ask of you and we can discuss the details when we meet.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (The call has ended.)

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Yawn—Just woke up and already hear you guys chatting...

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Wait a minute, this person seems suspicious. How does she know your contact details?

speaker: NPC #50092
anh_en: Hey, is it {PlayerName}? I hope I've finally reached the right person...
We'll find out.
For I'm the famous Rover!
Yes, speaking. And you are?
I'm not interested in your product, thank you.

speaker: NPC #50092
anh_en: Hello, I'm Vida, running a modest business in Egla Town.

speaker: NPC #50092
anh_en: Oh, don't worry. I don't do cold calls. I run a small business here in Egla Town. Just call me Vida.
I've seen you before, haven't I?
What can I do for you?

speaker: NPC #50090
anh_en: Have you come across these paintings of vibrant colors standing in a dreary field in the wild?

speaker: NPC #50091
anh_en: You're here at last! I was just wondering how much longer I'd have to wait.

speaker: NPC #50091
anh_en: Always feels like a breeze to chat with a sharp mind like yours. That is exactly why I got your contact from a former colleague. After all, no one wants the places in their memories to be covered in dull patches, right?

speaker: NPC #50091
anh_en: If we can only see those familiar landscapes in photos from now on... it's a depressing thought, isn't it?
Let's talk terms first.
How about a little something to sweeten the deal?

speaker: NPC #50091
anh_en: Certainly, I wouldn't expect you to help for free. The Faded Zones often hold abundant mineral deposits and resources. But they can't be accessed due to the influence of the Overflowing Palettes.

speaker: NPC #50091
anh_en: Restoring the zones will not only bring back the colors but also the resources. You can trade them with me for some... rare items on the market.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Sounds like this is her true intention...

speaker: NPC #50091
anh_en: As a merchant, it's my fundamental skill. So, what do you think? Those goods and offers are exclusively for partners.
Understood, let's seal the deal.

speaker: NPC #50091
anh_en: Alright, take a look at what's on the shelves. The resources are just what you need right now.
Why did you suddenly reach out to me?

speaker: NPC #50091
anh_en: Because... 'Here's to a world of discoveries and wonders.'

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Hmm, sounds familiar. Isn't that the slogan of the Pioneer Association?
Are you with the Pioneer Association?

speaker: NPC #50091
anh_en: I used to be. Back when I was a traveling merchant, I also worked briefly as a contract photographer for the Pioneer Association, capturing landscapes along the trade routes to earn some travel expenses.

speaker: NPC #50091
anh_en: Now... as you can see, those strange phenomena have drained the color from many places, making it harder to capture great photos. I've settled down and opened my own shop, so I haven't renewed my contract.

speaker: NPC #50091
anh_en: But deep down, I am still unable to move past the faded landscapes.
Do you want me to restore those areas?

speaker: NPC #50091
anh_en: Thank you for your patronage. From now on, we're long-term business partners.

speaker: NPC #50091
anh_en: Let's work together to reclaim the natural colors of our world!

speaker: NPC #50091
anh_en: Oh, right, is there anything else you want to ask? For an important partner like you, I'm always an open book.

speaker: NPC #50091
anh_en: Egla Town is my hometown. Whenever I stand up high and gaze at the windmills spinning in the breeze, I feel a sense of peace.

speaker: NPC #50091
anh_en: Ragunna is a bustling city and the big families got eyes all over the place. Not exactly a friendly environment for certain businesses. You know what I'm saying, don't you?
I'm not sure I understand.

speaker: NPC #50091
anh_en: Anyway... Although I reside in the town, I actually have business dealings with some shops in the city. You might have indirectly purchased my goods already.

speaker: NPC #50091
anh_en: Of course, I often look through the photos I took during my travels, reminiscing about the delightful and challenging moments along the way.

speaker: NPC #50091
anh_en: People can't dwell on the past forever. I'll entrust you with <ano=restoring>safeguarding</ano> those beautiful landscapes for now, and I'll continue to support you all the way.

speaker: NPC #50091
anh_en: Some of the items on the shelves are in limited supply, but they will be restocked periodically. Be sure to check back often!
Where did these rare items come from?
Why not expand your business in Ragunna City?
Do you ever miss your life of traveling?
No further questions.

speaker: NPC #50091
anh_en: In my travels across Rinascita, I've built a network of business contacts, many of whom provide me with unique supplies.

speaker: NPC #50091
anh_en: Some items, however, have yet to hit the market for various reasons, such as a master chef's secret recipes or some efficacious alternative medicine developed by folks...
Doesn't that make these... black market goods?

speaker: NPC #50091
anh_en: Relax. No one's going to come knocking at your door. And even if they do... I'm sure you can handle it, right?

speaker: NPC #50091
anh_en: Ragunna has a shop called "Rosemary's Apothecary," perhaps you've visited it already. Its owner, Miss Rosemary, is an old client of mine. I wonder if you've noticed—

speaker: NPC #50091
anh_en: Her behavior sometimes changes, doesn't it?

speaker: NPC #50091
anh_en: I've heard from the elders in town that at the end of Whisperwind Haven lies a mystical island, surrounded by a circular forest encasing a mirror-like lake.

speaker: NPC #50091
anh_en: The lake, with its mirror-like calmness, is said to reveal one's "inner self."

speaker: NPC #50091
anh_en: It seems... no one has actually reached there yet.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Rover, it’s a <color=Highlight>Sonance Casket</color>! Hmm... Hang on to it. I know this old acquaintance who’s a <color=Highlight>relic merchant</color>. He knows a lot about stuff like this. I’ll take you to him when we get to Jinzhou.

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: Hello, Xiaofang. You seem to be in a hurry. What’s the matter today?

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: I’m so lucky to meet you today, Rover.
What is a Sonance Casket?

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: It might look like a box, but it’s actually some kind of energy entity that doesn’t have a physical existence.

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: On the other hand... One could consider it a box, in a way. The usual boxes contain physical items, but the Sonance Caskets contain records of the past.

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: Simply put...

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: Well... my young friend, this is a data fragment that survived the collapse of a Sonoro Sphere. These Sonance Caskets, just like the Sonoro Spheres, hold onto sounds from bygone days.

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: Within these Caskets, one can find the most treasured artifacts from the magnificent civilization that existed before the Lament, as well as the profound human emotions experienced during the catastrophe.

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: Ah... They represent the final remnants of a bygone era, washed away by the relentless tide of history.

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: I have a selfish request to make.

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: Could you please let me have this Sonance Casket?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Shh... Uncle Chenpi... Please don’t call me that, remember?
Why?
What’s in it for me?
Of course, I’ll give you something in return.

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: To be frank, the Sonance Casket doesn’t hold any financial worth.

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: Yet for those of us who are relic hunters, the information stored in these Sonance Caskets is highly coveted.

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: I can pay you with Shell Credits, or other valuable items.

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: Long story short, it’s a sweet deal for you. I’ll make sure you’re happy with what you get.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Rover, you can trust Uncle Chenpi. He is a famous treasure appraiser in Jinzhou, definitely not a bad person who'd try to slip one past you.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Besides, I, Chixia, am a Patroller. If he ever lies to you… Hmph, justice will punish him.

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: Aww, Chixia... You know I’ll never do something like that…

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: Oops, my bad. I should call you Chixia, Patroller Chixia.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Just kidding, Uncle Chenpi! You’re so kind, no hard feelings, okay?
It’s a deal, then. (Hand over the Sonance Casket)

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: Great… Thank you, Rover.

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: So… This youngling here must be a friend of our great Patroller Chixia, yes?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Uncle Chenpi, please stop teasing me.
Hello.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Uncle Chenpi, this is my friend Rover, hehe. I brought {Male=him;Female=her} here today for some help...
(Give the Sonance Casket to Chenpi.)

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: Wow, this thing is really hard to find. I’ve been out in the wild searching for something like this...

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: Now, if you have any other questions, please ask away.
So your dream is to become a hero.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Yeah, I’m not quite a hero yet, but I’m giving it my all.
You’re gonna be the hero of Huanglong, Ma Xiaofang.
You’re gonna be the hero of Huanglong, Chixia.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Aww… Please, spare me that, Rover.
Okay... Because we’re besties, I’ll give in a little. You can call me Ma Xiaofang when it’s just us, but please don’t do that when there’s other people.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: That’s right! Chixia, Chixia... oh, what a magnificent name! I came up with it all by myself. This is the culmination of all my life experiences and knowledge!
Rover, feel free to call me by any name, but... Ahem, just so you know, that name is for our ears only, okay?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Yeah, I wanna know too. You’re all about exploring the past, but people always say we should be looking ahead, so what’s the deal?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Yeah, I wanna know too. Why are you so keen on collecting Sonance Caskets, Uncle Chenpi? Those… Fragments of past data, are they really that important?
(Ask about Chixia’s name change.)

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: The past has influenced how things are today and will be in the future, as everything we see has changed a lot over many years.

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: The seeds of yesterday give root to the flowers of tomorrow. In the absence of historical knowledge, how can we engage in discussions about the future?

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: The past serves as a reminder of our origins, ensuring that we do not lose sight of our original intentions amidst the overwhelming current of history.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Ah… I see. That sounds really cool. Thank you, Uncle Chenpi.
You’re welcome.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Oh right. Uncle Chenpi’s the best treasure appraiser in town.

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: I appreciate the compliment, Chixia. There are numerous talented individuals in Jinzhou, and I am far from being one of the best.

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: If the art of appraising treasure piques your interest, it may be worthwhile to seek guidance from a young girl known as "Master Youhu" if you cross paths with her in the future.

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: I am not nearly as skilled as her. Youngsters these days are seriously talented.
Ugh, speaking of that, I haven’t seen Youhu for a while now. Hopefully she didn’t get into trouble again…
(Ask him why he is collecting Sonance Caskets.)

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: If you ever find other Sonance Caskets, please consider selling them to me.

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: Don’t worry, the pay will make it worth your while. I’m not stingy when it comes to money.
(Ask if he can teach you treasure appraisal.)
I’ve got nothing to ask.

speaker: Speaker_29_Title
anh_en: Haha, well... I’m afraid you should ask Patroller Chixia herself.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Rover, you... Can we please not talk about this? My old name was cringy, that’s all…

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: No, I don’t mean to hide anything from you...

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: You see, "Ma Xiaofang" just sounds so lame. Heroes in the Hero Plays I watch never use any name like that.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: These TDs are scuttling about again...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I'm gonna need some help with this.

speaker: NPC #750170
anh_en: May applause greet you!

speaker: NPC #750170
anh_en: The thing is, we've run into a bit of trouble.

speaker: NPC #750170
anh_en: The High Tide's drawn in so many TDs, and even after it receded, plenty of those bastards still refuse to leave.

speaker: NPC #750170
anh_en: Can't just leave them running around the place.
That's a potential risk.
Do they not count as targets for a hunt?

speaker: NPC #750170
anh_en: Exactly. A true warrior should always keep their blade sharpened, even after a hunt.

speaker: NPC #750170
anh_en: The hunt this round's already wrapped up, and these TDs are just scattered breadcrumbs that can't even make the list. Yet, they still pose a threat.

speaker: NPC #750170
anh_en: The surrounding terrain is complex, so you'll need to keep a watchful eye before the real action starts.

speaker: NPC #750170
anh_en: A TD hunter must have eyes as sharp as an eagle's, and the explosive prowess of a lion.
Are we just tracking them down?

speaker: NPC #750170
anh_en: Ah, warrior... Do I know you from somewhere? Did you participate in the Great Agon?

speaker: NPC #750170
anh_en: TD tracking is a skill-demanding work. A slight lapse in judgment and your prey will slip through your fingers.

speaker: NPC #750170
anh_en: However, I notice you've been probing the nearby traces ever since you arrived. I take it you've got some experience in this?
I may know a thing or two about hunting.
I've already gotten approval from the Hunter's Guild.

speaker: NPC #750170
anh_en: Haha. My hunter's instincts are still as sharp as they were.

speaker: NPC #750170
anh_en: Approval from the Hunter's Guild? Is that something new they're doing now? Goodness, I've been here for too long.

speaker: NPC #750170
anh_en: Well then, without further ado, let the hunt begin!

speaker: NPC #750170
anh_en: May glory be with us, my friend!
