You've got the wrong person.
You're looking at this year's champion.

speaker: NPC #750170
anh_en: Is that so? Hold on, you must... There it is, you're the champion of this year's Agon!

speaker: NPC #750170
anh_en: Aha, so it's you! Thought you looked familiar.

speaker: NPC #750170
anh_en: I've been out here in the hunting grounds for longer than I can remember, so do forgive me for not recognizing our beloved champion at first glance.

speaker: NPC #750170
anh_en: Nevertheless, I am deeply grateful that it was you who showed up.
How so?

speaker: NPC #750170
anh_en: Ha! You even took care of the biggest and baddest TD out there!

speaker: NPC #750170
anh_en: And just like that, we can enjoy some momentary peace in the Sanguis Plateaus.

speaker: NPC #750170
anh_en: Looks like I don't have to worry about TDs for a while. I think it's time I go do something else.
Something else, as in?

speaker: NPC #750170
anh_en: It's incredible how a young champion like you came to be during my years here at the hunting grounds. This must be a revelation of fate.

speaker: NPC #750170
anh_en: I intend to step outside for a bit. See the world. Come back when the next High Tide arrives, and have a good brawl with those TDs myself.

speaker: NPC #750170
anh_en: Until next time, fellow warrior!

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Hello! Welcome to the Jinzhou branch of the Pioneer Association!

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Allow me to make a brief introduction.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Our core mission at the Pioneer Association is to push the boundaries of humanity's understanding through exploration. We ignite curiosity and embrace a trailblazing mindset, inviting adventurers from all backgrounds to join us.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Our team consists of top journalists, writers, photographers, and expeditioners from around the world.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Pioneers are free to plan their own expeditions with our support, and we offer platforms for publishing high-quality content such as magazines, podcasts, and books.
What can I get from this?
I'm in.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Our Pioneers earn cash for submissions, plus dedicated funding for approved expedition plans from the Association.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Pioneers also have the opportunity to receive special outdoor tools essential for their journeys. As they venture further, these tools can become invaluable aids in exploration.
I'm in.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Great! I'll get your profile set up real quick. You'll be able to check your exploration process so far on your Terminal at any time.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: I guess you must be Rover?

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: And... all set! From now on, Rover, you are a member of the Pioneer Association. You are sort of like my family now!

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: By the way, you should check out our expansive selection of publications and merchandise here, Rover. Now we've got the latest issue of Wutherium Geographic, the thrilling series of Into the Depths of Waves, and subscription discount coupons for our Pioneer Podcast...

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: There's also the bestselling All You Have to Know about Wuthering Waves and The One Hundred Lives of a Pioneer Association Reporter, plus our customer favorite—Gulpuff plushies!

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: New customers can buy one and get one 50% off!
Latest issue?
Podcast subscription?
Plushies?
I’ll pass for now.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: We publish two periodicals actually. Wutherium Geographic for general readers, and Post-Lament Anthropocene for academics.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: If you're interested in subscribing to our magazines, tell me now and we’ll send the latest issues to your doorstep every month!
How did you know?

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: For adventurers looking for top-notch entertainment, our Pioneer Podcast has it all. The Podcast is free, and there's also an Insider Channel for paid subscribers.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: With diverse shows covering news, music, and science, there's something for everyone.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: The Insider Channel features updates on ongoing explorations by contracted reporters and seasoned explorers.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Let me know if you'd like to subscribe!

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Oops, Gulpuff plushies sold out... Want me to reserve one for you?

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Anyway, you can always reach out for help on your journey. The Pioneer Association is here for you through any obstacles!
Yes, I am.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Our headquarters has extended an invitation to you. Please consider joining the Pioneer Association!

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Measure the planet with your own feet, and witness civilizations through your own eyes.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Let's go explore the world together!
The Pioneer Association?
Explore the world?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Wait, who turned this on?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: It's the first time I see its screen glow...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: Really?! LET ME SEE!

speaker: NPC #850586
anh_en: That's weird—Oh, {PlayerName}! Didn't expect to see you here!
Looks interesting.

speaker: NPC #850586
anh_en: Hm, you gonna give it a try?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The arcade stands before you, its screen flickering with a rhythmic glow, almost like it's breathing. You get the strange impression that a single touch will pull you into an entirely different world.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Sure. Why not?
You know me?
What are we looking at?

speaker: NPC #850586
anh_en: You kidding? How could I not recognize the Academy's living legend!

speaker: NPC #850586
anh_en: Check this out. This arcade cabinet has been sitting here since my very first day of school. I've never seen it on before.

speaker: NPC #850586
anh_en: But its screen is actually live today!
Let's see...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You lean in and find a line of text emerging from the center of the screen.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Attention faculty and students! Welcome to the world of Star Bouncing. Log in with your Persona Pinball and start a brand-new adventure!

speaker: NPC #150057
anh_en: Ah, {PlayerName}. You finished it faster than I expected. Never let people down, hm?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: So adding Rainbow Bean Pop Rocks into the game was also part of your plan?

speaker: NPC #150057
anh_en: It works like a catalyst. Otherwise, the game would be far too boring and bland.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: And Dr. Luuk?

speaker: NPC #150057
anh_en: That's none of my business. He signed up for it himself.

speaker: NPC #150057
anh_en: He volunteered to make sure everything stayed under control. Makes sense to me. It's his invention, after all.

speaker: NPC #150057
anh_en: Mornye also helped work on the theories, though only a tiny part during the initial phase before she got buried under a mountain of student essays...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Sounds like another prank managed by the sly faculty together.

speaker: NPC #150057
anh_en: Ouch. No need to be so harsh. It was just an academic collaboration.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: So, you did all this... just to let me have a try?

speaker: NPC #150057
anh_en: Exactly. You get to experience something different—reactions or personalities you don't normally get to see.
Why do I see disappointment on your face now?

speaker: NPC #150057
anh_en: What's your verdict? A funny little surprise, I hope?
It's not bad.
What if I say no?

speaker: NPC #150057
anh_en: Haha. I'm glad you liked it.

speaker: NPC #150057
anh_en: Hmm... then I'll have to try something else next time.

speaker: NPC #150057
anh_en: I hope you did find a bit of unusual fun in this little interlude, {PlayerName}.
Care to explain all this, Madam President?

speaker: NPC #150057
anh_en: That's too much of a word. I know someone as sharp and smart as you would clear this game in no time. But isn't it normal to be a bit emotional when you finally finish a game?

speaker: NPC #150057
anh_en: Well, it's just a little game I made on a whim.

speaker: NPC #150057
anh_en: And don't worry, its underlying structure is completely safe.

speaker: NPC #150057
anh_en: It just brings your hidden persona to the surface for a while. Pretty funny, isn't it?
...True.

speaker: NPC #150057
anh_en: Well, even I find myself craving something fresh to break up the daily grind every now and then. And honestly, with so many brilliant students around, I never have to look far for a spark of inspiration.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: We're finally connected, {PlayerName}. Can you hear me?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (What is this feeling... is it... the Somnoire?)

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Don't worry, it's just me, the White Cat from the Somnoire. I'm reaching out to you in your dream...

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: There are things best discussed face-to-face. Could you come to Ragunna City if you have the time? I need a favor from you, meow...

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Hello, {PlayerName}... This city is quite peculiar, meow. To be honest, it's my first time in Ragunna.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Ever since the last incident, I've been working on the Somnoire, getting it to resume the task of dream backup.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: But I'm completely powerless when it comes to Ragunna's dreams. So, I'd like to ask you to keep completing those challenges, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Most of the Dreamscape Nodes should be directly accessible to you, {PlayerName}. Some are special Tacet Discords linked to the Somnoire, while others are corrupted Dreamscape Nexus.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: However, in the Fagaceae Peninsula and the Penitent's End, the Dreamscape Nodes appear to be veiled by an unknown force.
That sounds complicated...

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: It's truly a headache, meow. Penitent's End is completely shrouded in a thick, eerie fog, and some of the nodes in Thessaleo Fells are shielded by a strange energy.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: To fully connect the Dreamscape Nodes, these obstructions must be removed. Complete the challenges, and I'll reward you accordingly, meow.
I'll think about it.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Alright, then. I'll mark the locations. I'm counting on you, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: But... something tells me there's more hidden behind the Dreamscape Nodes. {PlayerName}, make sure to stay vigilant after completing all the nodes in a region, meow.
Meow?
You are a cat...

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Ahem... never mind. The reason I contacted you, {PlayerName}, is because I sensed your frequency coming from Ragunna.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: I am not a mere cat! Ahem, let's set that aside for now. The real reason I contacted you, {PlayerName}, is because I sensed your frequency coming from Ragunna.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Originally, I couldn't leave the Whining Aix's Mire or collect dreams from other regions due to restrictions placed upon admin privileges and the Resonance Nexus.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Especially in Rinascita, which has been veiled by a network of countless nodes, making any connection impossible... until just recently, when one of its nodes suddenly linked up.
Those special challenge nodes?

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Exactly. I believe you've unintentionally picked up a unique frequency, {PlayerName}. With the Somnoire obtaining samples from Ragunna, I was finally able to connect with you.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: I see... so, that's what was lurking deep within the network of Dreamscape Nodes.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: There's something actively collecting people's nightmares and negative emotions...

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Well done, {PlayerName}. For now, the Somnoire connection has seen some progress. Let's discuss it further in person.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: {PlayerName}, do you think that special TD is similar to some of the memory fragments in the Somnoire?

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: I saw a pitch-black abyss, where people were neatly lined up, crawling, performing the same gestures, murmuring the same words, trapped in the same dream.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: In the next moment, they noticed my presence and turned to meet my gaze... Their eyes... Their pupils were stained with the same substance...

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: And in the darkness behind them, a pair of enormous eyes slowly opened... I've never seen a dream like this before.
That sounds unsettling...
They all turned to look at you?

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Yes. Just thinking about it gives me an uneasy feeling.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: It wasn't normal, meow... Just thinking about it gives me an uneasy feeling.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: That dream was far too dangerous and unsettling. What could be lurking in the darkness beneath Rinascita's waters? Have the people of Ragunna always been living with such a threat?

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: So, {PlayerName}, I'd like to ask you to keep eliminating those TDs hidden within the network. Only then will the dreams housed in the Somnoire be safe.
There are some resemblances.
And it reminded me of an old acquaintance...

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Yes, if you look closely, it's very similar to those corrupted dreams.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: I'm talking about the corrupted dreams, meow.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Dreams are visions from the subconscious. Even when they solidify into memory fragments, they still carry all the joy and sorrow of the dreamer.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: But those special TDs... it's as though people's subconscious have been unified by a single concept, carrying nothing but one desire.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: I tried to peer into the depths of the network to see what lay beyond. For a brief moment, I saw a single frame of image and almost drowned in the tidal sound, losing myself.
What kind of image?

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Well done, {PlayerName}. I can feel that all the Dreamscape Nodes are now connected.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: The hidden threats have been cleared... I've prepared your rewards, meow. Let's discuss the details in person.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Good job, {PlayerName}! I knew you could do it.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Thank you again for all your help, {PlayerName}. By the way, in addition to the agreed reward, I want to give you this as a keepsake.
What is this?

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: This is a unique sample I found in a Dreamscape Node. I'm not sure what it's for yet, but it certainly looks exquisite.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Maybe one day it will come in handy.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Now the dream frequency in the Ragunna region is stable... Hmm, how should I say this... It feels very... Rinascita.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Just like people from Jinzhou often dream of the Moon-Chasing Festival or Loong Whiskers Crisp, the most common dreams in Ragunna are about prayers, pizza, opera, and the Carnevale.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: From these dreams, it seems the people of Ragunna live quite happily... So why is there such a turbulent subconscious lurking beneath the surface?
Are deep-sea monster stories popular lately?
Maybe the Order is hiding something...

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: I really don't get it, meow, why would anyone like such terrifying things?! The deep sea is so dark, and I can't even swim, meow.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: I'm not sure about that... but there are surprisingly few dreams from Order members in these samples... What's going on?

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Let's leave that for later. In time, the Somnoire in Ragunna will be fully established.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: {PlayerName}, I can feel the sea fog over this island thinning.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Although it's still not stable, the Dreamscape Nodes here should be accessible now, meow.

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: So the Dreamscape Nexus was taken over by these TDs of obsession...

speaker: NPC #1439
anh_en: Now the hub seems to have rejoined the dream network, {PlayerName}. You can try connecting to it, meow.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: A familiar view, but without its luster...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Sigh. Such a shame.

speaker: NPC #700152
anh_en: Sigh. Such a shame. This is far from enough for this picture book...
Sounds like a good plan.

speaker: NPC #700152
anh_en: No, not yet. But before that, there's something I must take care of first. Do you remember the Overflowing Palette?

speaker: NPC #700152
anh_en: Well, as an observer, I shall find a way to continue the book's flow of life.

speaker: NPC #700152
anh_en: But before I find this painter, there's something I must take care of first. Do you remember the Overflowing Palette?

speaker: NPC #700152
anh_en: Overflowing Palettes can affect colors around them, making them fade in reality.

speaker: NPC #700152
anh_en: And it has occurred to me that many of the landscapes sketched inside this picture book have fallen under the influence of these "Palettes." Without their real-world counterparts as references, finding an artist is pointless.
I can help with that.
Count me in that observer gang.

speaker: NPC #700152
anh_en: Would you really? Oh, that would mean a great deal to me, {PlayerName}! Then I shall leave the task of restoring the Faded Zones to you.

speaker: NPC #700152
anh_en: I'll compile a list of the Faded Zones and send it to you shortly.
What's it for?

speaker: NPC #700152
anh_en: Oh, it's you, {PlayerName}. Here's to a world of discoveries and wonders!

speaker: NPC #700152
anh_en: What do you think? There aren't any colors yet, but I think the sketches alone are already extraordinary!
Like the work of an exceptional artistic talent.

speaker: NPC #700152
anh_en: I picked it up from a merchant I met on the streets. According to him, this book had the potential to become a masterpiece.

speaker: NPC #700152
anh_en: But the painter became seriously ill and passed away before applying the colors. No one wants to pay for something incomplete.

speaker: NPC #700152
anh_en: The beauties of the landscapes are already preserved by perfect lines, yet lacking the colors to complement them. Such a shame... And here I am, on a search for the right painter to finish the work.
Have you found one yet?

speaker: NPC #700152
anh_en: Here's to a world of discoveries and wonders.

speaker: NPC #700152
anh_en: That's great. Mind introducing me to your friend if you get the chance?
What made you join the Pioneer Association?
About the "picture book."

speaker: NPC #700152
anh_en: Why did I join the Pioneer Association? Out of curiosity, of course. I still remember the words written on the inside cover of Wutherium Geographic.

speaker: NPC #700152
anh_en: Go see the world and witness history in the making. Go see humanity's masterpieces—our art, our buildings, our innovations. Go see it all, and feel it all.

speaker: NPC #700152
anh_en: I wish to extend my view far beyond where my body can take it.

speaker: NPC #700152
anh_en: Yes. After every Faded Zone is restored, finding a reliable artist to fill in the colors is all we need to do.

speaker: NPC #700152
anh_en: Speaking of artists, got anyone that comes to mind, {PlayerName}?
I know an artist friend in Jinzhou.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Grandpa Jingzhu, are these Echoes enough?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: But there are times when melodies blend together perfectly, creating a beautiful harmony!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Forming an Echo team is just like that!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: I hope that made sense... Anyway, why not give it a shot yourself? It's the quickest way to understand!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Absolutely! See? The Echoes obtained in this Tacet Field can make up a team with Havoc Warrior.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Hmm... Let me take a look. You're right!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: {PlayerName}, luck is on your side, huh? Putting together a team so quickly. Usually, it takes us quite a bit of effort to form an Echo team.
Form an Echo team?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Oops, my bad! I got carried away and forgot to explain what that’s all about.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Hmm... Give me a sec. I’m searching for the right words here.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: As you already know, each Echo has its own unique frequency. When we gather several Echoes together, it's like...

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: It's like having a bunch of people playing different instruments. Most of the time, the melodies clash and it's a total mess.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Well done, well done indeed. This Echo team is much more impressive than mine back in the day, haha!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Alright, I can feel the confidence swelling within me! Let’s return to Jinzhou and dazzle her!
Alright, let’s go.
Give me a few moments.
Hehe, I can already picture the look on her face!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: No rush. I also need to make some preparations. What should I say to her…

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Her house is over there. I've walked that path many times and I won't make a mistake.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Popular Love Messages in Huanglong! Ahem, I know it might seem a bit strange for someone of my age to say such things...

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: But as long as I can win her heart, I can put aside my pride.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: I’m counting on you. After I say my line, you’ll follow up to set the perfect mood.
Okay, fine.
I require a raise.
{PlayerName}, I had no idea you’re even more helpful than me! Way to go!
Of course, I won’t stint on compensation. Your efforts will be duly rewarded.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: That’s settled then. Thank you, kids.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Before I go knocking on her door, there's a favor I must ask of you.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Ahem, I’ve prepared some opening lines and I need your assistance in delivering them.
Opening lines?

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Well, just some nice words, carefully chosen, and I believe they’ll definitely do the trick.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Do you know what’s sweeter than any bloom? Not the Waterlamp’s glow, nor the Iris’s perfume, but the blossom of our love’s perfect tune!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Do you know what lasts forever in Wuthering Waves? Not fleeting civilizations, nor Tacet Discords’ lore, but my unwavering love for you, forevermore!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Well... Grandpa Jingzhu, what are these?

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: There she is, Linghan, m-my beloved wife... wife-to-be.
Alright, there’s no time to waste. I must make my move!
Whoa, {PlayerName}, your passion is contagious! You’ve got me all fired up too!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Do you know what’s sweeter than any bloom?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Not the Waterlamp’s glow!
Nor the Iris’s perfume.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: But the blossom of our love’s perfect tune!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Good! Better strike while the iron’s hot!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Do you know what lasts forever in Wuthering Waves?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Not fleeting civilizations!
Nor Tacet Discords’ lore.
And this flower is...?

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: But my unwavering love for you, forevermore!

speaker: Lăng Hàn
anh_en: You done? Please excuse me.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Wait! I have a surprise for you!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Hurry! Show her those majestic Echoes!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: It’s the Noctemint, her favorite flower.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: I’m about to ask her, "Would you accept this Noctemint and join me on a lifelong journey?"

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: But alas, my efforts seem to fall short... I truly hope she’ll appreciate this Noctemint this time.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Perhaps, with my carefully prepared opening lines and the majestic Echoes you’ve captured, she’ll finally accept my love.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Do you remember the opening lines? I’ll say my line first, and you’ll follow up! Remember to set the mood!
Well, but...
Always ready!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Look! Aren’t these Echoes impressive? These two youngsters assisted me in capturing them.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Linghan, we’re of similar age, with shared interests. I hold you dear and desire nothing more than to journey through life with you. Would you do me the honor of accepting this Noctemint?

speaker: Lăng Hàn
anh_en: Speaking of Echoes, that’s my specialty.

speaker: Lăng Hàn
anh_en: If you’re aiming to become an Echo Master, you can’t judge an Echo solely from its appearance. Take this Carapace, for instance. Despite its imposing scythes, it may not be what it seems.

speaker: Lăng Hàn
anh_en: What truly counts is finding the Echo that resonates with you and nurturing it wisely. Always remember, never let appearances sway your decisions!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Yes, yes. So, might you consider accepting this Noctemint?

speaker: Lăng Hàn
anh_en: No, thank you. I’m not interested. I’d rather bask in the sunshine and enjoy some dried melon seeds all by myself.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Grandma Linghan turned him down, right?

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: It’s her way of guiding me forward. Hahaha, she truly does care about me!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: ...Starting to wonder if Grandpa Jingzhu bumped his head.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Come along, my young friends! There's no time to waste. We're leaving the city to gather the materials needed...

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Wait, Grandpa Jingzhu! Take it easy! It's getting late, and you're still recovering from your injury. Plus, {PlayerName} must be beat after capturing all those Echoes...

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Oh, my apologies. I got carried away and lost track of time. You must be exhausted. Let’s do it another day.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Ah, almost forgot. Here’s your compensation. Please, accept it.
If you insist.
Really? Just take it?

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Good! Next time I ask for your help, I’ll also pay you a decent sum. It’s how connections are forged, isn’t it?
It’s definitely a rejection.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Take it, kid. You’ve earned it. Next time I ask for your help, I’ll also pay you a decent sum. It’s how connections are forged, isn’t it?

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: You’ve both worked hard today. Hurry home and rest up! Thank you!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: She didn’t accept my Noctemint...
Grandpa Jingzhu must be very upset.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Yeah, that's a bit of a bummer. I'm feeling a little down about it too...

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Hey, Grandpa Jingzhu, how about we shake off the blues with a stroll? Or maybe grab a bite to eat? I know a place that serves great Maocai, spicy but delicious!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: I’m not disheartened, not in the slightest!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: I’ve been reflecting on Linghan’s words, and it’s become clear to me.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: She wasn’t rejecting me. She was urging me to nurture the Echoes with care.

speaker: Sí Hà (Đang liên lạc)
anh_en: Hey there, Rover! Remember Grandpa Jingzhu?

speaker: Sí Hà (Đang liên lạc)
anh_en: That’s fine. Swing by the training grounds when you’ve got a sec.
Of course.
Who?
Yep, the one who said that “my-unwavering-love” thing.
The one who said that "my-unwavering-love" thing. Ringing any bells now?

speaker: Sí Hà (Đang liên lạc)
anh_en: So, I ran into him earlier, and he needs our help in snagging Echoes again. Hence, the call.
Sure, why not?
When I have time.
Awesome! We’ll catch you near the training grounds, then.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Now that we’re all here, Grandpa Jingzhu, what’s the plan?

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Alright then, let’s set to sharpening these giant scythes!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Um... Speaking of the Echo training grounds...

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Ah, that’d be Instructor Yhan’s training grounds! I’ve been there before for the Patroller Graduation Assessment. Honestly, if I can help it, I’d rather not go for round two.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Ahem, but with {PlayerName} by our side today, it won’t be so nerve-wracking, right?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Being timid doesn’t fit being a Patroller! Follow my lead. Let’s roll!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Since our last parting, I’ve been pondering over Linghan’s words, and they’ve offered me a new perspective!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: “If you’re aiming to become an Echo Master, you can’t judge an Echo solely from its appearance. Take this Carapace, for instance. Despite its imposing scythes, it may not what it seems.”

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: She believed that the Scythes are only imposing on the surface, yet lacking in practicality and sharpness as weapons.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: I’m sure if I can hone these scythes to blade-like sharpness, Linghan will gladly accept my Noctemint.
Really?
Are you sure this time?
One improves with practice. We’ll know the answer once I try.
Ahem, life is full of uncertainties. If I fail this time, there’s always another chance!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: I’ve heard rumors that Yhan has turned into quite the strict instructor. You’d better take care.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: There are quite a few juniors in there who were once beaten hard by me, haha! So, I’ll refrain from joining you and spoiling their spirits.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Here we are. Go on in. Wish you good luck!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Chixia is talking to someone. Come back when they’re done talking.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Sadly, I only have a Hoartoise. Round face, round head. Far from impressive.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: If I could just get an Echo that meets her standards, maybe she’d let me have a chance.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Uh... Grandpa Jingzhu, are you really sure about that? It sounds a bit strange. It's not every day you see a lady keen on Echoes.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: At least, it seems to be the only way to her heart.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Despite the odds, I’m resolved to attempt it.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: But you’re not at your best. You really should take some good rest.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Who knows what might happen if you take another tumble down that hillside...

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Oh, sorry! I shouldn’t have said such things!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Little Patroller, you're still too young to understand what love means. Enduring physical pain is one thing, but the ache of unrequited love is something even great heroes can't overcome.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Anyway, I’ll capture an impressive Echo and seize my love.

speaker: Ông Lão
anh_en: *sigh*...

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Oh, please reconsider, Grandpa Jingzhu! Echoes will always be there for you to capture. Once you recover, you can catch as many as you want!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Once I recover... But kid, I grow tired of waiting. When will the opportunity arise again?

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Besides, Tacet Discords are most active recently, so it’s the best time to capture impressive Echoes!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: I can’t let this chance slip away.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Okay, okay. How about this?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: I’ll go catch Echoes for you and you’ll go to the hospital. Is that okay?

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: But I don’t want to bother you with my own issue...

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: No worries. It’s no trouble at all! After all, it’s a Patroller’s duty to take care of the residents’ needs.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Well, it doesn’t sit right with me having you work overtime for my personal issues. If you’re going to help, you have to accept some compensation from my savings. It’s the least I can do.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Oh, no need to worry about paying me! Actually, I have a really skilled friend who could help. What if we hire {Male=him;Female=her} to help instead?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Grandpa Jingzhu, seriously, you’re not well... Let’s forget about capturing <ano=TD Frequencies>Echoes</ano> for now and head straight to the hospital, okay?

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: That’s fine for me.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Excellent! Leave it to me! Grandpa Jingzhu, now please go to the hospital and tend to your injuries.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: No way! If I don't capture an impressive Echo, I'll be too anxious to even think about eating or sleeping.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Oh, come on! You shouldn't be out there chasing them at your age. Why do you have to get one?

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Ahem, because the person I like wants one!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: The person you like...?

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Yes. You know, it's not usual for a man of my years to seek love, but I love her. She keeps rejecting me.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: She’s into impressive Echoes, so that’s my in.
I want to train Echoes.

speaker: Speaker_790_Title
anh_en: I see. Follow me. Select a training program that aligns with your current skill level.

speaker: Speaker_790_Title
anh_en: Hello, our paths cross again. What brings you here this time?

speaker: Speaker_790_Title
anh_en: Just a word of caution. Don’t let overconfidence cloud your judgment when choosing. It’s wise not to bite off more than you can chew.

speaker: Speaker_790_Title
anh_en: Otherwise, you may find yourself in tears.

speaker: Speaker_790_Title
anh_en: Not bad. Far beyond my expectations.

speaker: Speaker_790_Title
anh_en: {PlayerName}, you never fail to impress me.

speaker: Speaker_790_Title
anh_en: Don’t hesitate to come to me if you need help. I’d be happy to provide training at different levels for enthusiastic people like you.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Haha, that sounds a tad... intimidating, doesn't it?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: I never imagined we’d breeze through all that training so quickly! You’re truly living up to your name, {PlayerName}!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Let’s go break the good news to Grandpa Jingzhu!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Back so soon?

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Yhan is quite a formidable figure. Breezing through his training is truly commendable.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: I have no doubt that the world will soon be at your feet, youngsters!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Haha, enough banter. Let’s get down to the business first. The scythes of the Havoc Warrior await our sharpening!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Whoa! It’s even more impressive now! Check out those scythes—they’re seriously intimidating!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Despite your youthful vigor, enduring Yhan’s training again in such a brief span may still be quite a challenge. Maybe, we can...

speaker: Speaker_790_Title
anh_en: This voice... I knew it's you, Mr. Jingzhu.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: In-Instructor Yhan?

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Ah, you still recognize this old face, Yhan.

speaker: Speaker_790_Title
anh_en: But you have retired for a long time...

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Retired I may be, but the fire still burns within me! It’s been quite some time since I retired, and opportunities to mingle with you youngsters are rare these days.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: And here stands Chief Instructor Yhan. You’ve been keeping well, I trust?

speaker: Speaker_790_Title
anh_en: I’m merely fulfilling my duty. And how fare your old comrades?

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Except for Captain and myself, they all... Ah, never mind. Let’s focus on happier topics during this once-in-a-while reunion.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: The past is the past. When you reach my age, you’ll realize that the present moment holds the most significance in life!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Live in the moment and cherish each passing day. That’s how we honor our comrades’ sacrifices.

speaker: Speaker_790_Title
anh_en: Indeed, Mr. Jingzhu. The present demands our full attention.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Exactly, then let’s talk about the present. You know what I need now. Are you willing to lend a hand?

speaker: Speaker_790_Title
anh_en: You’re as spirited as ever, Mr. Jingzhu.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: You two know each other?

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Haha, I’m truly flattered.

speaker: Speaker_790_Title
anh_en: These should be enough for your needs. Take them.
Great, thanks.

speaker: Speaker_790_Title
anh_en: We do and for a long time.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Instructor Yhan doesn’t seem half as evil as the rumors make him out to be.

speaker: Speaker_790_Title
anh_en: In the days of the Midnight Rangers, Mr. Jingzhu commanded my utmost respect.

speaker: Speaker_790_Title
anh_en: It’s been a while since we last met. Mr. Jingzhu. You still look spirited... though your legs don’t seem as nimble?

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Ahem, just a minor accident. You see, I’m getting on in years. A little slip while hiking. Nothing to worry about!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: I’ve been resting and should recover soon.

speaker: Speaker_790_Title
anh_en: Your injuries seem to have healed well, but don’t underestimate the importance of rest.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: You’re as talkative as ever, boy. Back in the day, we endured far worse and still fought valiantly in battles. Remember?

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Make her fall in love with me with only one shot!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: With my natural charm and these finely honed scythes, I’m confident this time I’ll win Linghan’s heart and let her accept my Noctemint!
Are you sure?
Really?

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Ahem, absolutely!
What makes Grandpa Jingzhu so sure that having a powerful Echo will win Grandma Linghan’s heart?
I’m with you on this one. What makes Grandpa Jingzhu so sure that having a powerful Echo will win Grandma Linghan’s heart?

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Of course, it’s not just the Echo I’ve prepared! Linghan once shared her criteria for an ideal partner.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: She said her ideal partner is a wise and valiant soldier wielding a handsome greatsword, accompanied by a majestic Echo, facing countless foes with unrivaled poise.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: You see? Apart from the majestic Echo, everything else fits me to a tee!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Why the look? Do you lack faith in me? It’s understandable, given the generation gap between us.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: But when it comes to matters of love, especially for us seniors, trust me. I’ve got this!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Alright, all set and ready. Let’s pay a visit to Linghan.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: I’m still surprised at the revelation that Grandpa Jingzhu was once a Midnight Ranger.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Hmph, I’m used to keeping a low profile. Bide my time to impress Linghan.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Back here again, in this familiar spot.

speaker: Oánh Oánh
anh_en: Grandpa Jingzhu, you’re here to see Grandma, right?

speaker: Oánh Oánh
anh_en: I heard you're... um, what's the word? Courting Grandma?

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Oh my! Hold on, Yingying. You’re too young to understand what that means.

speaker: Oánh Oánh
anh_en: I even learned a new term! Late-life love!

speaker: Oánh Oánh
anh_en: Anyway, Grandpa, you should go for it! I’ll go tell Grandma you’re here!

speaker: Oánh Oánh
anh_en: GRANDMA!

speaker: Oánh Oánh
anh_en: Grandpa Jingzhu is back with more Noctemints for you, Grandma!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Oh my, oh my, kids these days are something else.

speaker: Lăng Hàn
anh_en: Noctemints?

speaker: Lăng Hàn
anh_en: It’s strange. Lately, about ten gentlemen have brought me Noctemints.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: It’s twelve.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: And now I'm the thirteenth one... Hold on, those before were all me too…

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Remember what you told me last time? One can’t judge an Echo solely from its appearance.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: That actually makes perfect sense! So I’ve honed these scythes even sharper!

speaker: Lăng Hàn
anh_en: You can interpret it that way.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: What a relief to hear that! Alright, let me present to you what we’ve managed to achieve this time!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: What do you think, Linghan?

speaker: Lăng Hàn
anh_en: He was a wise and valiant soldier, and even his Echoes were impressive. Compared to him, everyone else falls short.

speaker: Lăng Hàn
anh_en: So, feel free to ask me anything Echo-related, but let’s keep everything else off the table.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Alright, then... Sorry to bother you. I shall take my leave.

speaker: Lăng Hàn
anh_en: Sorry, what was the reason for your visit again? Ah, to show me the Echo?

speaker: Oánh Oánh
anh_en: NO! Grandma, he’s here to give you Noctemints!
Oh, girl...
Nice move!
Yingying seems to be quite lively today, and that helped me a lot.
Yingying is certainly brimming with energy today, isn’t she? That helped me a lot.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: I suppose I should seize this opportunity. Yes, that’s right. I did come to bring you Noctemints. Would you like to spend the rest of your life with me?

speaker: Lăng Hàn
anh_en: Oh dear, this is quite the headache. Thank you, but I'm not presently interested in seeking a partner. Even if I were, I'd prefer someone akin to my former lover...

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: It seems Grandpa Jingzhu was rejected again.
As long as you’re not stingy about the payment.
It was quite amusing to watch all of this unfold.
Thank you. You two are really kind-hearted!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Don’t worry. I’ll ensure you receive adequate compensation.
Well, this is a little embarrassing... Still, being happy is good for your health, right? At least I made someone happy. It’s not too terrible.
Well, this is a little embarrassing... Still, being happy is good for your health, right? At least I made someone happy. It’s not too terrible.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Thirteen consecutive rejections... Perhaps it’s time for some introspection on my approach...

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Perhaps, Linghan isn’t used to such direct and impassioned displays of affection?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: That makes sense... Grandma Linghan does seem rather serious, so perhaps it’s time to switch tactics?

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Hmm... What alternative approach should I try?
Talk more about Echoes?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: That’s a great idea! Start by engaging her in a topic that grabs her attention, and you might find yourself getting closer to her. Then, asking her to be your partner might just fall into place naturally!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Indeed, it seems Echoes are the only thing that captures her interest.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: I’ll have to think carefully about how to improve the Echo. Actually, my captain taught me a lot back in the day, but age has dulled my memory.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Alright, let’s call it a day. I need to go home and think it over. Here, this is your payment for today’s efforts.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Grandpa Jingzhu, are you okay? Please don’t be sad... I-I’ll do everything I can to cheer you up.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Hmm? Sad? Not in the slightest! Even if I were, it’d be but a mere act.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Thirteen failures down, but I’m not about to throw in the towel! I’ll persist, be it the fourteenth, fifteenth, or beyond...
Why are you suddenly fired up?

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: For I’ve resolved to become the wise and valiant soldier that matches Linghan’s ideals!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: I feel bad for rendering your efforts futile.
It’s okay.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Honestly, I'm super curious too. Something just doesn't add up with an old lady being so into Echoes!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: And why is Grandpa Jingzhu being so stubborn...
Maybe we'll get some answers once we've snagged those Echoes.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Alrighty then, let’s get prepped and roll out!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Finally convinced Grandpa Jingzhu to go to the hospital... It's getting late. {PlayerName} should be arriving here soon...
I’m here.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Oh my, you scared me! When did you get here?
At the start of your conversation.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Then what do you think?
As long as you pay.
I’m a bit curious.
Great, you can make some extra money while helping Grandpa Jingzhu. Talk about killing two birds with one stone, right?

speaker: Cảnh Chúc (Đang liên lạc)
anh_en: Hey there, it’s Jingzhu! I’m reaching out once again to ask for the help of you young folks.
Hehe, yes. I’ve thought it over and I do need the help of you young folks.
You don’t sound very enthusiastic, but it doesn’t matter. Once you arrive, you’ll be immediately convinced that my plan will work this time!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc (Đang liên lạc)
anh_en: I’ll be waiting for you at the Jinzhou Theater, and that red-haired Patroller will be joining us as well.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc (Đang liên lạc)
anh_en: And don’t you worry, I’ve already prepared your payment. I won’t let you work for free.
Sure.
Okay, fine...
Alright then, see you later!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc (Đang liên lạc)
anh_en: Alright then, see you later!
How are you?
What can I do for you?

speaker: Cảnh Chúc (Đang liên lạc)
anh_en: As usual, I’m doing just fine!
A valiant Midnight Ranger like myself won’t be deterred by a few setbacks!
Since we last met, I’ve been pondering a more practical approach...

speaker: Cảnh Chúc (Đang liên lạc)
anh_en: And I’ve finally devised one! Eager to put it into action!
You need help?
I see...

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Hey! You’re all here!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Tuners?

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Yes, Tuners have the ability to fine-tune the frequencies of Echoes, eliminating any unwanted noise and bolstering their strength!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Oh, right! It’s that round or square thing, isn’t it? How could I forget?

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Our goal for today is to acquire some Tuners from Tacet Fields.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Great! For stronger Echoes! Let’s get moving!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: When I heard Grandpa Jingzhu needed a hand, I zipped over here using my amazing overdashing skill!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: No need to hurry. Take a moment to catch your breath, young one.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: No worries, I’m bursting with energy! So, Grandpa Jingzhu, what’s the plan?

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Alright. I must say, {PlayerName}’s suggestion seems quite practical. Find a subject that piques her interest and proceed gradually...

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: So, I’ve devised a plan to enhance the Echo. Once we make the Scythes stronger, I’ll be ready to present it to her.
What plan?
Yeah, what else can we do? The Scythes is already pretty impressive. Can we kick it up a notch?

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Let me share a little secret with you. There’s another valuable asset in Tacet Fields... known as Tuners!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Ah, finally arrived. It’s just around the corner.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Sorry, but I must take a brief rest. I’m relying on you, young ones!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Nailed it! {PlayerName}, you’re really mastering this!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: We did find some Tuners! I gotta admit, I was kinda wondering why you seemed so at ease out in the wild.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: But now that I know you used to be a Midnight Ranger, it totally clicks!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: My captain taught me a lot... from uncovering Tacet Fields to identifying various Tacet Discords, even the places to find Tuners...

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: However, memories tend to play tricks as you age, so I must see it with my own eyes to be certain.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Even in the wild, I find myself relying on you young ones to help me reach my objectives.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: But enough dwelling on the melancholy. As long as the Echo gets stronger, I’m content.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Hmm, not bad. You’ve stirred up memories of my past glory.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Linghan should be delighted to see this, don’t you think?

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Let’s hurry back to show her!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Strange. It’s unusual for Linghan to not be outside soaking up the sun at this hour. Could she be indoors?

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: No response...
Did she go out?
Something's not right. Linghan typically avoids venturing out too far as her memory isn't as sharp as it once was...

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Yeah, I’ve got a weird vibe too. Let’s ask around the neighborhood.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Count on me! I practically know this area like the back of my hand. I’ll go ask everyone I can find to see if they’ve spotted Grandma Linghan.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Shaohua, have you seen Grandma Linghan today?

speaker: Thiều Hoa
anh_en: You mean the old lady next door?

speaker: Thiều Hoa
anh_en: It seems she went out early this morning.

speaker: Thiều Hoa
anh_en: Isn’t it strange? I heard she’s been quite unwell lately, hardly ever venturing outside. Instead, she spends hours basking in the sun right by her doorstep.

speaker: Thiều Hoa
anh_en: But she went straight out today, and I have no idea where she went.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Got it, thanks for letting me know. I’ll check with someone else and see if I can dig up more info.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Hello, may I ask your name?

speaker: Lãm Thanh
anh_en: Hello, I’m Lanqing. I just moved in. Are you a Patroller? Anything happened around here?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Hey, mind if I ask you something? Have you seen Grandma Linghan around today?

speaker: Lãm Thanh
anh_en: You're talking about the lady who's into Echoes, right? I haven't spotted her around today, unfortunately.

speaker: Lãm Thanh
anh_en: I’ve crossed paths with her a couple of times. She seems nice.

speaker: Lãm Thanh
anh_en: But she always looks a bit under the weather, and her memory seems a bit shaky.

speaker: Lãm Thanh
anh_en: I heard she’s dealing with some serious health issues. It must be tough for her.

speaker: Oánh Oánh
anh_en: *Sobbing* Grandpa! Finally had someone to help! We were so scared...
It’s reassuring to have your support. When it comes to Linghan’s safety, the more helpers, the better.
Thank you, young ones... Words are inadequate to express my gratitude.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Yep! The more eyes we have, the faster we can track down Grandma Linghan.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: But where on earth could Grandma Linghan have gone...?

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: I think she might have gone to that cave near the edge of Jinzhou.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: A cave, you say? Tacet Discords love hanging out in places like that. Let’s hurry and check it out!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: No, no, no, don’t cry. Tell Grandpa what happened.

speaker: Oánh Oánh
anh_en: Grandma left early this morning, and when Dad noticed and went to find her, she was gone! *Sobbing*

speaker: Oánh Oánh
anh_en: What if Grandma gets lost again...?

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Don’t worry, Yingying. Grandma will be alright. She’ll be back home soon.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: I must carefully consider why Linghan went out today. There must be a purpose behind it.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Ah, I see... Today is... I know where she is. No need to worry. I’ll bring her back home safely.
Need any help?
Let us help.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: This place is huge! How on earth are we going to find her? Ugh, it's so frustrating!
How to use it?

Don’t worry, {PlayerName}, it’s pretty straightforward. Normally, I’d give you time to figure it out yourself, but with Grandma Linghan missing, we can’t afford to waste any. Let me walk you through it.
You got it! I’ll be your guide through this.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Whoa, this new tech is amazing! We found her in no time flat.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Let’s not dawdle. Hang tight, Linghan! We’re on our way!
Should we split up?
Do we have any other leads?
Easy there, young one. There’s a clue that could help us locate Linghan swiftly.
Now that you mention it, something just jogged my memory. It might help us locate Linghan swiftly.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: If my memory serves me right, she should be gathering the Echo of Flautist. Given her health, she wouldn’t venture to Tacet Fields, so she must be exploring the wild for scattered Tacet Discords.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: In our day, we relied on experience to locate Tacet Discords, but I’ve heard there are more advanced technologies available now.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Yep! The gourd just got upgraded with a search function. Let’s see if we can use it to spot any nearby Tacet Discords.
Let me try...

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: {PlayerName}, are you ready?
Not yet.
I’m ready.
No worries. Take your time to sharpen your weapons.
Awesome, let’s do this! Grandpa Jingzhu said it’s the best time for Echo-catching, and I’m ready to snag a bunch!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: This place is seriously dangerous. Grandma Linghan isn’t in a good health condition. Why would she come here...

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Darn! She’s too far away to hear us!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: No! The Tacet Discords are closing in on her!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Oh, man! We can’t even use overdashing to catch up from this distance!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Leave it to me!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Frostbite Tortoise, I choose you! Protect Linghan!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Phew! That was a close call!
Let’s take this chance...!
Your observation is sharp, young one. You have the makings of a soldier. Now is the moment to strike! Seize the opportunity given by the lull in Flautist’s attacks!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Let’s go!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: She must be here to collect the Echo of Flautist. After all, today is... a special day.
What special day?
Many years ago on this very day, Jinzhou was besieged by a fierce Tacet Discord outbreak. Tens of Midnight Rangers stood firm on the front lines, confronting thousands of Tacet Discords.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: It was Linghan who proposed a brilliant strategy. With her deep understanding of Echoes, she suggested utilizing them to repel the enemies’ assault.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: To minimize casualties, she led the entire squad here to gather hundreds of Flautist’s Echoes.
She was also a Midnight Ranger?
Yes...

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Hey, isn't that person with the silver hair over there...? Grandma Linghan! GRANDMA LINGHAN! Over here!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Phew... Finally safe.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Young ones, are you alright?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: W-We’re fine! Just needed to catch our breath after that crazy moment...

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Instead of worrying us, go make sure Grandma Linghan’s okay!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Linghan, how are you feeling? Any injuries? Does it hurt?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Grandpa Jingzhu, why are you crying?

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: These tears... They’re tears of joy.

speaker: Lăng Hàn
anh_en: By the way, there’s a striking resemblance between you and my dear...

speaker: Lăng Hàn
anh_en: Both with a nose and two eyes, quite similar indeed, hehe.

speaker: Lăng Hàn
anh_en: But you’re nowhere near as handsome as him. In my eyes, he was incomparable—wise and brave beyond measure.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Y-Your cataracts seem to be worsening...
Hurry up! Get her reacquainted with you!
You’re right! Captain Linghan, it’s a pleasure to make your acquaintance. Allow me to introduce myself. I’m a member of the Vanguard of Midnight Rangers. You can call me Jingzhu.

speaker: Lăng Hàn
anh_en: Jingzhu... Did you just have flowers with you?

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Oh yeah! I was too busy dealing with the Tacet Discords, and I dropped them somewhere.

speaker: Lăng Hàn
anh_en: Your Echo is Frostbite Tortoise, isn’t it?
Let me get them for you!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: They’re right here. Let’s take them back to Grandpa Jingzhu!

speaker: Lăng Hàn
anh_en: You’ve raised it well, and the timing couldn’t be more perfect.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Linghan...

speaker: Lăng Hàn
anh_en: Seeing your Echo reminds me of my dear...

speaker: Lăng Hàn
anh_en: He shielded our entire squad with a humble Frostbite Tortoise, time and time again.

speaker: Lăng Hàn
anh_en: At first, everyone mocked him for choosing such a seemingly feeble Echo. Yet, they were all silenced by its might in the end.

speaker: Lăng Hàn
anh_en: After all, the strength of an Echo lies in the hands of its user.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: I see. My judgment was clouded by strength before, capturing Echoes purely based on their appearances. You're right. You're always right.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Here, this Noctemint is for you. Please accept it, Linghan. Will you once again be my lifelong companion?

speaker: Lăng Hàn
anh_en: Ah, the scent of Noctemint... it’s so familiar. My dear used to bring me Noctemints. Just a whiff would lift my spirits.

speaker: Lăng Hàn
anh_en: Flowers, Echoes... they’re all the same. Practicality is key.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Y-Yes! From this moment onward, I’ll be by your side, soaking in the sunshine, engaging in conversation... Whatever you desire, I’ll be there with you!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: As long as I can be by your side!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Because I made a promise to you, Linghan. I vowed to never let you be alone, and I intend to uphold that promise for eternity.

speaker: Lăng Hàn
anh_en: But alas, we can’t soak up the sun here.

speaker: Lăng Hàn
anh_en: Escort me back. Basking in the sun on my doorstep is where I feel most at ease.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Alright, alright, let’s go home!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Grandpa Jingzhu, where is Grandma Linghan?

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: After a major victory, she eventually fell ill. She started to feel mentally foggy, causing her memories to slowly fade away.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: She forgot how to navigate the streets of Jinzhou, forgot to eat her favorite Helmet Flatbread while they were still warm, and then...

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: She even forgot about me...

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: So, that’s why you’ve been chasing after Grandma Linghan, huh?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: You’re hoping to stick by her side as her special someone.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Yes, you’re correct. Our comrades, once vibrant youths, perished in battle, while others succumbed to illness.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: I can’t help but fear that someday if she were to regain her memories, she’d feel a profound loneliness... I cannot bear the thought.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Sorry for bringing up sad things. Thank you for helping me find Linghan.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Linghan has accepted me. It’s a great joy! I should feel happy!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: The past is the past. From now on, I’ll treasure every moment shared with Linghan!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Linghan isn’t in a good health condition, so I’ve let her return to rest for now.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Exactly! Let’s treasure every moment and live life to the max!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Hehe, if you have time, feel free to visit us, and we can chat about Echoes to our heart’s content.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: I can’t express my gratitude enough for your assistance in resolving this matter.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Plus, seeing you must have made Linghan so relieved to know that the people we risked our lives for have turned into amazing adults.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Thank you for your efforts. Here are what you deserve.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Besides the compensation, this old man has a word of advice for you.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Take good care of your Echoes. The world beyond can be perilous, and they may come in handy in times of need.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: To safeguard yourselves and those dear to you.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Such a relief to hear that! I’m so glad she got home safe.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Oh, and by the way, I’ve got a ton of questions. {PlayerName}, you too, right?
Yes...
You might have noticed already: Linghan was once an exceptional Midnight Ranger, serving as the captain of the Vanguard.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: She wasn’t just my captain; she's also my beloved wife, with whom I’ve shared many years...

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Being captain, she had a lot on her plate, always leading the charge, protecting our squad, and teaching us survival skills.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: As the battles escalated, she pushed herself beyond limits and suffered grave injuries.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Grandpa Jingzhu, you’re already done with treatment? That was quick!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: After all, it’s part of my Patroller duties.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Don’t let this old man’s age fool you. I’m still strong and these injuries hardly slow me down!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Really? Um... though it does seem like you’re totally fine now.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Of course! I’m used to injuries. Anyway, I’m feeling perfectly fine now. Shall we go?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Are you coming with us, Grandpa Jingzhu?

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Of course, how could I let you youngsters handle my affairs while I sit around? It’s dangerous outside Jinzhou and I’m familiar with the situation there. I’m sure I can be of some help.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: But...

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Haha, don’t worry! This old man used to be quite something in his day! Even though I’m old now, I can still hold my own against any danger.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Okay, Grandpa Jingzhu, promise me you’ll take care of yourself. If anything dangerous pops up, don’t try to tough it out. Just give me a holler right away!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: We’re almost there. Stick close to me!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Havoc Warrior is the monster with those big scythes, right? It’s indeed impressive! Grandpa Jingzhu, I had no idea you were so knowledgeable about Tacet Discords!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Of course! Back in my prime, with my captain, we captured all kinds of Tacet Discords...

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Hm? There are several Havoc Warriors ahead. Let’s go!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Grandpa Jingzhu, are you feeling alright?

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: I’m feeling perfectly good. Instead of worrying me, let’s focus on these <ano=Energy entities with chaotic frequencies>Tacet Discords</ano>.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: You’re right. There’s a whole bunch of Tacet Discords around. Which one do you think we should capture first?
The impressive one.
The formidable one.
Exactly, that’s my goal. Let’s aim to capture the most impressive of them all!
The formidable ones are always the most impressive. It’s one and the same.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Ah, let me think... the most formidable and impressive one around here is... Havoc Warrior! Let's capture it!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Hehe, knew we could pull it off! We’ve got an Echo now, easy peasy.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Hey {PlayerName}, hurry and absorb it before it poofs away!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Check it out, Grandpa Jingzhu! These massive scythes are just too cool, huh?

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Shh... I think I sense it. The frequencies of the Tacet Field...

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: There’s a Tacet Field nearby!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Mm, not bad. She should be pleased this time.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: I hope, just this once, she’ll stay long enough to hear me out before walking straight away...

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Ooh, I’ve got an idea! What if we transformed into the Scythes? That’d definitely impress her!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Oh, please don’t, dear. She might be scared. Perhaps we should gather a few more, just to be sure.

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Havoc Warrior is undoubtedly impressive, but relying on a single Echo might not be enough to capture her heart...

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: We need a collection, a display of multiple Echoes to truly leave an impression!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Yep! Having a bunch of Echoes following behind turns head, but how can we snag more?

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: To <ano=A place where TDs gather>Tacet Field</ano>! Tacet Discords are drawn to those grounds like moths to a flame.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Wow, there is indeed a Tacet Field! Grandpa Jingzhu, you really know a lot!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Hehe, I already told you, this old man had his fair share of adventures in his prime!

speaker: Cảnh Chúc
anh_en: Now, it’s your moment to shine. Clear this Tacet Field and you should be able to capture some Echoes.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Whew, finally done! Let me see...

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Whoa, two more Echoes to go! {PlayerName}, you’re so lucky!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: You know, the chances for Echoes to appear after taking down Tacet Discords are slim, not to mention bagging two at once!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: They say the stronger your Terminal, the likelier it is for Echoes to pop up. That's because... because... Anyway, your Terminal must be crazy powerful! Right?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: The gateway to the Somnoire is open again… Did something happen?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: Ah, there you are! I owe you my thanks for helping us clean up the mess.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: Haha, I figured you'd say so! Thank you. And, as always, I'll be there if you need anything from me.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: Rest assured. The Somnoire has always been generous. And, as always, I'll be there if you need anything from me.
Were you intercepting those dream fragments?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: Exactly. Those dream masses broke apart into countless dream fragments.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: They scattered like leaves in a forest, making it difficult to retrieve them all.
The Ebony Gatekeeper mentioned he's working on a solution.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: Is that so? Well, I guess he would've been more suited for this task than me...

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: Dreamwalker, I have a favor to ask. Can you continue to restore those chaotic Memory Zones?
Do you need to ask?
Sure, as long as you pay me.

speaker: NPC #150024
anh_en: Meow!
And you are?
Are you that white cat from before?

speaker: NPC #150024
anh_en: Meow!
Say something other than "meow."
Come on, I know you can talk.

speaker: NPC #150024
anh_en: Meow!

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: Dreamwalker, you've returned.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: The backup only retains limited memories from a certain point in the past, so it makes sense he doesn't remember what happened.
He asked for my help in restoring the Somnoire.
So... is there another problem brewing?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: At the moment, that fella is just a backup, so he's probably just doing his job, plain and simple.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: Behind this gateway lurks all sorts of mysteries. The chaos in the Somnoire hasn't been fully resolved, and I'm continuing my investigation.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: I'll be here to help you along the way, just as I did before.
It's nice to meet you.
The Ebony Gatekeeper didn't recognize me.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: Didn't we just have a grand adventure together? I know, you haven't managed to wrap your head around it yet, have you?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: Yes, you see… he's in a bit of situation.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: That fella who greeted you at the gateway wasn't actually the real Ebony Gatekeeper.
Not the real Ebony Gatekeeper?
What do you mean?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: After your battle in the Somnoire, he lost control over that realm for a time. To fill his unforseen absence, the Somnoire activated his backup.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: I hope it will make a difference.
What should I do next?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: You can follow "his" guidance and carry on with your exploration.
Okay.
You mean to complete this beginner's guide?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: Thank you, this will help to restore some of the Memory Zones.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: Exactly. "He" has mistaken you for a newcomer to the Somnoire and laid out a special route for you.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: But the real Ebony Gatekeeper's power is gradually being restored. Before long, that backup of his might be decomissioned...

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Trắng
anh_en: But that's for another day. For now, your path is already set.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: What took you so long to leave that Memory Zone?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Well, forget it...

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Ugh, enemies are everywhere.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: But you handled them like it's second nature... Truly impressive.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: How are you feeling?
Don't forget the rewards you promised me.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: I knew you weren't one to just sit back and watch.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Of course, I haven't forgotten the reward I promised you.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Let's wrap things up for now. Next time, we can go deeper into the Memory Zones together.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: …But when that day comes, maybe the real "me" will be taking charge, don't you think?
What do you mean?
The monsters in there weren't that hard to beat.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: You seem calm. Good. That means the Somnoire's effects haven't gotten to you.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Keep up with the good work, will you?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Well, that clears this area nicely.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: As you've probably already noticed, the Somnoire's size is near incomprehensible. This is just the tip of the iceberg,

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: There is still much work to be done if we are to prevent the Tacet Discords from escaping again.
I'll come here often.

speaker: NPC #800086
anh_en: You made it.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Is that so? It leads to the Somnoire, a place where all the dreams, memories, and emotions of Solaris-3 converge.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: You know about the Somnoire? It's where all the dreams, memories, and emotions of Solaris-3 are stored.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: It knows the taste of a child's favorite candy and the wild schemes of a dictator. It understands the beauty and darkness hidden in the subconscious of life.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: In other words, it holds the dreams of everyone, forever recorded.
Why are you waiting for me?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: The Somnoire records everything about our planet, and your presence is key to keeping it running smoothly.
That's nothing new to me.
I know, I'm the Dreamwalker.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: ...So you remember this place?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Before your reawakening, something that shouldn't have been there infiltrated the Somnoire.

speaker: NPC #800086
anh_en: I've been here waiting for you.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Now, the Somnoire is in chaos, and your assistance is much needed to restore its stability—Wait, something's not right…
You've already recovered?
Didn't we just fight?

speaker: NPC #800086
anh_en: What do you mean? I don't understand.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Something's not right... It's like he has no memory of our battle.)

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: You can call me Gatekeeper for now. My name isn't important—what matters is this gateway.
I recognize this gateway.
It leads to the Somnoire.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Impressive as always…
Even if you didn't ask, I'd do it anyway.
I'll consider it if the rewards are generous.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Yes, you've always been like this. Maybe that's why the gateway chose you.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Yes, you've always been like this. But don't worry, I can guarantee they will be.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Time is ticking. Let's go inside, then.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: With you on board, I'm confident we can restore the Somnoire to its normal state.
What do you need me to do?
Looks like the problem isn't solved.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: I can't explain it further to you just yet. Not before you regain your memories.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: The Somnoire needs authentic memories and experiences, and I shouldn't tamper with them.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: At least now you know that these gateways are kind of like Tacet Fields. Tacet Discords can escape from them.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: If you can help us fix the Somnoire, we may be able to prevent more Tacet Discords from spawning. Think of it as dispelling a Tacet Field.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Of course, you will be adequately compensated. What do you say?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: As you can see, we are now inside the Somnoire. What do you think of it?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: She is a virtual entity, a fusion of countless consciousnesses within the Somnoire, and the one experiencing this dream.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Just think of her as someone dreaming, but she doesn't truly exist. She's just an Illusia created by the gateway to the Somnoire.
Why is she here?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Because there has to be someone dreaming for a dream to exist, doesn't there?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: In fact, she will be a valuable ally as you navigate the Somnoire.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: You cannot bring anything inside here. If you need anything in battle, you'll need to manifest them from the dreams recorded in the Somnoire.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Such as... the Echoes you use in battle.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Go talk to her. She'll give you some important things for your dream.
It's beautiful.
It's bizarre.
It's familiar.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: After all, it's made up of the memories and dreams of countless individuals.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Dreams often take us beyond what we can imagine.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Back to the point, in the Somnoire, you'll encounter other entities apart from me.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Like her.
She is…

speaker: Hình Ảnh Mộng Mị
anh_en: Ah, hello. Are you dreaming too?
Are you really dreaming?
Yes, greetings, my fellow dreamer.
Hi, please give me an Echo or two.
Yes, I've been dreaming forever. You wouldn't believe the things I've dreamed.
Haha, hello to you! I've never seen anyone as lively as you here.
There is no need to rush…

speaker: Hình Ảnh Mộng Mị
anh_en: Now that you've found me, I'm guessing you want to hear about my dreams? I've been dreaming up some amazing things!

speaker: Hình Ảnh Mộng Mị
anh_en: Just now, I dreamed about...

speaker: Hình Ảnh Mộng Mị
anh_en: So, what do you think? Aren't my dreams exciting?

speaker: Hình Ảnh Mộng Mị
anh_en: You know that something's gone wrong here, right?

speaker: Hình Ảnh Mộng Mị
anh_en: Strange things have been gathering in the Somnoire lately, and I've been having nightmares too...

speaker: Hình Ảnh Mộng Mị
anh_en: So I won't keep you much longer. If you can help restore things to normal, we'll have all the time in the world to chat.
There are some powerful things in your dreams.
Thank you for sharing your dreams with me.
Hehe, I didn't lie to you, did I?
You're welcome! I really enjoyed sharing that with you.

speaker: Hình Ảnh Mộng Mị
anh_en: I've had so many amazing dreams, but sadly, there's no one here to listen...

speaker: Hình Ảnh Mộng Mị
anh_en: I'd be happy to share my dreams with you anytime you want!
Why not now?

speaker: Hình Ảnh Mộng Mị
anh_en: Because I understand you're here for business, not my dreams.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: That's amazing. I thought…

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Anyway… You did well today. I'll meet you outside the Gate.
You thought what?
You thought I'd be defeated?

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: I thought this task wouldn't be easy, even for someone like you.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: I underestimated you.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: The Somnoire has grown increasingly chaotic and dangerous.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Recently, it has been devouring and copying all dreams without discrimination...

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: You'll encounter more bizarre occurrences in the Somnoire… Creatures, plants, Tacet Discords, and even your cherished friends.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: While you are aware it's a dream, these sights may still leave a lasting impact on your psyche. I hope you are prepared.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: They aren't supposed to be here. This Memory Zone must have been corrupted, too.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Don't underestimate them, Rover. Be careful. We have no idea what kinds of enemies may appear in the current Somnoire.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: I'm not sure what that thing was, but the Metaphor it provided should come in handy.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: There is no such thing as an objective reality in this realm of dreams and memories. The more obscure something is, the more possibilities it holds.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Here they come again. Such a relentless mob of monsters.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Ugh, enemies are everywhere.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: But it seems you've become somewhat accustomed to the battles here. That's good.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: I've got something for you... They should come in handy at some point.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Anyway... See the thing over there? It's the culprit behind the chaos and corruption in this area...

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: It looks tough to deal with. You should make good use of the Illusive Echoes and Metaphors you've gotten so far.

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: Tacet Discords are coming out of the Gate...

speaker: Người Gác Cổng Đen
anh_en: The situation inside Somnoire must be worse than I thought.

speaker: NPC #800403
anh_en: My knights… have they all fallen?

speaker: NPC #800403
anh_en: Honorable Mechascouts and distinguished members of the order. Yet... the Void Storm has tainted them and left them stranded. Maintenance and restoration are in order. But we are in the height of the Celebration, the Knights of the Wild would not wish to mar our people's joy.
I can help them.

speaker: NPC #800403
anh_en: Truly?!

speaker: NPC #800403
anh_en: There is also Petrahane, Airelas, Honya, Albin, Golesia, Stieler, Landry, Erthgold… They have battled for far too long. Can you truly save them all?
The charge rests with me now.

speaker: NPC #800403
anh_en: Charge! To battle!

speaker: NPC #800403
anh_en: As Grand Commander, I have little to repay you with. But as an instructor unit of the Academy, I shall deem this charge a supplementary exam. Slay the foe, restore our fallen knights, and upon your success, I'll see to it that extra credits are awarded towards your final evaluation—along with a handsome reward worthy of your deeds.
For extra credits!

speaker: NPC #800403
anh_en: Charge! To battle!
You look in the direction the Grand Commander points, just as when Joljodra pointed toward the Grand Commander's location.

speaker: NPC #800403
anh_en: Then the final charge rests with me alone.

speaker: NPC #800403
anh_en: Behold, our Knights of the Wild. Defeat the enemies that beset them! Once they are restored, they shall take up arms by your side!

speaker: NPC #800403
