anh_en: My knights understand the true meaning of unity. To see their comrades aided without delay, these Common Knights will hurl you straight to the Grand Knights.

speaker: NPC #800403
anh_en: Charge! To battle! Some among our ranks have engaged foes of terrible strength. Be wary of these powerful enemies. But know that to strike them down is to purge the area of its greatest shadow.

speaker: NPC #800403
anh_en: Now then, {PlayerName}, please… lead the charge!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: For Astra, for Caldheim, for all the Knights of the Wild!
(What in the world...? Anyway, I might as well play along.)

speaker: NPC #800403
anh_en: Ah, so you must be {PlayerName}? Your name precedes you. Whispers of your deeds have long traveled the winds and frequencies to my ears.

speaker: NPC #800403
anh_en: I am the Grand Commander, leader of the Knights of the Wild.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I thought knights only existed in Rinascita.

speaker: NPC #800403
anh_en: Nay, far from it. Where life endures, knights stand watch. The Knights of the Wild are scattered across Lahai-Roi, ever charging toward danger to shield those in peril.

speaker: NPC #800403
anh_en: I am the 18th Grand Commander of the Knights of the Wild. Ask Astra, or Caldheim, they both will attest to the meaning and glory of our order.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Astra and Caldheim... Who are they exactly?

speaker: NPC #800403
anh_en: Charge! To battle! The final exam approaches! Strive for extra credits!

speaker: NPC #800403
anh_en: Charge! To battle! Pass the quiz! Extra credits!!

speaker: NPC #800403
anh_en: Congratulations. You have passed the exam! That was the most brilliant charge I have ever witnessed! {PlayerName}, when the day comes that I am damaged beyond repair, would you be willing to become the 19th Grand Commander of the Knights of the Wild?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: No, I implore you to take good care of yourself, Grand Commander. But know that I shall serve as a knight of the order and come to your aid whenever needed.

speaker: NPC #800403
anh_en: QAQ! QAQ!

speaker: NPC #800403
anh_en: We machines cannot shed tears, but I hope you know, I am deeply grateful.
I do!

speaker: NPC #800403
anh_en: From now on, you can receive the "Grand Commander's Extra Credits."

speaker: NPC #800403
anh_en: However, after this, all the benefits you previously gained will fade. In their place, however, you shall receive rewards beyond measure.
Accept the Grand Commander's Extra Credits.

speaker: NPC #800404
anh_en: Were I left with nothing else, I would still raise my sword and march forward.
Sword… What sword?

speaker: NPC #800404
anh_en: In my heart, my friend.

speaker: NPC #800404
anh_en: Perhaps you have heard the story of the Grand Commander?
The Grand Commander? Who's that?

speaker: NPC #800404
anh_en: I believe you ought to pay the Grand Commander a visit.

speaker: NPC #800404
anh_en: Though I wish I could see him again, I must wield the sword in my heart and continue to lead my own charge.
Joljodra points you in the direction of the Grand Commander.

speaker: NPC #800404
anh_en: I've heard your story from the Grand Commander. It seems the sword in your heart is just as keen as mine.

speaker: NPC #800404
anh_en: If you wish to continue the charge, I will point you toward the Grand Commander once more.
(Lead the charge.)
(Rest for now.)

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Free test! Free test! Come and get your free test right here!

speaker: NPC #850437
anh_en: Free test! Free test! Come and get your free test right here!
Why would I want a free test?

speaker: NPC #850437
anh_en: Oh, you'd rather pay? Fine by me. People always treat me like a trash can. I suppose I can stomach some Shell Credits instead of half-eaten sandwiches for a change.

speaker: NPC #850437
anh_en: Honestly, though. Kudos to your enthusiasm for exams. I'd say your cohort is the most motivated one I've seen so far!
That's not what I meant by that question.

speaker: NPC #850437
anh_en: Well, it was open to interpretation. Anyhow, the test has already started while we were speaking—

speaker: NPC #850437
anh_en: This is a test of combat mastery. Show your best kicks and shoot for the top-tier accreditation!

speaker: NPC #701053
anh_en: The Exostrider's fall was no silent affair. The Reactor Drive's glow pierced the darkness, and the warm frequency echoes in the air to this day.

speaker: NPC #701053
anh_en: Your Terminal has captured a warm afterglow—this is no coincidence. After all, similar frequencies are known to be drawn to each other.

speaker: NPC #701053
anh_en: Fellow bearer of an identical frequency, my name is Arsenio. Would you be willing to accept my invitation to our camp?
Sure.
I'm a little busy right now.

speaker: NPC #701053
anh_en: Thank you for accepting my invitation. I'll send you the coordinates shortly.

speaker: NPC #701053
anh_en: I appreciate the response. Perhaps I could send the coordinates to you in advance, and you may visit anytime as you please.

speaker: NPC #701052
anh_en: Sure, I'll head over right away.

speaker: NPC #701052
anh_en: I'm a little busy right now. I'll head over when I have the time.

speaker: NPC #100207
anh_en: Thank you for coming. I am the mech Solsworn, Arsenio.
Sure.

speaker: NPC #100207
anh_en: According to my calculations, long-term exposure to Void Storm corruption may lead to my loss of ability to self-control. Thus, I took it upon myself to stay away from populated areas and chose a solitary life.

speaker: NPC #100207
anh_en: Voidmatter corruption has already taken root within me, and the remaining functionalities of this body are no longer sufficient for me to move freely. Thus, as I reside so far away from civilization, I have no choice but to send out messages in search of help.

speaker: NPC #100207
anh_en: Fret not, the current situation conforms to my calculations, and I am able to remain functional for some time.

speaker: NPC #100207
anh_en: I appreciate your assistance. May the Reactor Drive's light shine upon us always.

speaker: NPC #100207
anh_en: I come from the Spacetrek Collective. The Roya have shown me the essence of the Reactor Drive's light. It's the warmth of the Exostrider's sacrifice that is meant to shine upon Lahai-Roi.

speaker: NPC #100207
anh_en: Where there is light, darkness lurks. The phenomenon known as the Void Storm is erasing the frequencies of our existence as we speak...

speaker: NPC #100207
anh_en: It devours everything in its path, leaving only corrupted Terminals in its wake. These Terminals are called the Tapes of Last Words.

speaker: NPC #100207
anh_en: Inside, they record the essences of the departed, and may once again see the light of day once they're purified of the Void Storm's influence.

speaker: NPC #100207
anh_en: My mission is to purify the Tapes of Last Words with the purifier integrated into my body and to prove that the departed existed.

speaker: NPC #100207
anh_en: Those who explored for the sake of everyone do not deserve to be lost in the storm.

speaker: NPC #100207
anh_en: If you come across any Tapes of Last Words in your journey, you may bring them to me. I shall have them purified and bear their existence firmly in my heart.
Why not search for them yourself?

speaker: NPC #100207
anh_en: Eliminate corruption from the Tape of Last Words and recover the unspoken messages of the lost—that is my mission.

speaker: NPC #100207
anh_en: Voidmatter Transfer Device operation complete. Body regeneration down. Voidmatter corruption remains within an acceptable range. Tape of Last Words successfully purified.

speaker: NPC #100207
anh_en: The Tape of Last Words has been reclaimed. I give thanks for your strength in fulfilling this sacred duty.

speaker: NPC #100207
anh_en: Fret not, my body will last until my mission... reaches its end.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: We've collected plenty of Tapes of Last Words. Ohhh... I can't watch Arsenio keep hurting itself like that, but the way it's determined to fulfill its duties... Let's bring them over quick!

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 17 and complete "Ominous Star."

[Event Rules]
1. Participate in By Moon's Grace and help prepare for the Moonlit Fair to boost the festival's Popularity.
2. Increase Popularity by fulfilling Wishes and building stalls.
3. Meet the Popularity goals to claim the corresponding rewards.
4. Any unclaimed rewards will be sent by mail upon your first login within 30 days after the event ends.
Converging Paths

1. During the Moon-Chasing Festival, you can increase Popularity via the activities in <color=#8c7e51>Lodge Wishes</color> and <color=#8c7e51>Fair Stalls</color> to make the Moonlit Fair more lively.\n2. Popularity ranges from Level 1 to Level 6.
Popularity

1. Build or upgrade stalls to increase Popularity, gain buffs, and unlock Companions.
2. Building or upgrading stalls requires Funds, which can be earned by completing Wishes in Lodge Wishes.
3. Stalls can be upgraded multiple times, with higher levels providing greater buffs.
4. After building a stall, you can participate in the stall's activities and may earn unexpected rewards, with additional daily rewards for Thus Says the Moon, Hsin's Fortuity, and Riddle Twiddle.
Fair Stalls

1. You can spend Preparation Credits and Funds to fulfill people's Wishes in <color=#8c7e51>Lodge Wishes</color>. Each Wish has its own resource cost.\n2. Fulfilling Wishes will earn you Funds and Wish Tags. Setting new records will boost Popularity.\n3. Send the right Companions to fulfill the Wishes in <color=#8c7e51>Lodge Wishes</color>. You can view their detailed stats on the Companions page.
Lodge Wishes
There is a preferred Companion Stat for each Wish. Selecting your Companions accordingly will earn you a higher score.\nTo boost your Companions' stats, interact with them on the Companions page.

Preparation Underway: Your Companions act in turn, earning scores based on their stats.\nScoring Rules: Scores fluctuate each round, as your Companions can't always perform at their absolute best. Nevertheless, Companions with higher stats have the potential to earn higher scores.
During preparation, Companions may experience a "Eureka" moment. The likelihood of this occurring varies for each Companion.
Eureka allows for additional investments. Higher risks yield greater rewards. Make your choice wisely.
Results: A Wish Rating depends on the combined scores of your chosen Companions. Higher Ratings earn you more Funds and Wish Tags.
Lodge Wishes Rules

1. Companions can help you fulfill Wishes in <color=#8c7e51>Lodge Wishes</color>.\n2. They have three stats: Knowledge, Action, and Teamwork. Higher stats and better matches with the Wish's recommended stat lead to higher Wish Ratings.\n3. Build and upgrade <color=#8c7e51>Fair Stalls</color> and complete the <color=#8c7e51>Festival Journal</color> quests series to unlock more Companions.
Companions

1. You can interact with Companions to boost their stats and Bond Level.\n2. Each Interaction has its own cost of Wish Tags. A higher cost results in greater enhancements.\n3. Complete Wishes in <color=#8c7e51>Lodge Wishes</color> to earn Wish Tags.
Interacting with Companions

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 17. For the best experience, complete "Thaw of Eons" before participating in this event.

[Event Rules]
1. Help Xiangli Yao prepare for the Moonlit Fair to boost the festival's Popularity.
2. Increase Popularity by fulfilling Wishes and building stalls.
3. Invite Companions to assist in preparations by completing the corresponding Side Quests, and earn higher Wish Ratings and Funds.
4. Achieve the festival goals to claim and redeem rewards.
5. After the event concludes, unclaimed rewards will remain available for 30 days and will be reissued via Mail when you log in during this period (Note: Rewards that have not been redeemed will not be reissued.)
By Moon's Grace

[About]
Arno, a special agent of the Black Shores, is currently looking for help in gathering Surveillance Datasets on the Lament with the promise of generous rewards. Interested individuals are welcome to speak with him.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and complete Main Quest Act VII "Thaw of Eons."

[Event Rules]
1. During the event, you need to activate challenges across different regions. You can participate in any unlocked challenge as many times as you want.
2. After the challenge starts, Surveillance Datasets will appear. Try to collect as many Surveillance Datasets as possible within the time limit. Once all existing Datasets are collected, new Datasets will appear. The more Datasets you collect, the better the rewards.
3. There are various modules available in the challenges. Utilize them strategically to speed up Dataset collection.
4. If there are any unclaimed rewards after the event ends, they will be automatically sent to your mailbox when you log in again within 30 days.

[About]
Fulmine, the manager of Wutherium Film Studio, looks worried these days.
The deadline for the next periodical is around the corner, but he seems to have trouble picking the right photos...

[Eligibility]
Complete Main Quest Chapter II Act III "What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing" and Side Quest "Scale of Past."

[Event Rules]
Explore areas according to the clues to collect the scattered Chrono Traces.
Collect all the Chrono Traces to receive Astrites and other rewards.
More Chrono Traces will be available for collection in other areas in the future.

Traces of Tides

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14.

[Event Rules]
1. Gain as many Tactic Points as possible in the Infinite Battle Simulation.
2. Each area of the simulation contains three Charting Nodes, with enemies growing stronger at each node. Defeating enemies at the third Charting Node will reward you with a great amount of Tactic Points.
3. Open Supply Chests after defeating enemies to claim Tactic Points and Low-Capacity Variable buffs.
4. Once you've collected enough Low-Capacity Variables, you can unlock new powerful buffs—High-Capacity Variables, which will greatly boost your combat power in the Infinite Battle Simulation.
Infinite Battle Simulation

[About]
Beneath the starry sky, the Black Shores keeps its endless vigil, calculating the arrival of the Lament.
But fear not the unknown—we are born of the stars.
Complete event quests to earn great rewards.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and arrive at the Black Shores in the main quest "To the Shore's End."

[Event Rules]
The event has three phases, each unlocking as you progress through the main quests.
Complete event quests to earn great rewards.
If you have any unclaimed rewards when the event ends, you can log in within 30 days afterward to receive the rewards via mail.
Please note that certain content of the event is not available while in Co-op mode. Quest Tracking is not available in certain game scenes.
Where Stars Slumber

[Mail Types]
There are two types of mail: Starred Mail and Other Mail.
Starred Mail stays pinned at the top of your mailbox and does not expire. It will not be deleted when you select "Delete Read Mails."
Other Mail has an expiration date and will be automatically deleted when it expires.

[Mail Capacity]
The mailbox can store a maximum of 99 mails.
Once the limit is reached, the oldest mails without attachments or with claimed attachments will be automatically deleted.
Make sure to claim your attachments promptly to avoid any loss from expiration and deletion.

[<color=#c19f51>Team Selection</color>]

After the trainee has formed a team, they can enter the challenge. The minimum number of Resonators in a single team is <color=#c19f51>1</color> and the maximum is <color=#c19f51>3</color>. The team formation will record the development status of the selected Resonators, which will remain unchanged in a large-scale training.

Starting from the <color=#c19f51>3</color>rd level training - Real Scene Simulation, trainees need to form <color=#c19f51>2</color> teams to challenge before the training begins.

[<color=#c19f51>Training Purpose</color>]

If the trainee eliminates all the enemies within the limited time, the training is considered successful. Only after success can they enter the next training. If all the small trainings within a large-scale training are completed, the large-scale training is considered successful.

In large-scale training, the status of the Resonators will be inherited. The trainee needs to ensure that at least <color=#c19f51>1</color> Resonator in the team survives, which is considered to have passed the large-scale training.

[<color=#c19f51>Training Subjects</color>]

The entire gameplay is composed of <color=#c19f51>4</color> large-scale trainings. In the first <color=#c19f51>3</color> large-scale trainings, each large-scale training has <color=#c19f51>4</color> rounds of small training. The <color=#c19f51>4</color>th large-scale training has only <color=#c19f51>1</color> training.

Trainees can temporarily leave the Tower of Adversity after completing a training, and the training progress of the trainees will be recorded. They can then choose to continue or reset the training progress.

Except for the behavior of continuing training, trainees can only play from the first training of the large-scale training.

[<color=#c19f51>Ability Limitations</color>]

In the Tower of Adversity gameplay, trainees cannot develop Resonators, use items, change equipment and Echo during the training process, and some system functions will also be prohibited.

[<color=#c19f51>Guardian of the Voice</color>]

In the Tower of Adversity gameplay, different trainings may have different buff effects. Trainees can adjust the team formation, equipment or Echo according to the buff effects.

[<color=#c19f51>Reward Rules</color>]

When passing a training for the first time, the trainee will receive a reward after the training settlement. <color=#c19f51>Repeatedly passing the cleared training will not receive the reward again</color>.

[<color=#c19f51>Tower of Adversity</color>]

A large underground comprehensive experimental center built before the Lament. It sank into the sea due to the terrain changes during the Lament, and only recently resurfaced. 

This research station has a depth of over ten thousand meters reaching the Moho, and there is a trend to continue to expand downwards. At the same time, there seems to be a periodic echo coming from the deep well, as if it is breathing. Therefore, the deep well has also gained the nickname of the Gate of Hell. 

Without a doubt, humans do not have the industrial capacity to build such a facility. At the bottom of the deep well, countless mysteries are waiting to be unveiled...

[<color=#c19f51>Exploration Cycle</color>]

The environment of the Tower of Adversity naturally recovers in a <color=#c19f51>two-week</color> cycle, and the data and monsters will be updated after the cycle is reset. The rewards from the data will also be updated. 

[<color=#c19f51>Underground Structure</color>]

The Tower of Adversity has <color=#c19f51>3</color> areas to be explored, and each area has <color=#c19f51>4</color> depths. Only after the explorer has completed the exploration of the <color=#c19f51>3</color> areas at the same depth, can they proceed to explore the deeper layers. 

[<color=#c19f51>Lineup Selection</color>]

Exploration requires the formation of <color=#c19f51>3</color> teams, each to complete the exploration of <color=#c19f51>3</color> areas. The Resonators who have already fought will be locked in the exploration area and cannot participate in the exploration of other areas until the exploration of the <color=#c19f51>3</color> areas of the same difficulty is completed. The explorer can choose to manually unlock the Resonators, but after the unlock, the exploration points of the current area will be reset. 

[<color=#c19f51>Exploration Rules</color>]

Explorers need to conduct multi-layer exploration in each area, each layer of exploration has a certain time limit. If the exploration is not completed within the time limit, it will be judged as a failure; if all the monsters are defeated within the time limit, it will be judged as a pass. 

[<color=#c19f51>Exploration Degree</color>]

When the explorer is exploring the surface layer, the relay layer, and the deep layer, the exploration degree will be evaluated in real time according to the explorer's performance. After the exploration is completed, a fixed amount of exploration points will be settled; 

When the explorer is exploring the mutation layer, the exploration should be ended as soon as possible to avoid pollution. The <color=#c19f51>faster the exploration is completed</color>, the <color=#c19f51>more exploration points will be obtained at the time of settlement</color>. 

[<color=#c19f51>Residual Echo</color>]

In the research station, each area node will have a Master of Illusion. The Master of Illusion has obtained the enhancement of the Lament's Echo, and has a stronger power than the general monsters, and even has rule-like characteristics (such as enhancement effects). The explorer needs to choose the lineup carefully according to the characteristics. 

[<color=#c19f51>Reward Rules</color>]

The deeper the exploration, the more information obtained, the more rewards. Every time a certain exploration degree is reached, rewards will be settled at the end of the cycle; when the explorer has completed the exploration of the surface layer, the relay layer, and the deep layer, rewards can be obtained in advance. 

[<color=#c19f51>Ability Limitations</color>]

In the Tower of Adversity, it is not possible to cultivate Resonators, use items, change equipment and Echo during the exploration, and some system functions will also be prohibited.

Amidst drifting starlight where fate entwines with the constellations, she unveils the revelations and blessings hidden within Septimont's lunar phases…
"You're from Huanglong, right? Hehe, worry not. I can give you Huanglong-style moon readings."

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 8.

[Rules]
Log in each day during the event to receive 1 Waveborn Moonstone, up to a total of 10.
Use Waveborn Moonstones to decipher Lunar Phases and earn rewards along with limited-time buffs.
Each buff lasts for 3 hours. Deciphering a new Lunar Phase within the buff's duration will replace the current buff.
Buffs are only active in the open world and some of the Sonoro Sphere challenges.
Decipher 7 Lunar Phases to obtain the exclusive Avatar "Wax and Wane."
Moonlit Revelation

Past memories lie buried deep within dreams, and the key to exploration is in your hands. Please do not forget, only within dreams will the answers be revealed.

[Dreamscape Aid]
Manually trigger the Divined Dream state when Dreamscape Energy reaches 500 points. In this state, Sigils and certain Metaphors will be enhanced, Crit. Rate and Energy Regen of all Resonators in the team are increased by 50% and 100% respectively. The cooldown of Resonance Skill or Resonance Liberation is reduced by 50%, triggered once every 4s. Divined Dream lasts for 10s and depletes all Dreamscape Energy when it ends.

[Exploration]
- Choose three Resonators and embark on epic battles in the Illusive Realm. 
- The Echo Skills, Stats, Levels, Resonance Chains, and Weapons of Resonators can be carried over in the event.
- In the Illusive Realm, you can gain powerful boosts from Metaphors. Sigils and certain Metaphors provide additional enhancements when Divined Dream is activated through Dreamscape Aid.
- Each battle in the Illusive Realm brings you against different enemies. Complete these challenges to earn Illusive Points and reach milestones to claim bountiful rewards.

[Remnant Crystal]
A Remnant Crystal will appear in the Memory Zone after defeating the powerful enemies found in the deepest parts of the realm. Use Waveplates to collect its rewards.

[Difficulty]
Higher SOL3 Phases offer more challenging Exploration in the Illusive Realm with more Remnant Crystals and Illusive Points as rewards. The difficulty of the Illusive Realm is dependent on the SOL3 Phase you're in when the Illusive Realm resets (04:00 every Monday). Adjusting your SOL3 Phase during each exploration cycle does not affect the difficulty and rewards of the current cycle.

Maji, the idea king, is back with yet another new campaign—

Interact with adorable Echoes and submit their behavioural data to Maji to collect Lollo Stamps and participate in the thrilling lottery!

Reach Union Level 14 and complete Main Quest Chapter II Prologue.

During the event, you can complete Lollo Campaigns to obtain a set number of Lollo Stamps. Each Lollo Stamp lets you peel off one Lollo Campaign lottery ticket.

Lollo Campaign: Rising Anew

1. In Deathtrap Mode, you can choose a Tactic after surviving each wave of attacks. 
2. Some waves may even reward multiple Tactics.
3. At the end of certain waves, KU-Money's Shop opens, allowing you to purchase Tactics using Sim Credits.
4. Tactics come in four rarities: Green, Blue, Purple, and Gold, with higher rarities offering stronger effects.
5. They're also grouped into Tactic Sets based on their type. You start with access to Green and Blue Tactics from each set. As you collect more Tactics from a set, the Purple and Gold ones of that set become available.
Tactics Terminal

1. You can view details about the Tacet Discords attacking in the current stage, including their types and threat levels.\n2. Select an image to see more info about each TD type.\n3. TDs are categorized into three threat levels: Standard, Elite, and Dangerous, each causing different amounts of damage to the Energy Matrix upon reaching it.
Tacet Discords Overview

[Introduction]
Built on the principles of ancient sonar technology, this detector locates special collectibles by scanning their specific frequencies within an area.
 
[Instructions]
1. Sonar Circuits are required to use the Casket Sonar. Sonar Circuits can be synthesized at the Synthesizer, and the Synthesize recipe for Sonar Circuits is unlocked by increasing your Pioneer Association Level.
2. Once special collectibles are located, the Casket Sonar will stay activated. It will deactivate once all identified items are collected. You can locate up to 5 collectibles at once.
3. The Casket Sonar can only be used in areas where a Use Permit has been obtained. Special collectibles in unauthorized regions cannot be located.
Casket Sonar

[About]
The agents of the Black Shores have long been the first to respond in times of crisis. To lower the risks they face in fighting the TDs, the Black Shores has developed specialized combat devices designed to counter the threat. Valentina is now leading simulation tests of the devices, and she's counting on your assistance to push the tests forward.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and complete Main Quest Chapter II Prologue to unlock.

[Event Rules]
1. In this event, you will deploy Combat Machines to defend the Energy Matrix against simulated TD Outbreaks.
2. The simulated Tacet Discords attack in waves. You will have time to strategically place various types of Combat Machines before each wave begins.
3. Build your lineup wisely to counter different types of Tacet Discord.
4. Progress through the stages to unlock the "Deathtrap Mode,"  where new Tactics provide powerful battle boosts.
5. During the Limited-Time Rewards period, complete tasks to earn "TD Slayer" Coupons. Collect enough to unlock Phantom: Fallacy of No Return.
6. Any unclaimed rewards will be automatically sent to you via Mail the next time you log in within 30 days after the Limited-Time Rewards period expires.
7. Limited-time rewards cannot be claimed once the reward window ends, but you can continue playing to earn permanent rewards.
Tidal Defense Simulator

Stages in this event support progress saving when you quit mid-challenge. Upon re-entering the stage, you can choose to continue from your last save or start over.

Notices:
1. The saved progress includes: wave progress, deployed Combat Machines, and unlocked Overwatch Protocols and Combat Machine upgrades when you first started the stage. In the Deathtrap Mode, it will also include any Tactics or items obtained.
2. Progress is automatically saved after each wave ends and after selecting Tactics in Deathtrap Mode.
3. All progress saved when quitting in mid-challenge will be erased after the game updates to a new version. Please keep the version update times in mind.
Save Feature

Terminal Swap

[About]
Behold! Wutherium Film Studio Special Feature: Resonators in Combat Edition is back for a limited time!
Capture Resonators' exhilarating momen
ts during combat, then submit the photos to Fulmine and C-MOSS to earn plenty of rewards!

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14.

[Freeze Frame]
During the event, you will be given different daily Freeze Frame challenges, each with Normal and Hard modes. Complete Normal Mode to unlock Hard Mode for that challenge and the Normal Mode for the next Freeze Frame challenge.
Each Freeze Frame challenge will center on a specific Resonator. Your goal is to capture highlights of these Resonators in combat by meeting specific objectives. Completing these tasks earns you rewards.
Complete Normal Mode to unlock Free Mode, where there are no designated Resonators and you can select your own model. Complete Hard Mode to unlock the Slow Motion gadget during photography.

[Slow Motion]
During Freeze Frame challenges, when the designated Resonator performs the action needed for the objective, Slow Motion will be triggered. Time will slow down significantly, allowing you to observe and capture precise moments of the Resonator's movements.
In Free Mode, Slow Motion will no longer trigger automatically. Instead, you can activate it manually using the Slow Motion gadget whenever you want.

Note: Stage "Freeze Frame: Gentle Stream" will be available simultaneously with Featured Convene "Blessings From Dewy Winds."
This event is unavailable in Co-op Mode.
If there are any unclaimed rewards after the event ends, they will be automatically sent to your mailbox when you log in again within 30 days.
Recaptured: Action Highlights

[About]
The Huaxu Academy has recently made a breakthrough in Utility tech. Researcher Lanyan now requests your help testing a new tool near the Academy.

[Event Rules]
1. Assist Lanyan in testing the Flight Utility to earn Astrites, upgrade materials, and other rewards.
2. Rovers who have not yet unlocked Flight can gain access to the ability by participating in the event. Those who have already unlocked Flight can immediately use it in Jinzhou.
3. The event will remain available until completed, and will automatically close some time after completion.
Windrider Project

[Introduction]
The Lootmapper identifies specific frequencies to quickly locate nearby undiscovered Supply Chests. It is an indispensable tool to facilitate exploration in the wilds.

[Instructions]
1. Place a Lootmapper to scan for nearby, undiscovered Supply Chests within its range. 
2. You can only place 3 Lootmappers at once. If you exceed the limit, the first one will be taken back automatically. You may also manually retrieve any Lootmapper you have placed.
Lootmapper

In Custom mode, you can adjust color temperature, intensity, brightness, and texture intensity.
Please note that the Eye Comfort feature is not compatible with Global Filter.

As the Tactical Simulacra project advances, the Huaxu Academy has successfully achieved the measurement of Tunability, a property through which countless Reverberations converge into Tacet Discords. Disrupting their Tunability would mean a lethal blow that paralyzes them...

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14.

[Event Rules]
1. In Tactical Simulacra: Off Tune, challenge waves of powerful enemies using special buffs across different simulation domains.
2. As you complete more challenges, new special buffs will be available to you in the subsequent challenges.

[Equip Echoes]
Equip Echo to gain attributes, Echo Skills, and specific bonuses.
Drag and drop for faster equipping.

The number of Echoes you can equip is limited by the total COST. The COST of equipped Echoes cannot exceed your current COST limit.

[Echo Upgrade]
Upgrading an Echo raises an Echo's Mainstat. This improvement is not randomized.
Echo Upgrade also unlocks new Substat slots every 5 levels.

[Echo Tuning]
By Tuning an Echo, you can unlock new random Substats and unleash its potential. The unlock Substats will be fixed and cannot be tuned again.
(Echoes with the lowest rarity may not be able to be Tuned due to data interference.)

[Data Modification]
Data Modification for Mainstats and Substats has different rules and item requirements.
Use a Modifier to adjust the first Mainstat of a selected Echo into the designated stat. This can only be done on unupgraded 5-star Echoes.
1 Modifier is consumed for each Mainstat Modification.
Use a Transducer to adjust the Substats of a selected Echo to random stats, excluding locked Substats. This can only be done on fully tuned 5-star Echoes.
The number of locked Substats determines the amount of Transducers consumed in each Modification:
- With 2 or fewer locked stats, consume 1 Transducer.
- With 3 locked stats, consume 2 Transducers.
- With 4 locked stats, consume 3 Transducers.
You may choose whether to apply the Modification results in Substat Modification. Discarding the result does not refund used Transducers.

Substat Modification results that are not confirmed due to unexpected errors will be saved in the server for up to 30 days. Please confirm your results in time.

[Basic Gameplay]
The game is played with a deck of 16 cards. Each player starts with a hand of 8 cards. Players flip a coin to decide their play order in each round.
In a player's turn, they draw one card from their opponent's hand. If a player has two identical cards in hand, they may play them as a pair.
The game ends when any of the victory conditions are met.

[Victory Conditions]
1. Each player starts with 2 HP. Drawing the Crownless Card costs 1 HP. If a player's HP drops to 0, they lose the game.
2. If a player plays every card in their hand while their opponent is still holding the Crownless Card, the player who goes out wins.

[Card Details]
1. Wild Card: At the start of each turn, the Wild Card randomly transforms into another number card in the player's hand. It cannot transform into the Crownless Card, a card that has already been played, or repeat its transform in previous rounds. Wild Cards can form pairs like standard cards.
2. Crownless Card: There is only one Crownless Card in the deck. Drawing it causes the player to lose 1 HP (out of 2). The first player to lose 2 HP loses the game.
Card Game

speaker: NPC #750675
anh_en: Hey there! Want to play a round of Super Cloud Ride Challenge?

speaker: NPC #750675
anh_en: It's a racetrack tailored to help the Xuanfang Wardens hone their driving skills!

speaker: NPC #750675
anh_en: Just imagine it! Galloping down the track on that lightning-quick ride, blood pumping, the wind whistling in your ears!

speaker: NPC #750675
anh_en: And the joy of breaking through all distractions, drifting last-second around obstacles...
Only a veteran such as you can do it!

speaker: NPC #750675
anh_en: And the joy of speeding past your opponents in turbo...

speaker: NPC #750675
anh_en: I know you don't want to miss an experience like that! Come now, try our Super Cloud Ride Challenge firsthand!

speaker: NPC #750675
anh_en: I'm in.

speaker: NPC #750675
anh_en: Woohoo! I was hoping you'd say that!

speaker: NPC #750675
anh_en: Wow, you're even better than I thought! A real speed demon!

speaker: NPC #750675
anh_en: But records are made to be broken! If you compete again, I'll be your super loyal fan!

speaker: NPC #750675
anh_en: Bye now! I hope we'll see each other again!

speaker: NPC #750886
anh_en: Oh, hi, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #750886
anh_en: Could you give it a try and tell us what you think?
Sure.

speaker: NPC #750886
anh_en: Just touch the Battle Shade Shroud to enter the testing ground in Fogveil Pagoda.

speaker: NPC #750886
anh_en: I'll wait for you here.

speaker: NPC #750886
anh_en: You're just in time. I have a favor to ask.
Does it have something to do with this mechanical gateway?
Go on.

speaker: NPC #750886
anh_en: This mechanism was built by T-G0NG for the Skyworks. It's called the Battle Shade Shroud.

speaker: NPC #750886
anh_en: It leads to a drill ground in Fogveil Pagoda. The facility generates holographic Tacet Discords—pretty much every documented type—and uses them to test Autopuppet combat capabilities.
And the Skyworks is not doing the test themselves?

speaker: NPC #750886
anh_en: The holographic TDs are quite powerful. They're designed to test how well the Autopuppets fight as a team and to push the top models to their limits.

speaker: NPC #750886
anh_en: We've recently adjusted the holographic TDs' power. Some testers think they're too difficult, while others say that that's the point.

speaker: NPC #750886
anh_en: You're back! How was the test?

speaker: NPC #750886
anh_en: You're welcome to come back and perform the test again at any time. Any data we can get will be very helpful.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: If I have time, I'll come again.
Easy.
A bit too hard.
The difficulty was just right.

speaker: NPC #750886
anh_en: Too easy? We'll consider upping the difficulty.

speaker: NPC #750886
anh_en: If even you think it's too difficult, we'll tune it down a bit.

speaker: NPC #750886
anh_en: Great! It looks like we can start rolling out the new tests.

speaker: NPC #750886
anh_en: Thank you for your help, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #750886
anh_en: I've contacted the Skyworks and arranged your payment.

speaker: NPC #750674
anh_en: This device is ingenious, truly...

speaker: NPC #750674
anh_en: Hey, {Male=good sir;Female=good lady}! A word?

speaker: NPC #750674
anh_en: And so, I'd like to learn some tricks of mechanism from you. Please take a look at them for me!

speaker: NPC #750674
anh_en: My master always says that after you ask for help, you've got to show some gratitude. So when you get back, I'll have a proper thank-you gift prepared. Please!
What is it?
I'm busy. Make it quick.

speaker: NPC #750674
anh_en: You seem skilled. You must know something about mechanical devices.

speaker: NPC #750674
anh_en: Look at that device! It can fire at Tacet Discords and blast them sky-high even from over ten meters away!

speaker: NPC #750674
anh_en: I feel powerful just thinking about it! At least, that's how it was supposed to work... But when I tried to use it, it just blew my master's wig off his head!

speaker: NPC #750674
anh_en: How could that happen?! I just can't figure it out!

speaker: NPC #750674
anh_en: Now, every time I see this thing, I just think of that scene—my master rubbing his head, his wig flying through the air amidst the puff of smoke, and I just...

speaker: NPC #750674
anh_en: I can't seem to steady my hand, no matter what I do! How am I supposed to operate the thing?! And if I can't get it right, I'll fail my master's test!

speaker: NPC #750674
anh_en: My hero has returned!

speaker: NPC #750674
anh_en: I've learned a lot from watching you operate those devices, but I still don't really get them...

speaker: NPC #750674
anh_en: So what do you think matters most when operating them?
The conviction to eradicate Tacet Discords.
Keep your eyes on the target and steady your hands.

speaker: NPC #750674
anh_en: Oh, I see! Conviction! Next time I'm using them, I'll stare down those Tacet Discords with all my heart!

speaker: NPC #750674
anh_en: Oh, I see! My master once said, "If you cannot understand, just keep practicing." Seems like I just need more practice.

speaker: NPC #750674
anh_en: Alright... I'll try my hardest.

speaker: NPC #750674
anh_en: Here's a little token of my appreciation. Thank you!

speaker: NPC #750897
anh_en: I've taken note of your heroic bearing, {Male=good sir;Female=good lady}!

speaker: NPC #750897
anh_en: There's one more device, but it's a bit farther away. Sorry for all the trouble.

speaker: NPC #750897
anh_en: You blasted those Tacet Discords into the air! Incredible!

speaker: NPC #750897
anh_en: There's another device near the house. Would you like to give it a try?
